Job Title: Clinical Supply Chain Manager (FSP, UK)

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Overview

This is a UK-based FSP opportunity in which you will be dedicated to supporting a global pharmaceutical sponsor as an embedded Clinical Supply Chain Manager.


Acting as the clinical supply representative within cross-functional study teams, you will be responsible for driving supply strategy, managing vendor oversight, mitigating supply risks, and ensuring clinical supply activities are aligned with study objectives and timelines. The role requires strong collaboration across internal sponsor functions and external partners, with a focus on governance, oversight, and strategic decision-making rather than day-to-day operational execution.


If you enjoy working at the intersection of strategy, stakeholder management, and operational excellence, this role offers the opportunity to influence clinical trial success within a sponsor environment while benefiting from the support and development opportunities of an FSP model.

Your Responsibilities
• Interpret clinical trial protocols to create and execute an effective clinical trial supply chain solution

  • Create master English label text in accordance with relevant regulatory framework (e.g. Annex 13)
  • Create and maintain demand forecasts and packaging plans so that packed clinical supplies are readily available in accordance with the project requirements
  • Initiate packaging campaigns with the assigned vendor and provide oversight to ensure on-time delivery
  • Setup, monitor, and where necessary, update study assigned Interactive Response Technology (IRT) systems to ensure study inventory is effectively managed
  • Create an appropriate distribution plan and have oversight of the assigned vendor(s) executing it
  • Ability to work independently and proactively to ensure that the supply of all trial materials is delivered to the right place at the right time
  • Provide ongoing budget tracking activities so that projects are run efficiently and in accordance with client approved quotations
  • Maintains 100% compliance on all assigned training and applies learnings to everyday practice
  • Remain up to date in all GxP and regulatory requirements applicable to the role
  • Leads client and vendor related meetings where necessary to discuss clinical supply chain topics or status updates
  • Creates a Temperature Excursion management plan
    • Manages the review and assessment process of Temperature Excursions reported to the IQVIA Clinical Trial Supplies team
    • Conducts thorough and regular risk management assessments to ensure all risks are systematically reviewed and appropriate mitigations are executed

    Education, Knowledge and Qualifications
    • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related discipline
    • 2-3 Years related industry experience in Clinical Trials (Essential)
  • 2-3 Years experience in Clinical Supply Chain Management (Essential)
    • Working knowledge of clinical trial supply processes including demand forecasting, inventory management, packaging, labeling, distribution, and returns
  • Experience working with IRT/RTSM systems and clinical supply management tools
  • Understanding of GCP, GMP, GDP, GxP, and applicable clinical supply regulations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Experience in supply planning, demand planning, inventory planning, or production planning within a regulated environment
  • Understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes from manufacturing through distribution and clinical site supply
  • Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP, for inventory management, material planning, supply tracking, and reporting
  • Ability to analyze supply and inventory data to support forecasting and decision-making
  • Ability to build effective relationships and collaborate across global, matrixed organizations
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

Professional proficiency in English

Please note this role is based in the United Kingdom and is delivered through an FSP (Functional Service Provider) model supporting a dedicated pharmaceutical sponsor. This role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

raw.description:
What Business Analysis contributes to Cardinal Health

Business Analysis serves as a liaison between the organization's businesses and IT systems development teams to align business strategies and capability needs and to ensure IT systems enable their desired value. This job family identifies and analyzes business needs, defines requirements and objectives, and makes recommendations for solutions using new and existing technologies. This job family researches and documents relationships between the components of the application system (i.e., end users, business processes, data, applications, and devices) and translates business requirements into application requirements.

Job Summary

The Consultant, Pricing Solutions Analysis supports custom pricing applications and data solutions for Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution segment. This role acts as a liaison between the organization's businesses and iPrice application development teams to align business strategies and capability needs to ensure the iPrice system enables their desired value. This role identifies and analyzes business needs, defines requirements and objectives, and makes recommendations as a subject matter expert (SME) on the iPrice system.

Location: This position is remote. Candidates must be based within the United States and able to work EST or CST business hours.

Responsibilities

  • Develop subject matter expertise of iPrice (a custom pricing application), business processes, and master data.
  • Focus on continuous improvement to deliver solutions that improve profitability and customer experience.
  • Elicit and document business requirements with stakeholders and subject matter experts.
  • Convey business requirements to developers with appropriate level of detail.
  • Perform functional and regression testing and facilitate user acceptance testing with business teams.
  • Deliver timely and effective communication to stakeholders and impacted partners for progress updates and implementations.
  • Support analysts, developers, and business stakeholders with data questions and investigations
  • Document data structures, business logic, and ETL processes – including conducting recurring trainings and data information sessions with end users.
  • Identify, design, and implement process improvements by automating manual processes and optimizing data delivery for greater scalability
  • Maintain Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Compliance.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Enablement and Learning Business Partners to develop training programs and job aids.
  • Create and maintain documentation for team processes and supported applications including SOPs, user guides, and data catalogs.
  • Maintain SQL Server and Oracle databases.
  • Perform ad hoc analytics and database development to support applications and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred.
  • 4+ years experience in related field, preferred.
  • Proven track record that demonstrates curiosity, creativity, innovation, and initiative preferred.
  • Strong communication skills in writing, speaking, presenting, and listening preferred.
  • Ability to efficiently project manage, organize and prioritize tasks preferred.
  • Experience with JIRA or similar project management tools, preferred.
  • Experience in SQL (SQL Server preferred), including creating stored procedures, views, scripting, and automation, preferred.
  • Familiarity with other database technologies: e.g., HANA, Oracle, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, preferred.
  • Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) applications or other Price Management software, preferred.
  • Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), preferred.
  • Experience managing projects that span both technical and non-technical teams, with an emphasis on engaging stakeholders and building business requirements and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), preferred.
  • Proficient in creating comprehensive, user‑friendly documentation that communicates pricing workflows, business logic, and standard procedures across cross‑functional teams preferred.
  • Established background in launching software or services in partnership with and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development, and understanding of development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Kanban), preferred.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes, data pipelines, and working with structured/unstructured data, preferred.

Anticipated salary range: $82,100 - $117,200

Bonus eligible: No

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 11/30/2026 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

Deputy Program Manager — Federal Health IT Operations

Location: Remote — United States (National Capital Region preferred)
Security Clearance: Active Secret required

Lead Complex Operations. Keep Mission Delivery Moving.

Rackner is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager to lead day-to-day service operations supporting a complex federal health IT mission. This role brings together clinical, training, field, and technical teams to keep services coordinated, resources available, and operational commitments on track.

You'll work closely with program leadership to manage competing priorities, coordinate workforce capacity, and address operational challenges across multiple service-delivery functions. This opportunity offers meaningful leadership responsibility in a DoD environment, where sound operational decisions help support military health services and mission readiness.

What You'll Do

  • Lead day-to-day service operations across multiple teams supporting a complex federal health IT mission.
  • Coordinate operational schedules and priorities across training, field activities, military exercises, and ongoing service delivery.
  • Manage workforce capacity and resource coordination to support operational readiness and service continuity.
  • Identify and address scheduling conflicts, staffing challenges, and competing operational priorities.
  • Coordinate supplemental staffing and surge support in response to changing mission needs, ensuring activities remain within authorized work requirements.
  • Lead weekly operational and monthly service reviews, communicating progress, risks, and priorities to program leadership.
  • Support the Program Manager and maintain operational continuity when acting on their behalf.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in service management or operations leadership supporting Department of Defense (DoD) programs.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
  • Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional certification.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Field Service Management.
  • Coordinating schedules and operational resources across globally distributed teams.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, you'll work alongside multidisciplinary teams supporting important federal missions and solving complex operational and technical challenges.

We value collaboration, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement. Our environment encourages professional growth and provides opportunities to strengthen service delivery and contribute to meaningful mission outcomes.

Benefits & Perks

Rackner offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to applicable eligibility requirements and plan terms, including:

  • Company-supported certifications and professional development opportunities.
  • Career development and leadership opportunities.
  • 401(k) with a 100% company match on contributions up to 6%.
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
  • Weekly pay and team events.

Work Arrangement

This position is remote within the United States, with a preference for candidates located in the National Capital Region.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

raw.title: Solutions Architect
raw.excerpt: At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents.
raw.description:
At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation.

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

As a Solutions Architect at Cube, you'll be the technical bridge between our product and our customers' data infrastructure. You'll work hands-on with prospects and customers across industries to design, implement, and optimize semantic layer architectures that solve complex data challenges. This is a highly technical, customer-facing role where your SQL expertise and data analysis skills have a direct impact on customer success.

What you will do:

  • Design and architect end-to-end semantic layer solutions using Cube, integrating with customers' existing data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Build comprehensive data models in YAML or JavaScript that define metrics, dimensions, and business logic.
  • Develop proof-of-concepts and technical demonstrations on customer data, and lead technical discovery sessions to understand data architecture and requirements.
  • Guide customers on best practices for data modeling, caching strategies, access control, and performance optimization.
  • Run hands-on workshops and training to enable customer teams, and partner with Sales to provide technical expertise during the evaluation process.
  • Write complex SQL to analyze customer data and validate solution designs, and build integrations between Cube and downstream BI tools, notebooks, and custom applications.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the customer lifecycle, and bring customer feedback back to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.

Who you are:

  • Expert-level SQL proficiency: you can write complex queries, optimize performance, and understand query execution plans.
  • Strong data analysis skills: you explore data, identify patterns, validate metrics, and communicate insights.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript or Python, comfortable working with APIs and building data transformations.
  • 3+ years in solutions architecture, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a similar technical customer-facing role.
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack: data warehouses, transformation tools, and BI platforms.
  • Experience with semantic or metrics layers, or BI modeling frameworks (LookML, dbt metrics, or similar).
  • Strong communication skills: you can translate technical concepts for both technical and business audiences.

Bonus points:

  • Prior experience with Cube.js or similar semantic layer platforms.
  • Background in analytics engineering or data platform roles, and familiarity with dimensional modeling best practices.
  • Familiarity with REST/GraphQL APIs and how applications consume analytics.
  • Knowledge of caching strategies and performance optimization for analytics workloads.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift) and an understanding of multi-tenancy, access control, and data governance.
  • Experience with embedded analytics or building data-powered applications.
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM integration with semantic layers, and contributions to open-source data projects.

This role is customer-facing and involves occasional travel to customer sites and company events.

We're a fully remote company based in San Francisco. You can work from anywhere and join our highly collaborative team.

raw.description:
The VITAS Telecare RN is a member of the interdisciplinary team who is the pivotal person responsible for identifying the physical, psychological, social, and spiritual needs of those patients and families needing assistance after normal business hours. He or she initiates appropriate interventions to the patients and families by utilizing the nursing process, the VITAS Palliative Care Guide, and Telecare Protocols during alternate hours.

  • Provides clinical assessment and intervention utilizing the nursing process, VITAS Palliative Care Guide, and Triage Protocols.
  • Serves as the patient and family advocate by communicating with the attending physicians, long term care facility staff, case managers, and others external to VITAS as necessary. Provides collaboration with LPN/LVN’s.
  • Coordinates all service delivery after hours including patient and family education, dispatching of interdisciplinary visits, and coordination of services with external vendors and resources as needed.
  • Provides support and collaboration with Telecare staff to ensure favorable patient outcomes.
  • Provides bereavement support to families.
  • Documents interactions with patients, families, contacts, and vendors in the patient record to include the assessment, plan of care, caller agreement to the plan, any actions and interventions and the resolution of each patient/family interaction.
  • Reviews all entries in the record made by Telecare LPN/LVN’s and Patient Care Coordinators and ensures compliance with documentation Standards.
  • Participates in the orientation of new team members as assigned by the supervising manager.
  • Attends regularly scheduled in-services, staff meetings, and educational conferences.
  • Develops and achieves professional growth goals and objectives, and reviews with supervising manager on a monthly basis.
  • Seeks certification in the specialty of hospice nursing when qualified to do so.
  • Instructs and documents appropriate use of medications, home medical equipment and supplies.
  • Appropriately utilizes the resources of contract personnel such as Pharmacy, HME, agency staff, and transportation services.
  • Promotes a customer service-oriented approach to care delivery.
  • Supports and promotes all Care Connection Center cultural platforms.
  • Compliance with all departmental standards, policies, and procedures with training and education, management of the workload, disaster planning, attendance adherence, and quality standards.
  • Performs other job duties as required.

This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to perform any other job duties assigned by their supervisor or management.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • A minimum of two years’ experience in acute-care hospital nursing in either medical-surgical, oncology, home health, or emergency required.
  • One year of customer service/call center experience preferred.
  • Eligible for licensure in other states VITAS Triage services are located.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, as well as demonstrated effective telephone skills.
  • Ability to work as a team player and multi-task.
  • Proficient in customer conflict resolution and crisis management.
  • Proficient in telephone techniques including phone etiquette, and handling of calls.
  • Thorough knowledge of professional nursing principles, methods and procedures; anatomy and physiology; medical supplies and equipment used in nursing practice; and the uses and effects of medications including narcotics.
  • Working knowledge of applicable state and federal laws and regulations pertaining to registered nursing and the scope of practice limitations of clinic support staff.
  • Ability to work weekends and holidays as necessary to support the operations of the Care Connection Center.
  • Ability to type 40 WPM.

EDUCATION

• Graduate from an accredited school with an associate or bachelor’s degree in Nursing.

Shift Differential

RN Telecare- Evenings 4PM - 12AM = $2.50/Hour

RN Telecare- Evenings 12AM - 8AM = $3.75/Hour

RN Telecare- Evenings 8AM - 4PM = $2.50/Hour

CERTIFICATE & LICENSURE

• Current Registered Nurse License(s) (with no current/pending restrictions) required.

• Telecare RNs that reside in a Nurse Licensure Compact State are required to have or obtain a multistate license designation for their state active nursing license.

• May be required to obtain additional nursing licenses, based on business needs.

ACCOMMODATIONS

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

The Cybersecurity Project Manager is responsible for the delivery of strategic cybersecurity initiatives that strengthen the organization's security posture, reduce risk, improve compliance, and enable business objectives. Each project manager role will be anchored to projects within a key cybersecurity domain or, in some cases, to initiatives requiring partnership across multiple cybersecurity domains, such as Identity Security, Threat Management, Security Operations, Product Security, Governance, Risk & Compliance, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Emerging Technologies.

The Cybersecurity Project Manager serves as a trusted delivery leader who translates strategy into execution, aligns stakeholders around shared outcomes, manages risks and dependencies, and ensures initiatives are delivered predictably and transparently. This individual operates across technical and business teams, partnering with cybersecurity leaders, architects, engineers, product teams, vendors, and executives to drive successful outcomes.

Success in this role extends beyond delivering scope on time and within budget. The Cybersecurity Project Manager connects cybersecurity strategy to execution and ensures initiatives achieve their intended cybersecurity outcomes, such as risk reduction, control coverage, remediation, adoption, resilience, or capability maturity.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of cybersecurity initiatives from planning through implementation and operational transition.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, assumptions, decisions, and action items.

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory requirements such as NIST, CIS Controls, Zero Trust, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC, PCI, or related standards.

Job Title: Study Start-Up Coordinator– Remote

Job Location: UNAVAILABLE, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Our clinical operations activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking full-time, remote-based Regulatory Submissions Coordinator to join our Clinical Operations team. This position works both independently and collaboratively with a team to meet common goals and plays a key role in the study start-up process at Medpace. As a Regulatory Submissions Coordinator with Medpace Canada, you will gain exposure to diverse, challenging studies across all phases and multiple therapuetic areas. On a day-to-day basis, you will have the opportunity to use your study start-up expertise to guide and administer internal processes, as well as advise clients on Health Canada requirements. With our continued growth in Canada, we are looking for proactive, positive, and self-motivated individuals with a shared commitment to quality to join our supportive and dynamic team.


Responsibilities

  • Act as the point of contact with sites during the study start up process;
  • Prepare, review, and file clinical trial applications to Health Canada;
  • Ensure submissions comply with applicable regulations and guidance documents;
  • Advise study teams on changing regulations and compliance requirements;
  • Track and ensure timely filing of all essential start-up documents including Health Canada submissions.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in English (required) and French (preferred)
  • Ability to work in a remote setting;
  • Bachelor’s degree in a science or health-related field;
  • Experience working at a CRO is preferred;
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical research industry experience with HealthCanada and Ethics submissions;
  • Knowledge of ICH guidelines and applicable local regulations; and
  • Excellent written and oral skills.


Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports

Cincinnati Headquarters Experience

    • A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-Time - Lancaster, PA

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.

raw.excerpt: We are hiring in Moldova, and the job is decidingThis role is open to people in Moldova.
raw.description:
We are hiring in Moldova, and the job is deciding

This role is open to people in Moldova. Before you apply, read our website and look at our LinkedIn page for ten minutes. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Replies that could be about any firm will be filtered out.

What we are looking for

  1. Someone who makes the call and owns what follows, good outcome or bad.
  2. Someone who can tell which decisions are theirs and which belong to others, and never muddles the two.
  3. Someone who reads feedback as data and changes course, but does not fold when they have good grounds to stand.
  4. Someone who learns at speed. We would take a person at seventy percent and rising over a person stuck at eighty five.
  5. Someone who sees trouble early and reports it, including trouble caused by our own process.
  6. Someone who puts problems in writing, clearly and without spin.

The job in Moldova

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency, and we need one decision maker based in Moldova. Our AI image service is the fastest growing thing we offer. Whichever area falls to you, your work will help it grow.

You will take full ownership of a single area. It is not fixed today. The trial shows where you are strongest, and then we assign it. It will be either:

  1. The hiring machine. This covers how we find, screen and hire. You manage the funnel from first contact to offer: sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and flagging it when the process itself has broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. This covers how client work is planned, briefed, chased and shipped. You keep the dates, give the team a proper brief and make sure no task slips away quietly.

Seen from underneath, both are one job. Something has slipped, you decide the response, and you close it before anyone has to ask.

Be clear on what this is not. It is not assistant work and it is not coordination. You will make real decisions daily, and we will judge you by their quality, not by your throughput. If you need someone to tell you what to do each morning, it will not suit you.

How we handle your experience

We ask for no set number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

For each job you list we confirm the employer, dates, title and paid status, with a contract and payslips, in one exchange. At some point in the last 12 months you need to have worked full time. After that there is no minimum, and a thin history costs you nothing. If you misrepresent the history you do have, you are out. If you tell it straight, nothing is held against you.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

We settle the decision during the trial, and that includes which of the two areas becomes yours. You start making calls on live work in week one, and we say honestly how each landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

      1. Full time once hired, and no other job alongside. While you are on the paid trial you give us 4 hours daily, with 2 of those at a set time inside our working day, and your current job can continue. On a pass you resign and join us full time inside 30 days.
      2. Internet that is dependable: 30 Mbps down at least, 5 Mbps up at least, checked live with us.
      3. Written English that is strong.
      4. Based in Moldova.
      5. You record your hours in our time tracking tool from the first day.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Pay and responsibility climb quickly for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that touch a client moves more slowly and with care, and it is earned through a record of results, not a strong first month. We would sooner say so now than have you learn it in your second month.

Club Capital LLC is a rapidly growing business management services firm, providing: accounting, tax, advisory and digital marketing solutions to clients across the country. We provide a cloud-based financial infrastructure to our clients including tax services, payroll, bookkeeping, industry analytics, and bench-marking services. Our success is fueled by empowering our clients to achieve their full potential as small business owners and entrepreneurs.

Club Capital is dedicated to empowering our employees to achieve their utmost potential and drive growth professionally and personally. We achieve this by fostering an environment that thrives on honesty, integrity, transparency, curiosity, and humility! We are a remote first organization to foster work/life balance.

Position Overview

As a Senior Client Advisor you should be passionate about providing small business owners with the best customer experience they have ever seen. Client Advisors at Club Capital should possess an entrepreneurial mindset to manage a portfolio of business advisory clients. You will become a trusted advisor in many areas of the clients day to day operations; from reviewing monthly financial statements and working with them to review their business’ financial statements, establish targets, set goals to help them grow, and offer controller and CFO advisory services. Client Advisors serve as a primary point of contact for the clients within their portfolio and are expected to be able to understand accounting, business financials, while working closely with internal teams to support and perform additional duties for our more complex clients.

A Senior Client Advisor at Club Capital, will create a business advisory relationship with their clients through email, chat, and Zoom calls on a regular basis. A true partnership between the client and serving as subject matter expert in accounting and finances to ensure client success. Client Advisors will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing the monthly accounting for your client portfolio, facilitating their monthly financial reporting, and supporting in other key service areas.

Duties / Responsibilities

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and first point of contact for clients; becoming a trusted advisor for all portfolio services by reviewing monthly financials, bookkeeping records, EOY financials, and conducting review and growth calls
  • Prepare financial statements to facilitate the clients decision making process
  • Manage the bookkeeping team assigned to your client portfolio and oversee processes for month end close
  • Prepare budgets and revenue targets with clients
  • Conduct quarterly and ad hoc Growth Sessions with clients to review financial performance, create and adjust budgets, and identify industry trends
  • Lead and/or mentor other Client Advisors
  • Address payroll questions/concerns and provide first-level troubleshooting
  • Delight customers with expert guidance and support
  • Manage personal workload to deliver high quality work products on time
  • Effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders and management on established performance expectations
  • Work across teams to keep others informed of client status (i.e. Tax, client experience)
  • The desire to grow and expand your client portfolio and advisory services, willingness to become CFO certified.

Requirements / Qualifications

  • 4 + years of accounting experience; bookkeeping, public accounting, or small business accounting (Required)
  • B.S or M.S in Accounting or Business or equivalent experience
  • 3 + of related experience in a client facing role
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, tasks, and projects simultaneously
  • Solutions driven individual who is exceptional at deadlines and problem solving
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to provide exceptional client service along developing lasting client relationships

We offer a competitive total rewards package to include: Fully remote, competitive compensation package, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company match, PTO, paid holidays,

The pay range for this role is:

80,000 - 90,000 USD per year (United States)

Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior Reporting and Analytics Specialist to design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise reporting, dashboards, and analytical capabilities supporting the Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA). The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining reports required to support contractual performance requirements, healthcare contact center operations, workforce management, quality assurance, and program leadership.


The reporting environment will leverage Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Health Cloud, Amazon Connect, and other approved business intelligence and data visualization tools to provide accurate, reliable, and actionable operational insights. This position will work closely with developers, system administrators, workforce management analysts, contact center operations personnel, and program stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into effective analytical solutions.


Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Security Clearance.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise reports, interactive dashboards, analytical datasets, and business intelligence solutions using Salesforce CRM Analytics and other approved reporting tools.
  • Translate contractual reporting requirements, performance work statements (PWS), service-level agreements (SLAs), and operational needs into reporting specifications and standardized performance metrics.
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce CRM Analytics datasets, recipes, dataflows, calculated fields, and dashboard visualizations.
  • Create Salesforce reports and dashboards supporting patient engagement, care coordination, case management, referral management, appointment scheduling, and contact center operations.
  • Develop reporting capabilities using Amazon Connect operational data, including contact volumes, queue performance, average handle time, average speed of answer, abandonment rates, service levels, and agent productivity.
  • Integrate and analyze data from Salesforce Health Cloud, Amazon Connect, and other authorized enterprise data sources to support consolidated operational and contractual reporting.
  • Develop dashboards supporting workforce forecasting, staffing analysis, schedule adherence, agent occupancy, and operational performance monitoring.
  • Create and maintain recurring daily, weekly, monthly, and ad hoc contractual and management reports.
  • Establish standardized metric definitions, reporting calculations, data validation procedures, and documentation to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
  • Develop and maintain analytical data models, data transformations, automated refresh processes, and reporting integrations.
  • Troubleshoot reporting discrepancies, data quality issues, dataset refresh failures, and dashboard performance problems.
  • Perform testing and validation of reports, dashboards, and analytical enhancements before production deployment.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce developers, Amazon Connect developers, and system administrators to resolve data integration and reporting issues.
  • Maintain reporting documentation, data mappings, calculation methodologies, and reporting requirements traceability.
  • Ensure reporting solutions comply with applicable DoD/DHA cybersecurity, privacy, data access, and information protection requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and improve reporting efficiency, accuracy, and operational visibility.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline and 4–8 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 2–6 years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in accordance with Leidos policies.
  • At least 3 years of experience developing enterprise reports, dashboards, analytical datasets, or business intelligence solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Experience developing Salesforce reports, dashboards, custom report types, and analytical data models.
  • Experience translating business and operational requirements into reporting specifications and analytical solutions.
  • Experience integrating, transforming, and analyzing data from multiple enterprise application systems.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data validation, reporting calculations, and performance metrics.
  • Experience using SQL, Salesforce query tools, or comparable data retrieval and analysis technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting reporting discrepancies, data quality issues, and analytical processing problems.
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle processes, testing, and change management.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex reporting assignments and collaborate effectively with technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Ability to meet applicable DoD/DHA personnel security and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant certification or equivalent demonstrated CRM Analytics experience.
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator or Salesforce Platform App Builder certification.
  • Advanced experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics datasets, recipes, dataflows, dashboards, and Salesforce Analytics Query Language (SAQL).
  • Experience developing reports and dashboards for Salesforce Health Cloud or Service Cloud.
  • Experience developing contact center reporting solutions using Amazon Connect data.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Connect Contact Lens, contact center metrics, and operational analytics.
  • Experience with Amazon QuickSight, Amazon Athena, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, or comparable cloud-based analytics services.
  • Experience with Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, or other enterprise business intelligence tools.
  • Experience developing government contractual performance reports and service-level agreement reporting.
  • Experience supporting large-scale healthcare contact centers or enterprise customer service operations.
  • Familiarity with workforce management reporting, staffing analytics, forecasting, and contact center performance measures.
  • Experience developing automated reporting processes, scheduled data refreshes, and analytical data pipelines.
  • Experience supporting DoD, DHA, VA, or other federal healthcare programs.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, FedRAMP, DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), and cybersecurity requirements associated with regulated government healthcare environments.
  • Familiarity with healthcare workflows, including patient engagement, care coordination, referral management, appointment scheduling, and contact center operations.

A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com 2.800 consultores e especialistas em 28 países, construído sobre uma convicção: a IA não transforma empresas. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.

Na Keyrus, você não desenvolverá apenas habilidades; desenvolverá discernimento. Sua expertise se fortalece a cada sistema que você projeta, a cada desafio de negócio que ajuda a resolver e a cada implementação que evolui a partir dos aprendizados anteriores.

Com o tempo, você se tornará um dos profissionais mais raros da era da inteligência: alguém capaz de conectar dados, IA e tomada de decisão humana em escala, entre diferentessetores, mercados e geografias.
Esta não é apenas uma posição. É uma disciplina que você domina e uma história que ajuda a escrever para se tornar um Arquiteto da Inteligência da Keyrus.

A tecnologia amplia capacidades. A cultura da Keyrus diferencia. A excelência na execução conecta ambas.

O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ ARQUITETAR

Esta posição combina visão arquitetural, profundidade técnica e atuação consultiva. Buscamos profissionais capazes de transformar desafios complexos em soluções de dados escaláveis, modernas e orientadas a resultados.

O QUE FARÁ VOCÊ TER SUCESSO

Facilidade para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções práticas e escaláveis.

raw.description:
Founded in 2017, Lovelytics helps some of the most complex enterprises across Energy & Utilities, Media & Entertainment, Manufacturing, Retail & CPG, Healthcare and Financial Services modernize their data and put AI to work, not in a deck, but in production. We move fast, stay close to the cutting edge, and care more about outcomes than optics.

Our work spans the full data and AI lifecycle: Data Strategy & Advisory, Data Engineering, Analytics & Visualization, Generative AI & ML, and Cloud Migration & Modernization. All of it is delivered primarily on Databricks, with deep partnerships across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

In September 2026, Lovelytics became a CDW company. CDW completed its acquisition on September 25, 2026, bringing our team into its Data & Analytics Practice. Together, we can take customers from data strategy to production AI with a single partner across the full technology lifecycle.

Lovelytics now has 600+ people across the United States, Canada, Argentina, and Colombia, all working exclusively in data and AI. We’ve kept the technically excellent, low-ego culture that earned us a Best Places to Work recognition, a spot among Databricks’ top partners, and three appearances on the Inc. 5000.

Lovelytics is seeking a Generative AI Architect with hands-on experience delivering client-facing projects in the Generative AI domain, particularly on the Databricks platform. As part of our growing AI & GenAI practice, this role offers an exciting opportunity to design and deploy state-of-the-art solutions that combine language models, vector databases, and cutting-edge orchestration frameworks.

We’re looking for a GenAI Architect who's already taken GenAI from concept to production on Databricks. Joining our GenAI practice means you’ll architect, design, and deploy solutions that work in the real world: RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration, vector search, AI agents and the architecture decisions that make all of it scale. This isn't a research role, it's for practitioners who've worked with clients, understood their problem, and built something to solve it. If you're energized by the pace of this space and want to work alongside people who take data and AI seriously, we'd love to talk.

Note: This position is not eligible for work sponsorship at this time.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end architecture and technical strategy for complex GenAI and Agentic AI solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, from discovery through production.
  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to client stakeholders, translating business problems into scalable AI architectures and implementation roadmaps.
  • Design solutions across Agentic AI, Compound AI, LLMs, evaluation, optimization, governance, observability, and production AI engineering using relevant Databricks capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple project teams, ensuring architectural quality, engineering standards, security, scalability, Unity Catalog governance, and production readiness.
  • Guide and mentor Senior, Lead and Principal GenAI engineers and consultants, strengthening both GenAI and Databricks technical capabilities across the practice.
  • Lead technical discovery, estimation, architecture, proposals, demos, and pre-sales activities for strategic Databricks GenAI opportunities.
  • Develop reusable Databricks reference architectures, accelerators, patterns, and best practices for enterprise GenAI and Agentic AI implementations.
  • Stay current on emerging Databricks AI capabilities and broader GenAI technologies, translating them into practical client solutions.
  • Build strong client relationships, identify expansion opportunities, and help grow large, durable Databricks AI accounts.
  • Contribute to Databricks and GenAI thought leadership through workshops, blogs, conference sessions, demos, and internal enablement.

Our Ideal Candidate's Skills and Experiences:

  • B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent technical field.
  • 10+ years of technology experience, including significant experience in data, ML, AI, or cloud architecture.
  • 2-3 years of meaningful hands-on GenAI/LLM experience preferred, with demonstrated production implementations.
  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect, AI Architect, Lead Engineer, or equivalent technical leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex client engagements and multiple technical workstreams.
  • Prior consulting or professional services experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience mentoring and technically leading teams required. Formal people-management experience is valuable but not required
  • Deep hands-on experience designing and delivering production GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, agent orchestration, tool use, Compound AI systems, evaluation, prompt optimization, and LLMOps.
  • Strong Databricks experience, including Mosaic AI capabilities, Model Serving, MLflow, Unity Catalog, Databricks Apps, Vector Search, and Lakehouse architecture.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, governed enterprise AI architectures integrating structured and unstructured data.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, testing, and production deployment patterns.
  • Experience with model evaluation, observability, guardrails, performance optimization, and cost management.
  • Working knowledge of classical ML and how GenAI, ML, data engineering, and analytics fit into broader AI solutions.
  • Strong client-facing consulting and executive communication skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experiences:

  • Advanced Databricks certifications and strong familiarity with the broader Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  • Experience with DSPy, GEPA, automated prompt optimization, fine-tuning, synthetic data generation, and advanced evaluation techniques.
  • Experience building multi-agent systems, MCP-based integrations, tool-calling architectures, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Familiarity with multiple foundation model providers and model-selection strategies across proprietary and open-source models.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, particularly enterprise security, networking, and identity integration.
  • Experience with traditional ML, MLOps, feature engineering, and predictive modeling in addition to GenAI.
  • Familiarity with industry-specific AI patterns in Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Energy, Retail, Telecom, or other enterprise sectors.
  • Experience managing or mentoring senior technical resources such as Principals, Leads, and Engineers.
  • Experience participating in pre-sales, RFPs, proposals, solution estimation, and executive presentations.
  • Previous experience building or scaling an AI/GenAI practice, Center of Excellence, or technical community.

What We Promise You:

  • Meaningful, cutting-edge projects in Generative AI with clients across industries—from Fortune 100 firms to disruptive startups.
  • Rapid learning and mentorship opportunities with AI/GenAI thought leaders and practitioners.
  • A culture of experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Opportunity to be a conference speaker, blogger, writer.
  • A diverse, inclusive team and one of the best GenAI teams, where your voice, ideas contributions are highly valued.

The base salary range for this position for candidates based in the US is $160,000-210,000 per year. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, scope of role and budget. Employees in Ontario, CA are paid using Canada market data in CAD. Candidates are not guaranteed to be placed at any particular point within the range, and most offers will fall within the middle of the range or below. Lovelytics is committed to pay equity and transparency in compensation practices.

Lovelytics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This means you don’t have to worry about whether your application process will be fair. We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or disability.

raw.description:
Title: Marketing Asset Manager
Location: Remote (eastern or central US time zone-based)

Position Summary:
MOCA is seeking a Marketing Asset Manager to improve how prospective and current customers find information, understand our software and services, and take the next step across our corporate, Touchplan, and MOCA Services websites. This hands-on role combines website design, WordPress and Elementor expertise, and making data-informed improvements to the customer journey.

You will turn business goals and audience needs into clear navigation, effective page layouts, and useful content experiences. Working with marketing colleagues and external developers, you will own day-to-day website execution and maintain a prioritized plan for improving usability and conversion performance. You will also manage and maintain our marketing and brand assets, ensuring materials remain current, organized, and consistent with approved branding and messaging. While this is a remote position, the company is seeking applicant located in either the eastern or central time zone of the United States.

Essential Functions:

Customer Journey and Website Design

  • Map key visitor journeys, from initial discovery through evaluation, inquiry, and access to customer resources. Identify confusing navigation, missing information, and barriers to taking action.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to site structure, navigation, page hierarchy, internal links, and calls to action based on audience needs and business priorities.
  • Design and build pages and landing pages in WordPress using Elementor. Apply strong visual judgment to typography, spacing, imagery, and content hierarchy across desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
  • Create reusable page templates and components that support consistent branding and efficient updates across the websites.

Website Performance and Conversion

  • Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity/heatmap tools, user feedback, and behavior analysis tools to identify where visitors struggle and prioritize improvements.
  • Improve inquiry and demo request journeys, including forms and confirmation experiences. Coordinate with marketing operations to verify tracking, CRM connections, and lead routing.
  • Develop testable recommendations for page layouts, messaging, and calls to action. Use A/B testing where traffic supports meaningful results and usability testing to inform other changes.
  • Report on website performance with clear recommendations, tracking priority actions and qualified inquiries alongside traffic and engagement.
WordPress Management and Website Quality
  • Manage routine WordPress content updates and publishing, including page edits, announcements, and job postings. Coordinate hosting, plugin and theme updates, backups, and troubleshooting with hosting and development providers.
  • Test pages, navigation, links, and forms across browsers and devices. Apply accessibility practices for headings, contrast, alternative text, keyboard access, and form labels, and coordinate remediation with developers.
  • Monitor page speed and site health, optimize images and page assets, and collaborate regularly with developers to identify, prioritize, and resolve performance and technical issues.

Search Visibility and Content

  • Apply on-page SEO practices, including descriptive page titles, meta descriptions, logical headings, and internal links. Monitor indexing and crawl issues and coordinate technical fixes with developers as needed.
  • Work with content and marketing colleagues to organize and adapt product, service, industry, and customer content for website visitors. Keep claims, statistics, client logos, and resource links current.

Digital Asset Management and Brand Support

  • Maintain website design standards and document reusable templates and publishing practices. Apply approved brand guidelines consistently across digital content.
  • Support the organization and upkeep of marketing assets, ensuring teams can find current, approved versions.
  • Package emails and newsletters using approved copy and assets. Build and format email layouts, apply brand standards, and test mobile display, links, and calls to action. Coordinate with marketing operations on audience targeting and sending.

Qualifications/Experience - Required:
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, web design, graphic design, digital media, communications, or a related field preferred.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in website management, digital design, or digital marketing, with direct responsibility for improving business websites.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building and maintaining WordPress websites with Elementor, including responsive layouts, reusable templates, and routine troubleshooting.
  • A portfolio showing strong web design judgment and examples of customer journey, usability, or conversion improvements.
  • Practical understanding of user experience, website navigation, accessibility, on-page SEO, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Experience interpreting Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console data and using findings to recommend website changes.
  • Strong editing, quality assurance, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing requests and collaborate with marketing, sales, and development teams.
  • Strong attention to detail, practical problem-solving abilities, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Qualifications/Experience - Preferred:
Experience with B2B software, professional services, and/or the AEC industry; Elementor; basic HTML and CSS; Pardot/MCAE, Figma or Adobe design tools; behavior analysis or usability testing tools; and marketing automation or CRM integrations. Familiarity with Flywheel hosting and SEO tools such as Yoast or Semrush is helpful.

Job Description

The Director, HR Business Partner serves as the senior HR advisor to the Regional Vice President and regional leadership team, translating business priorities into an actionable people strategy across 600+ stores. As a member of the regional leadership team, this role uses workforce insights and business acumen to strengthen leadership capability, build talent pipelines, improve organizational effectiveness, and support regional performance.

The Director leads a team of HR Business Partners and is accountable for consistent, high-quality HR partnership across the region. Working across HR Centers of Excellence, Employee Relations, and Legal, this role anticipates workforce needs and risks, delivers integrated talent solutions, and leads organizational change aligned with regional and enterprise priorities.


What will you do?

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Partner across HR Centers of Excellence to integrate talent acquisition, organizational development, compensation, benefits, and employee relations solutions into a cohesive regional people strategy.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of field operations through regular store and market visits, using firsthand insights to shape regional people strategies and enterprise HR decisions or program design
  • Use workforce data (case trends, turnover, staffing, engagement, labor spend) to diagnose region-level issues, influence decisions, and develop proactive plans that strengthen leadership practices and team member experience
  • Partner with Employee Relations and Legal to identify and proactively address workforce risks, recurring employee relations trends, and compliance concerns across the region
  • Ensure leaders consistently apply company policies, performance expectations, and talent practices while balancing business needs, team member experience, and organizational risk

Talent, Organization & Culture

  • Own regional talent and succession planning, identifying critical roles, talent risks, bench gaps, and development actions that strengthen leadership capability and internal mobility.
  • Partner with Organizational Development and Training to build targeted development strategies that address regional capability needs.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to establish workforce and staffing priorities, leadership selection standards, and talent-pipeline strategies.
  • Lead organizational design and change initiatives that align structure, roles, talent, and labor models with current and future business needs.
  • Own the regional engagement and retention strategy, using employee feedback and workforce insights to address the underlying drivers of turnover and performance.
  • Champion an inclusive, high-accountability culture and consistent team member experience across all districts.

Team Leadership & Execution

  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of HR Business Partners, establishing clear priorities, consistent service expectations, and measurable outcomes aligned with regional business needs
  • Build HRBP capability through ongoing coaching, talent development, succession planning, and differentiated performance management
  • Create an effective operating rhythm across the regional HRBP team to identify emerging workforce trends, align priorities, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution across districts
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-impact people matters, coordinating the appropriate Employee Relations, Legal, and HR Center of Excellence partners

Qualifications:

  • Proven multi-unit, geographically dispersed retail, restaurant or field-based HR experience
  • Demonstrated success partnering with and influencing senior executives to improve business outcomes
  • Strong analytics capability; comfortable building a people plan with data
  • Demonstrated ability to apply critical and strategic thinking to complex business and workforce matters, make sound decisions amid ambiguity, and translate insights into practical, measurable actions.
  • High degree of business and financial acumen
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, as well as champion change
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and conflict management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Workday
  • Ability to travel as necessary

Certifications, Experience, and Education:

  • Certifications: PHR or SPHR preferred, not required
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience preferably in a business partner capacity including at least 3 years in a leadership role; and
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications or related field; or equivalent combination of education and/or experience

Location & Work Availability:

This position is a Remote based role, up to 50% travel required for market visits and leadership team engagement. Overnight travel may be required. This role will cover territories in West Virginia, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia and Kentucky.

raw.description:
We're looking for a Visual Designer to own visual design across brand, marketing, and digital channels for a fast-growing company. You will design ad creative, social content, landing page assets, presentations, and brand collateral, and turn briefs into polished work that looks sharp and serves a business goal.

This is a hands-on role. You will be in the design tools every day, working across formats and projects at the same time, with real ownership over quality and consistency. We are not looking for someone who only executes templates. We want a designer with a genuine creative eye who can take a rough brief, form a point of view, and deliver work that is distinctive and on brand. If you are fast, organized, and take pride in craft, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work inside a fast-growing company where design directly supports growth and brand
  • High-ownership design role with real variety across formats, channels, and projects

What You'll Work On

Marketing and Digital Design

  • Design static ad creative, social media graphics, email graphics, and landing page assets for paid and organic channels
  • Work from briefs, performance feedback, and brand guidelines to produce assets built to perform
  • Resize and adapt creative across formats and placements accurately and efficiently
  • Iterate on designs quickly based on testing results and stakeholder feedback

Brand and Collateral

  • Design presentations, one-pagers, reports, and other brand collateral for internal and external use
  • Maintain visual consistency across all touchpoints and help evolve brand guidelines as the company grows
  • Contribute creative ideas and visual concepts at the brief stage, not only at execution

Production and Asset Management

  • Prepare finished files in the correct formats and specifications for each use case
  • Organize design files and assets with clean structure, naming conventions, and version control
  • Keep project status current and communicate early if a timeline is at risk
  • Use AI-assisted design tools where they improve speed without lowering quality

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Proven design experience with a portfolio showing finished work across multiple formats such as ad creative, social content, brand assets, and presentations
  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, and visual hierarchy, with an eye for what makes design effective in a marketing context
  • Ability to work within an established brand system while bringing independent creative judgment to each project
  • Fast and organized with the ability to manage multiple projects at once and deliver on time
  • Clear communicator who flags issues early and incorporates feedback without friction
  • Available to work full-time during US business hours

Nice to Have

  • Basic motion design or animation skills for social and ad creative
  • Experience designing for paid social platforms such as Meta, TikTok, or LinkedIn
  • Background in a marketing agency, startup, or in-house brand team
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design and image generation tools
  • Experience with web design or landing page layout in tools such as Webflow or Framer

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link showing at least 4 to 6 finished design examples across different formats
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, walking through one piece of work you are most proud of, and explaining the design decisions you made and why

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a versatile designer with a strong creative eye who moves fast without cutting corners, this role gives you the variety and the direct impact to do your best work.

Benefits

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.
