raw.description:
A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Senior Engineer – Automation, you'll play a key role in developing innovative automation solutions that improve engineering efficiency, accuracy, and productivity across utility-scale renewable energy projects. You'll independently design, develop, and maintain engineering tools, custom software, scripts, data pipelines, and AI-enabled workflows that streamline design, estimating, and project engineering processes.

A typical day may involve collaborating with civil, structural, geotechnical, electrical, and electrical studies teams to identify opportunities for automation, solve complex technical challenges, and develop tools that simplify engineering workflows. You'll lead automation initiatives from concept through deployment, working closely with cross-functional teams to integrate new technologies, improve data accuracy, reduce manual processes, and enhance engineering quality.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Independently automates existing engineering workflows to support project design, estimating, and project execution, increasing the quality of engineering designs and proposals.
  • Develops and maintains assigned tools and applications end-to-end, following the team’s development standards, version control (e.g., Git), and code-review practices.
  • Partners with disciplined engineers to translate engineering, estimating, and proposal needs into well-scoped technical requirements and sound solution designs; builds tools for new design processes.
  • Interfaces with data pipelines, APIs, databases, and system integrations that move project, design, quantity, and cost data reliably between engineering, estimating, and business systems.
  • Implements AI and machine learning capabilities, including large language model (LLM) workflows, document review, and data extraction that increase efficiency.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience is required, including two (2) years of code-writing experience.
  • Must have a valid Driver’s License.
  • Minimal travel required.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Experience in mentoring or providing technical guidance to junior engineers or developers is preferred.
  • Experience automating engineering, design, or estimating workflows is preferred.
  • Previous engineering or construction-related experience in a related industry (e.g., heavy civil, industrial, utilities, power generation) is preferred; renewables-focused experience is a plus.
  • Experience developing engineering automation tools, custom software, scripts, and data-driven solutions that improve efficiency and accuracy.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, C#, or similar languages, with experience integrating engineering software and automating technical workflows.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay
  • 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees
  • 401(k) with company match
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)
  • Work/Life balance
  • Employee/Family focused culture
  • Gym on site
  • And more!

Blattner is not able to sponsor H-1B visas or permanent residency for this or any position. We are able to consider candidates who hold valid, independent work authorization (e.g., U.S. citizenship, permanent residency, or other valid, non-expired work authorization).


#LI - Remote

$100,561.00 - $145,814.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity.

WHO ARE WE?


With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. Blattner Company is the parent company of Blattner Energy and D.H. Blattner & Sons, of which all are members of the Quanta Services family of companies. Company headquarters are in Avon, Minnesota.

Additionally, Blattner is committed, in accordance with applicable law, to making reasonable accommodations for job applicants and employees based on a qualifying disability, a sincerely held religious belief or practice, and for pregnancy, childbirth or related health conditions. Applicants and employees who feel they have experienced or witnessed discrimination or who wishes to request a reasonable accommodation should contact the Human Resources Department. Ciklum is looking for a Technical Solution Architect to join our team full-time in Romania.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Technical Solution Architect, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Our client is a leading global payments platform that connects businesses and consumers across 260 payment types in over 40 countries. With over 20 years of experience and an annual transaction volume exceeding $150 billion, it is a powerhouse in digital wallets, eCash solutions, and merchant acquiring.

In 2026, our client is undergoing a massive AI transformation. You will be joining the Intelligent Automation & AI Engineering initiative with the goal of replacing manual decision-making workflows with reliable, auditable AI-assisted systems.

You will work in an automation COE, collaborating with a centralised AI Platform team, IT, Dev Ops etc.

Responsibilities:

  • Design end-to-end AI-powered solutions, defining architecture, technology choices, integrations, and deployment approaches
  • Build prototypes, AI agents, automations, and production-ready solutions using modern AI technologies
  • Design and improve AI-assisted development workflows, develop reusable agent skills, engineering standards, and automation frameworks
  • Design, deploy, and optimize Azure infrastructure for AI applications, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Transform business ideas into working prototypes, validate assumptions, and iterate quickly based on feedback
  • Connect AI solutions with enterprise platforms, internal APIs, databases, and business systems
  • Own technical decisions and proactively identify challenges, driving solutions from concept through delivery
  • Work directly with business stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions
  • Establish reusable architecture patterns, security guardrails, and engineering best practices
  • Research emerging AI technologies, evaluate new tools, and identify opportunities to accelerate engineering and business processes
  • Mentor engineers, document reusable solutions, and help teams adopt AI-assisted development practices
  • Take responsibility for technical outcomes, troubleshoot blockers, and proactively coordinate across teams to ensure delivery

Requirements:

  • Strong experience designing end-to-end enterprise solutions, including integrations, APIs, authentication, data flows, and cloud infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID, networking, and identity management
  • Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, tool calling, RAG, and multi-step workflows
  • Strong experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude Code, including agent instructions, skills, and automated development workflows
  • Strong development background in at least one programming language: Python, C#, or TypeScript, and experience building production-ready applications
  • Experience connecting enterprise systems using REST APIs, MCP, webhooks, and workflow automation
  • Ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into working prototypes quickly, validate assumptions, and iterate based on feedback
  • Understanding of enterprise security, RBAC, managed identities, secrets management, and secure AI solution design
  • Ability to independently drive technical initiatives from discovery through implementation and deployment
  • Strong English communication skills, comfortable working directly with business stakeholders and explaining technical decisions
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Graph API
  • Familiarity with Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar agent orchestration frameworks
  • Experience designing reusable AI agent skills, custom instructions, MCP servers, and agentic SDLC workflows
  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, and automated cloud provisioning
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Docker, and automated deployment pipelines
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, and other enterprise platforms
  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt optimization, tracing, monitoring, and cost management
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as financial services, with security, compliance, and governance constraints
  • Experience mentoring engineers, creating reusable engineering standards, and enabling teams to adopt new technologies
  • Experience exploring emerging AI technologies, running technical experiments, and turning successful prototypes into reusable solutions
  • Highly proactive and initiative-driven, takes initiative, challenges existing approaches, and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, thrives in a fast-paced R&D environment with evolving requirements and uncertainty
  • Strong builder mentality, prefers experimenting, prototyping, and validating ideas rather than spending excessive time on theoretical discussions
  • Passionate about AI, actively explores emerging AI tools and technologies and applies them in real-world scenarios
  • Independent and accountable, makes technical decisions and takes ownership without requiring constant guidance
  • Scalability-oriented, thinks beyond individual tasks and focuses on creating scalable, reusable solutions that benefit multiple teams
  • Pragmatic engineering mindset, balances speed of delivery with engineering quality, security, and maintainability
  • Collaborative, enjoys working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
  • Care: Medical subscription to Regina Maria, meal tickets of 40 ron net/day worked

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

In Romania, we welcome top-tier tech talent — whether from our Bucharest office or fully remotely. Tap into deep industry knowledge, grow your career, and make an impact in an empowering environment.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

$109,750.00 - $186,500.00

About Us

We’re Dayshape—an award-winning software scale-up with big ambitions and the momentum to match. Trusted by Big Four and many other top professional services firms globally, our AI-powered resource management platform is helping organisations to achieve extraordinary results. 

Our platform stands apart as the only solution that combines advanced AI, real-time project financials, and firm-wide insights to elevate resource management to a strategic function. By driving profitable growth, powering confident decisions, and ensuring satisfied clients and teams—we're helping our customers build strong organisations and careers for the long term.

Why our customers love Dayshape:

  • We help professional firms optimise margins and increase revenue, unlocking access to more profitable work. 
  • We provide complete operational visibility today and the tools to confidently predict tomorrow. 
  • We empower firms to become the places where top talent wants to work - and the best clients want to work with.

Recognised as Scotland’s fastest-growing tech company in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 for three consecutive years and more recently as the Enterprise Digital Tech Business of the Year at the 2024 ScotlandIS awards, we’ve consistently proven our ability to innovate and deliver real impact—and we’re always looking for like-minded people to join us.

At Dayshape, our purpose is to improve people's working lives, and our culture is an important driving force in helping us to do just that. We're a friendly, inclusive, and ambitious team—driven by our values and a shared commitment to success. If you’re ready to join a fast-growing, high-impact company that’s reimagining resource management, then let’s talk.

About the role

We've come a long way in a short time, but there's still so much more we can do. We have grand ambitions to make Dayshape the most scalable, flexible and rapid to deploy solution on the market, and we’re not there yet. That’s where you come in.

As part of our Engineering team, your key areas of focus will be enhancing product scalability and usability, helping consistently deliver features that support our customers' success. As a senior engineer, you will work collaboratively with the rest of our cross-functional team to plan and deliver new features and enhancements. You will take ownership of features and technical initiatives and make sure they are successful, while keeping an eye on UX, accessibility and aesthetics.

What you’ll do

  • Support our product and engineering managers in prioritisation, scoping and leading delivery of product features
  • Write complex, performant frontend business logic in JavaScript
  • Write and upgrade UI components using JavaScript and Vue.js
  • Write automated tests to assure quality (unit and end-to-end testing)
  • Support, mentor and coach other members of the team
  • Work with the rest of our engineering team to enhance scalability, performance and maintainability
  • Support our culture of learning, development and teamwork
  • Be involved in the entire life-cycle of features, including idea creation, deployment, and longer term updates and enhancements

About you

  • A confident and highly experienced senior JavaScript developer, writing both vanilla JS and modern frameworks (Vue.js in particular)
  • Experienced working in Agile teams as part of a product development environment
  • Comfortable writing unit tests and end-to-end automated tests
  • Able to zero-in on bugs without looking at the code, based on your experience and intuition
  • Passionate about shipping a product you can be proud of
  • Comfortable challenging and raising issues at any level
  • Well-informed on good software development principles, and able to implement them pragmatically
  • Knowledgeable about a range of technologies, and quick to learn others
  • An excellent and kind communicator, able to raise awkward questions kindly, and to recognise when you need help
  • Experienced in collaborating with others - you will be working closely with engineering, product and QA colleagues
  • Adaptable, and motivated to try/learn new things
  • Great at breaking down large tasks into manageable chunks
  • Able to see the Big Picture - how your decisions affect your colleagues and your users

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience working with complex web interfaces with large DOM views
  • Experience writing tests in Jest, Cypress or Playwright
  • Experience with the rest of our stack: C#, .Net (+Core), SQL Server, and/or Microsoft Azure
  • Experience working in (or with) the Professional Services industry

What you’ll get

  • Starting salary between £50,000 and £60,000, depending on experience
  • Earning potential in the Software Engineer salary band up to £63,650
  • At least £1,000 per year to spend on professional and personal development
  • 33 days' holiday per year (including bank holidays), increasing by 1 day each year to a maximum of 40 days
  • Paid four week sabbatical in your fifth anniversary year on top of your holiday entitlement
  • Enhanced family leave policies
  • Private medical insurance, including dental and vision benefits
  • Income protection and death in service cover
  • Matched 5% auto-enrolment workplace pension scheme
  • Access to wellbeing offerings, such as our Employee Assistance Programme and a dedicated counselling service
  • Volunteering time – up to 20 hours a year to participate in volunteer work
  • Regular All Hands meeting for inspiration and over-communication
  • Time out of the working week for team socials each month, with a mix of in-person and virtual options: past events include hiking, family BBQs, board games and at-home cocktail classes!
  • Genuinely nice, smart people to work with, who are excited about growing our company

Working Details

This is a full-time role (37.5 hours per week). We typically work from 09:00 - 17:30 from Monday to Friday, though we can be flexible around this, just let us know.

This role can be done fully remotely, as long as you are based in the UK. We have an office in Haymarket, Edinburgh, and you’re always welcome to join us there, but there are no required office days. Our team works closely together, so we collaborate day to day through regular video calls and team chat.

Join the team!

Equality of opportunity is more than just a responsibility: we believe it’s a huge advantage to welcome a variety of experiences and perspectives into the team. Diversity is a great asset and, as such, we strongly encourage applications from any background.

This is your opportunity to really influence how we get things done, and how our product develops to meet our customer’s needs. We're doing well, but there's lots more to do in order to maintain the high bar and pace that we've set.

If your experience isn't an exact match for this job description, but you have transferrable skills/experience that you think would be a great fit, please outline this in a cover letter. Everyone here is growing personally as the company grows, so if that sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’d love to see your application.

*Please note the successful candidate for this role will be subject to background checks and will have an opportunity to declare anything to us beforehand*

Overview

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Coding Compliance Manager, the Specialty Physician Coder plays a key role in reviewing and analyzing specialty coding and billing for charge processing. This role will be responsible for reviewing and accurately coding office, hospital, and surgical procedures for reimbursement and ensuring accurate and compliant medical coding for inpatient and outpatient services, diagnostic tests, and other medical services rendered to patients. The Specialty Physician Coder will also work with the Coding Compliance Manager on discovered coding trends and irregularities and needed action items.

  • Achievement of productivity standards as established by management.
  • Achievement of quality standards as established by management. In adherence with standard work, analyze and interpret medical information in the medical record and assign and sequence the correct ICD-10-CM, CPT, and/or HCPCS codes to the diagnoses/procedures of office, inpatient and/or outpatient medical records according to established coding guidelines, including the ability to review and natively code surgical operative/procedure reports.
  • In adherence with standard work, follow established workflow for working claim denials in the Follow-Up work queues and identify opportunities for billing/coding improvements. Participate in developing, implementing, and reviewing programs for coding compliance monitoring, criteria for benchmark comparisons, organizational policies and procedures, and physician clinical documentation improvement programs. Optimization opportunities include but are not limited to, working in the Follow-Up and Claim Edit work queues and analyzing denial trends.
  • In adherence with standard work, provide ongoing and frequent communication/education to MCMF providers to maximize coding compliance and reimbursement. Follow Coding Compliance department branding standards when communicating with clinical partners and fellow business center teams and work collaboratively with Physician Billing Services Insurance and Customer Service Representatives to solve billing and coding issues. Perform monthly coding change report analysis/oversight on provider coding change trends and communicate/educate the providers, as needed.
  • In adherence with standard work, work weekly Missing Charge Reports to identify missed billable charges to maximize reimbursement.
  • In adherence with standard work, organize, attend, and participate in specialty provider meetings. Prepare presentation materials for meetings, document meeting minutes, follow up on important action items/decisions from meetings, and report to the Coding Compliance Manager.
  • In adherence with standard work, take responsibility for various projects as assigned by management, and perform any additional/miscellaneous duties (not inclusive of job description) as requested by the management team within the scope of knowledge/ability.
  • “Other duties as assigned.”

Qualifications

  • 3 years’ experience working in a hospital or physician’s office as a medical coder and interacting with physicians.

  • 1-years’ experience as a specialty coder in one of the following specialties: Cardiology, Gastroenterology, Medical Hematology/Oncology, OBGYN, Pulmonology, or Radiation Oncology.

  • Expert knowledge of ICD10, CPT, and HCPCS.

  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy and physiology.

  • Epic software experience is highly desired.

  • Proficient Microsoft skills.

  • High School diploma or GED required.

  • CPC, CCS, or equivalent certification required.

  • Specialty coding certification is highly desired.

Pay Range

USD $40.00 - USD $40.00 /Hr.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

FP&A Manager

Olive & June

About the Role

Olive & June is seeking an FP&A Manager to support the company's financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis processes. This role is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional looking to grow their strategic finance skills within a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the FP&A Manager will help deliver financial insights that support decision-making across the business.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical and financial modeling skills, demonstrated experience in a startup or high-growth organization, and a desire to learn and develop as a finance leader. This individual should be comfortable working with large datasets, identifying business trends, and partnering with stakeholders to improve financial performance. Experience in consumer products, beauty, retail, or direct-to-consumer brands is required, with a strong understanding of the operational and financial drivers unique to these industries. The candidate must have direct experience managing and analyzing Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), with a strong understanding of gross margin drivers, inventory impacts, and operational cost structures.

This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys solving problems, building scalable processes, and contributing to the growth of an innovative and rapidly expanding business.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Assist with annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
  • Develop and maintain integrated financial models to support strategic planning and scenario analysis.
  • Monitor company performance against budget and forecast, identifying risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages for executive leadership.

Business Analysis & Decision Support

  • Partner closely with leaders across Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Product Development, Sales, and People teams.
  • Analyze business performance drivers, including revenue, gross margin, customer acquisition costs, inventory, and operating expenses.
  • Evaluate growth initiatives, product launches, retail partnerships, and pricing strategies through financial modeling and ROI analyses.
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to support key business decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners.

Operational Finance

  • Collaborate with Supply Chain and Operations teams to understand inventory, demand planning, purchasing, and margin trends.
  • Support forecasting and reporting for inventory, freight, manufacturing, and fulfillment costs.
  • Develop KPIs and dashboards that improve visibility into business performance.

Process Improvement

  • Help build scalable FP&A processes, reporting infrastructure, and financial systems to support continued growth.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve data accuracy and efficiency.
  • Establish best practices for financial planning and business performance management.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or related analytical roles.
  • Experience working at a startup, emerging growth company, or high-growth organization.
  • Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and business drivers.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets and financial systems expertise.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-making at all levels.

Preferred

  • Experience in beauty, consumer packaged goods (CPG), consumer retail, or direct-to-consumer brands.
  • Experience supporting inventory-intensive businesses.
  • Familiarity with ERPs and Planning Tools.
  • Experience supporting fundraising activities, board reporting, or strategic growth initiatives.

What Makes You Successful

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented, with strong business judgment.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.
  • Naturally curious and proactive in identifying insights and opportunities.
  • Excited to roll up your sleeves and build processes in a growing organization.
  • Collaborative, positive, and energized by partnering across teams.

raw.description:
At R3, we are building the on-ramp for the next trillion dollars of assets to move on-chain, bridging the worlds of traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi). We are launching institutional-grade RWA yield vaults, fully composable and integrated into Solana DeFi.

Our Corda Protocol is an institutional tokenized Real World Asset platform built on Solana. KYC'd investors deposit stablecoins into RWA vaults in exchange for vault tokens, and redeem the oracle-priced vault tokens back into stablecoins, with curators buying and selling the corresponding assets out in the Real World to settle those on-chain token transactions.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build and ship production RWA trading and lending infrastructure on Solana. You'll work across the stack, from on-chain programs to the front ends investors, traders and integrators use. You'll be working on systems that move real capital: liquidity venues, lending markets, and market-making infrastructure. This is a hands-on role for someone who has a genuine interest in bringing regulated finance on-chain and has already shipped DeFi protocols on Solana and understands the operational realities of running them under load.

As an early team member, you will play a crucial role in shaping the Corda Protocol. You should care as much about security, compliance, and auditability as you do about shipping quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Influence the design and development of the Corda Protocol RWA yield marketplace to scale it to multichain & multi-curator future
  • Build the full stack around these programs: indexers, keepers/crankers, APIs, and the React/TypeScript front ends that expose them to users and integrators.
  • Design and build Solana programs (Rust/Anchor) for vaults, lending markets, or related liquidity infrastructure.
  • Work directly on market-making and liquidity systems and the plumbing that keeps venues liquid and solvent.
  • Participate in code review, threat modelling, and internal/external audits of new and existing programs.
  • Design, implement, and optimize SDKs that will power our integration with centralized partners (exchanges, wallets, neobanks).

Required Skills/Experience

  • Prior experience at a crypto-native or web3 engineering team is a must; you will have worked at a lending protocol, yield marketplace, vaults infra or any similar marketplace that connected onchain allocators to the curated vaults.
  • Minimum of 6 years in software development and 2 years of experience in Rust with meaningful production time on Solana.
  • Proven experience shipping and deploying Solana programs in Rust (Anchor or native), ideally in one or more of: order book or AMM-style liquidity venues, lending/borrowing protocols, or market-making systems.
  • Full stack range: comfortable owning on-chain program logic and the off-chain services and front end (TypeScript/React, Node) that surround it.
  • Solid understanding of Solana's account model, PDAs, CPI, transaction/compute limits, and the tradeoffs involved in high-throughput on-chain systems.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience owning architecture & delivery.
  • MPC wallets/custody, Squads, on-chain monitoring, AML screening.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts & Kubernetes networking, Terraform, PostgreSQL.

• PKI and other cryptographic knowledge.

  • Experience supporting systems in production and investigating & diagnosing issues for internal or external customers.
  • Experience of Linux, shell scripting or other scripting languages, Linux command line tools, TCP/IP networking.

• Java / Kotlin.

Beware of recruitment scams: Your first interview is always with Rhea Beattie, our Global Talent Lead. Every interview after that is either a Microsoft Teams call booked through Teamtailor or Microsoft Bookings, or held in person at one of our offices (addresses at ). We'll never ask you to pay anything, share financial or crypto wallet details, or install software, so if something doesn't feel right, email before going any further. We do not use calendly for our interviews.

raw.description:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Karachi and across Pakistan.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.

This is NOT for you if

  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

raw.description:
募集背景

ThreeTraderでは、日本市場向けのマーケティングクリエイティブを担うシニアグラフィックデザイナーを募集しています。

求めているのは、優れたビジュアル表現力とAIを活用した高い制作効率を兼ね備えたデザイナーです。

複雑な金融・トレーディングの概念を、個人投資家にとって分かりやすく、魅力的で、思わず目を引くクリエイティブへと昇華できる方を歓迎します。

本ポジションは、デザインの企画から制作、改善までを主体的に担う実務中心のポジションです。

Growth、Marketing、Contentなどの各チームと連携しながら、日本市場に向けた広告・マーケティングクリエイティブを幅広く制作していただきます。

スピード感を持って制作・改善を繰り返し、ブランドの信頼性とマーケティング成果の両立を目指していただきます。

業務内容

1. デザイン制作・クリエイティブ開発

  • 日本市場向けのデジタルマーケティング素材の企画・制作（SNS広告、ディスプレイ広告、LP、メールテンプレート、アプリストア用クリエイティブなど）
  • 複雑な金融・トレーディングの情報を、個人投資家にとって分かりやすく、視覚的に魅力のあるデザインへと落とし込む
  • Adobe Firefly、Midjourney、RunwayなどのAIツールを活用し、制作効率とクリエイティブ品質を向上させる
  • デジタル広告やマーケティングキャンペーンにおけるビジュアルコンセプトの開発と実制作

2. ブランド管理・デザイン品質の維持

  • ThreeTraderのブランドガイドラインに基づいた一貫性のあるビジュアル表現の維持
  • デザインテンプレートやコンポーネントの作成・管理による制作効率の向上
  • 日本の金融サービスに関する広告・マーケティング規制を踏まえたクリエイティブの制作および品質管理

3. マーケティング成果の向上・ローカライゼーション

  • GrowthおよびPerformance Marketingチームと連携した広告クリエイティブの制作・改善
  • A/Bテストに向けた複数のクリエイティブバリエーションの制作
  • グローバルキャンペーン素材の日本市場向けローカライゼーション
  • 日本独自の文化、消費者心理、デザイン感覚を踏まえたビジュアル表現の最適化
  • 広告パフォーマンスデータを分析し、次のクリエイティブ制作・改善に活用

4. クロスファンクショナルな連携

  • Marketing、Product、CX、Contentなどの各チームと連携し、顧客体験全体におけるビジュアルの一貫性を確保
  • 複数のデザインプロジェクトを並行して管理し、スピード感のある環境で期限内に成果物を納品

Requirements

応募資格・必須スキル

デザイン経験・専門スキル

  • グラフィックデザインまたはデジタルデザインの実務経験5年以上
  • デジタルマーケティングや広告キャンペーンに関する実績を示すポートフォリオ
  • FinTech、金融サービス、その他サービス業または規制のある業界におけるデジタルデザイン経験
  • Adobe Creative Suite（Photoshop、Illustrator、After Effects）およびFigmaの実務スキル
  • Adobe Firefly、Midjourney、RunwayなどのAIデザインツールの活用経験
  • SNS広告、ディスプレイ広告、メール、LPなどのパフォーマンスマーケティング向けクリエイティブ制作経験
  • A/Bテストの基本的な理解と、データに基づいたデザイン改善能力

日本市場・言語スキル

  • 日本語ネイティブレベル、または日本語能力試験（JLPT）N1相当の日本語能力
  • 日本のビジュアル文化、デザインのトレンド、金融サービスにおける消費者の期待や表現に対する深い理解
  • 日本市場向けのクリエイティブ制作およびローカライゼーションに対応できる能力

求める人物像

  • 複数のプロジェクトや納期を効率的に管理できる方
  • デザインの細部にまでこだわり、高い品質基準を持っている方
  • MarketingやProductなど、デザイン以外のチームとも円滑にコミュニケーションできる方
  • 自律的に業務を進め、主体的に課題解決に取り組める方
  • 変化の速い環境に柔軟に対応し、スピードと品質の両立を追求できる方
  • 新しいデザイン手法やAIツールを積極的に取り入れ、継続的な改善を楽しめる方

歓迎スキル・経験

  • モーショングラフィックスやショート動画の制作経験
  • iOS / Google Play向けアプリストアクリエイティブの制作経験
  • スタートアップ企業やアジャイルなチーム環境での業務経験

ThreeTraderで働く魅力

  • 日本市場向けのマーケティングクリエイティブを主体的にリードできる
  • AIを活用した新しいデザイン制作手法に積極的に取り組める
  • Marketing、Growth、Productなど多様なチームと協働し、デザインの成果をマーケティングに直接反映できる
  • ブランドの成長と日本市場におけるクリエイティブの進化に貢献できる

応募について

ご応募の際は、これまでのデザイン実績やポートフォリオをご提出ください。

特に、デジタルマーケティング、広告クリエイティブ、金融サービス関連のデザイン経験をお持ちの方を歓迎します。

皆さまからのご応募をお待ちしております。

Job Title: Associate Manager / Manager, Project Services - Laboratories (Remote - West

Job Location: Valencia, California, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

We are seeking experienced laboratory professionals to join the Project Services team at IQVIA Laboratories.

This role is 100% remote (Pacific Time business hours). We are hiring at multiple levels — candidates are aligned to the appropriate level based on experience.

We hire passionate innovators who drive healthcare forward through thoughtful and inclusive collaboration. If you want to discover a career with greater purpose, join us as we transform and accelerate research and development.

Job Summary:

Under general direction, manage all laboratory aspects of clinical trial projects for a client or a specific program, serving as the primary point of contact from award through start-up, maintenance, and closeout. Lead planning, communication, risk management, and cross-functional coordination to deliver high-quality, customer-focused execution.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Manage assigned clinical trial laboratory projects from award through closeout, ensuring protocol requirements are understood and applied
  • Lead study set-up activities including protocol and budget review, start-up meetings, and implementation of project and risk management plans
  • Monitor timelines, deliverables, metrics, and budgets, including trend analysis, scope changes, and change orders
  • Serve as the single point of contact for sponsors, leading client communications, meetings, and issue triage and escalation
  • Drive timely, customer-focused problem solving and coordinate cross-functional resources to remove study obstacles
  • Oversee development of protocol-specific laboratory instructional documents and maintenance of laboratory specifications
  • Support proposal development, bid defense preparation, and development of sponsor or program-specific standards and procedures
  • Capture lessons learned and support continuous improvement across projects and programs

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Life Sciences and/or related field preferred
  • 3+ years of experience in a regulated laboratory environment
  • 2+ years of experience managing projects (e.g., study setup, method validation or transfer, client programs) — a formal project management title is not required
  • Demonstrated computer proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comparable company systems in a project delivery environment

The Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Needed for This Role:

  • Strong interpersonal and client management skills, with the ability to interact effectively with sponsor stakeholders
  • Experience with Lab Trial Management Systems (LTMS)
  • Strong organizational skills with high accuracy and attention to detail while managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with good command of English and clinical research terminology
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-stress environment with a customer-focused mindset
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients

What We Offer You:

We put our employees at the center of everything we do and are committed to providing them, and their families, with benefits that meet their diverse and changing needs. IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. raw.excerpt: Relae (formerly Carbon Direct) helps organizations like Microsoft, Mitsubishi, and JPMorgan Chase make defensible, high-stakes decisions across energy strategy, decarbonization, environmental markets, and natural capital.
raw.description:
Relae (formerly Carbon Direct) helps organizations like Microsoft, Mitsubishi, and JPMorgan Chase make defensible, high-stakes decisions across energy strategy, decarbonization, environmental markets, and natural capital. Our teams combine scientific rigor with commercial and policy fluency to answer questions that matter, and we invest just as seriously in the people answering them, with a clear path for career growth, structured manager development, and real ownership of hard problems from day one.

The Role

Overview

Relae is seeking an AI/ML Engineer for our Power, Data and Innovation team. This role will be responsible for designing, building, training, and maintaining machine learning models for production. You will be directly working with Relae’s existing and prospective clients to provide insights and analysis on power hedging and procurement of electricity, gas and other energy commodities to help analyze operational and market risks and flexible load opportunities, including assessments of associated emissions impacts.

This is an individual contributor role, and this role will work closely with software engineers, data scientists, energy economists, and power systems engineers to build models that support hyperscaler, utility, and corporate energy buyer clients navigating the AI-driven data center power boom.

Responsibilities

  • Leveraging a deep understanding of power systems data, identify, gather, and validate appropriate datasets for relevant power-sector applications, including assessment of uncertainties and data gaps, and develop analytical approaches to mitigate them.
  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for energy market forecasting and grid analytics (data ingestion from ISO/utility feeds and weather sources, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring).
  • Productionize forecasting and optimization models such as nodal price, load, or renewable generation forecasts with robust testing, observability, and documentation, in collaboration with cross-functional software and power advisory teams, and automated evaluations to ensure safe, frequent releases.
  • Collaborate with power systems engineers and energy market analysts to translate research insights and domain expertise into performant, scalable forecasting and optimization systems.
  • Contribute to technical design reviews, coding standards, and mentoring of best practices with the Tech & Software teams at Relea.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment in power trading, energy procurement, commodity risk management, utility strategy, energy markets, or related roles.
  • A master’s or a Ph.D. degree in applied statistics, applied economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Monitor real-time data for wholesale power markets, gas markets, congestion, basis, capacity, ancillary services, tariff developments, and regulatory changes that could affect portfolio cost or reliability.
  • Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience in ML frameworks and time-series forecasting techniques applied to the power industry, along with a solid understanding of current ML approaches — including LLMs, predictive analytics, and agent-based modeling — as well as time-series-specific challenges such as non-stationarity, seasonality, avoiding data leakage, and appropriate cross-validation techniques.
  • Ability to translate model outputs and technical tradeoffs into clear communication for non-technical audiences, including Relea’s existing and prospective clients
  • Experience working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the product surface may evolve based on client needs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Power and energy advisory/consulting experience or experience in power product design
  • Familiarity with weather-driven forecasting platforms or techniques (e.g., NWP data, ensemble weather models) and experience with grid optimization problems (e.g., storage dispatch, unit commitment, OPF)

Salary Range

$159,000-$195,000 a year

Benefits:

While we love our work, our lives aren’t defined by it. At Relae (formerly Carbon Direct), we offer a robust benefits package that considers the whole person, their partners, and their families – and we’re always looking to improve.

Our U.S. benefits* include:

  • Comprehensive nationwide medical, dental, and vision coverage. See a preview of our coverage here.
  • Time off as needed: Flexible vacation policy and ten company-wide holidays, plus annual winter break between Christmas and New Year's
  • 16 weeks of fully paid parental and family leave with no tenure requirement
  • Remote-friendly work culture with annual company-wide retreats
  • Reimbursement for your work-from-home setup

*These benefits apply to U.S.-based employees only. Employees outside of the U.S. receive benefits that vary by country. To learn more, contact

Equal Opportunity Employer

Diverse perspectives and experience enhance the way Relae selects and approaches the climate crisis, as well as the creativity and applicability of Relae's advisory and investment work.

Relae is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, national or ethnic origin, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other occupationally irrelevant criteria. We adhere rigorously to our equal employment opportunity policies in connection with all employment decisions, including hiring, compensation, and promotion.

raw.description:
The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client’s marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers’ Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers’ Associates to ensure that your assigned clients’ marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

  • Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well
  • Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing
  • Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you’ll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)
  • Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met
  • Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients
  • Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly
  • Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients
  • Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients
  • Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers’ demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly
  • Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue
  • Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

raw.description:
Equity-Based Opportunity for a Skilled Developer

Join Our Growing Startup!

We're Omnitrain, a dynamic and innovative marketing automation SaaS startup bootstrapped from zero to a rapidly expanding user base of over 50 paying subscribers. We are building an AI driven Marketing SaaS platform hosted on the Google Cloud Platform and are tapping into the latest generative AI models. We're seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Engineer to join our team on an equity-based compensation model, with the option for salary upon achievement of revenue goals.

We are in the process of raising a pre-seed fund -- this is your chance to get in on the ground floor.

This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on a promising venture and share in its future success.

Our Mission

Omnitrain’s very name communicates our ambitious goals for our roadmap and market impact.

Think of each aspect of digital marketing as a car on a train.

The moving parts of marketing work together in a linear fashion.

  1. Companies make ads to tell the world about their product.

  2. These ads are circulated online to a variety of marketing platforms, such as Facebook, Google, TikTok, etc..

  3. When people click those ads, they go to a landing page that continues the promise of the ad.

  4. People persuaded by the landing page’s message proceed to convert.

  5. Analytics are collected about the customer journey in order to identify what’s working well and what isn’t.

  6. Automation is leveraged to adjust the ads accordingly based on their performance.

We seek to expand our platform to provide solutions for each part of the train.

Marketers are responsible for potentially thousands or even millions of dollars in ad spend every month. And the reality is that the numbers can turn sour at any time, 24/7. There’s been brands who have literally lost millions in ad spend in as little as an hour or two due to human errors and misconfigurations. Many marketers are utterly chained to their work for fear that things could fall apart at any time and require immediate recalibration.

Our mission is to liberate these folks from their shackles.

In 2024, we released our MVP, the world’s first and only Text-to-Ads solution, which solves for the first car of the train (ad creation) in a way that no other solution in the market has been able to do. Thanks to our innovative proprietary systems in place, our solution instantly creates winning image ads for practically any business or service.

Now we’re looking to expand this concept to other kinds of ads (reels, video, UGC, etc), leveraging emerging technology to do so.

And of course, we plan to tackle the rest of the cars of the train in the future.

We have in-house talent that have many years of experience in building brands from zero to millions as well as a successful exit. We want to do it again, and we want you to be a part of it.

Benefits

  • Equity Ownership: Opportunity to own a stake in a high-growth startup.

  • Impactful Work: Make a meaningful contribution to a product that is already generating revenue.

  • Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a remote work arrangement with flexible hours.

  • Learning and Growth: Expand your skills and knowledge in a challenging and supportive environment.

  • Potential for High Returns: Share in the financial rewards if the company achieves significant success. Paid salary possibilities are available upon achieving revenue targets.

Responsibilities

  • Full stack coding: Develop and maintain high-quality software components across the full stack on GCP, emphasizing cloud functions, Firestore database, Firebase authentication, REST APIs, and integrating with a complex UI app written in Nuxt with Vue 3, and other tools or frameworks such as Quasar, PWA features etc.

  • API Development and Integration: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable APIs to support our core product functionality and integrations with third-party services. This can include AI products such as LLMs or image/video generation, marketing platforms (Meta, Google, etc), payment platforms (Stripe)

  • Microservices and data management: Write, edit, debug microservices as Firebase functions (gen 1 and gen 2), Firestore triggers, Pub/Sub queue processing code etc.

  • Generative AI: Explore and integrate generative AI technologies and techniques, ensuring their application is as pivotal as traditional API integration.

  • Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to UI/UX, APIs, database, deployment to GCP, writing test cases, debugging. Write high-quality, efficient, and testable Javascript code adhering to best practices and standards across the stack.

  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with the CTO and the development team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, assisting the team in overcoming obstacles and achieving milestones.

  • Commitment: We are looking for a part time commitment of about 20 hours a week. Less is acceptable. The more time, effort, and skill you can commit to the venture, the more you stand to gain in percentage of the operation.

Qualifications

  • Vue 3 Expertise: Experience in building modern apps with Vue 3 Composition API, preferably in a Nuxt 3 environment. This is non-negotiable - experience with React or Angular will not be considered. You must be a Vue developer to succeed here.

  • JavaScript experience: A compelling record of work with Javascript, front end and back end (Node.js 20+). Solid understanding of CRUD principles and best practices in creating APIs and calling external APIs. You must be able to demonstrate your ability to write front end and back end code in JavaScript or TypeScript. Experience with CSS or SCSS is also necessary.

  • GCP experience: We use Firebase and many other GCP services, and experience with the platform is essential. You should be able to write and deploy functions as microservices, work with Firestore and Google storage, Firebase authentication

  • Database Proficiency: General knowledge of, and working experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. We use Firestore at the moment, PostgreSQL down the road. Knowledge of BigQuery is useful but not essential.

  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Ability to analyze and solve complex technical challenges. Familiarity with building hybrid web apps for diverse operating systems and devices from a common code base. A holistic approach to development, with skills or interests that span beyond coding, including project management, user experience design, and data analysis.

  • Passion for Startups: Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, agile startup environment. We have many challenges to solve, and we must pivot priorities based on changing market conditions.

  • Equity-Based Compensation: Willingness to work for equity in exchange for potential future financial gains. We understand you have other commitments and are only asking for a part time commitment, as well as passion for our project.

  • Team player: We only hire people who are team players. We operate on respect. This is not a place for a lone wolf. We are fully remote and regular communication is essential for our success.

  • US Residency: Must be a resident of the United States.

Benefits

  • Equity Ownership: Opportunity to own a stake in a high-growth startup.

  • Impactful Work: Make a meaningful contribution to a product that is already generating revenue.

  • Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a remote work arrangement with flexible hours.

  • Learning and Growth: Expand your skills and knowledge in a challenging and supportive environment.

  • Potential for Enormous Returns: Share in the financial rewards as we achieve significant success. You decide how much time, effort, and skill you put in, and you will get a corresponding amount of equity % of the operation. Paid salary possibilities are available upon achieving revenue targets.

This position offers a unique opportunity to join a rapidly growing team at an early stage,

where your work will directly influence the trajectory of our product and company. We

value creativity, dedication, and a team-oriented mindset, and we're excited to welcome

individuals who are prepared to take on significant challenges and contribute to our

shared success.

About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We harness the power of an integrated solution ecosystem—comprising industry-leading partnerships and 1.8 million vertical domain experts in more than 230 markets—to create contextual, multilingual, pre-trained datasets; fine-tuned, industry-specific LLMs; and RAG pipelines supported by vector databases. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

Lead Research Scientist – Foundation Models for Vision AI & Physical AI

Company: Centific

Location: Seattle, WA or Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid/Remote)

About the Team

Centific’s Physical AI Lab is building the next generation of embodied intelligence at the intersection of multimodal foundation models, simulation, agentic AI, and real-world robotics. Our mission is to move from perception and reasoning to robust real-world action across safety, industrial, healthcare, warehouse, autonomous systems, and smart environment use cases.

We are looking for a Research Leader with deep foundational model-building experience, a strong publication record, and the ability to translate frontier research into deployable systems and long-term IP.

The Role

As Lead Research Scientist, you will define and drive Centific’s research agenda in Vision AI, multimodal foundation models, simulation-first learning, agentic AI, and embodied intelligence. You will lead a small team of researchers, engineers, and interns while contributing directly to model design, large-scale training, benchmarking, and external scientific visibility.

This role is for someone who has gone beyond applying existing models and has materially advanced architectures, training methods, datasets, or evaluation frameworks in AI, robotics, vision, autonomous driving, or multimodal learning.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead high-impact research in multimodal foundation models, world models, embodied AI, vision-language-action systems, and agentic AI.
  • Develop new approaches for perception, temporal reasoning, spatial intelligence, affordance understanding, autonomous decision-making, and sim2real transfer.
  • Advance challenging robotics capabilities including dexterous manipulation, contact-rich interaction, bimanual coordination, long-horizon task execution, navigation in dynamic environments, and robust action under uncertainty.
  • Contribute to large-scale model building, including multimodal pretraining, distributed training, fine-tuning, distillation, and evaluation of models for vision, robotics, and autonomous systems.
  • Help shape research relevant to autonomous driving and mobile autonomy, including scene understanding, multimodal sensor reasoning, planning-aware perception, and edge-case robustness.
  • Guide integration of research with simulation and digital twin platforms such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Omniverse, or related environments.
  • Establish rigorous benchmarks and reproducible evaluation frameworks for robustness, safety, generalization, manipulation success, policy performance, and real-world deployment readiness.
  • Mentor Ph.D. interns and engineers, and help build a strong research culture grounded in rigor, speed, originality, and scientific excellence.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Autonomous Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong publication record in top venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CoRL, RSS, or leading autonomous driving/robotics venues.
  • 5+ years of research experience in academia, industry, or advanced R&D environments.
  • Demonstrated experience building or advancing large-scale foundational models, novel architectures, or training methods in multimodal AI, vision, robotics, autonomous driving, embodied AI, world models, or simulation-based learning.
  • Deep expertise in PyTorch and/or JAX, GPU training, distributed experimentation, and large-scale model development.
  • Proven ability to lead ambitious technical programs and mentor junior researchers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications or patents in multimodal foundation models, dexterous robotics, autonomous driving, spatial intelligence, simulation-based learning, manipulation, or embodied AI.
  • Strong experience in Vision AI, including perception, tracking, grounding, 3D scene understanding, video understanding, sensor fusion, or multimodal reasoning.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI systems, tool-using agents, planning frameworks, and memory-based architectures; experience with agentic memory, knowledge graphs, or long-horizon reasoning systems is a plus.
  • Experience with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, OpenUSD/Omniverse, Open3D, PyTorch3D, NeRF/3DGS, or related simulation and 3D stacks.
  • Familiarity with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, planning, MPC, control, teleoperation data pipelines, or policy learning for robotics and autonomous systems.
  • Experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Triton, TensorRT, Docker, W&B, or large-scale training and deployment infrastructure.
  • Background in trustworthy AI, robotics safety, evaluation, or explainability for autonomous systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • Publishable, reproducible, and deployable research that strengthens Centific’s Physical AI portfolio.
  • New technical IP in multimodal AI, simulation, dexterous robotics, autonomous systems, and embodied intelligence.
  • Strong mentorship and research leadership across a growing team.
  • Demonstrable impact on model robustness, large-scale training capability, sim2real performance, manipulation capability, and real-world deployability.

Our Stack

Modeling: PyTorch, JAX, Hugging Face, xFormers

Simulation: Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, OpenUSD, Omniverse, Open3D

Systems: Python, Ray, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Triton, TensorRT

Multimodal AI: CLIP, SAM, VLMs, world models, vision-language-action architectures, agent frameworks

Why Join Centific

Help define Centific’s research direction in Physical AI, publish frontier work, mentor the next generation of researchers, and see your science move into real systems.

How to Apply

Email your CV, publication list, GitHub/Google Scholar, and optional 1-page research statement to

Subject: Principal Research Scientist – Foundation Models, Vision AI & Physical AI

Salary Range: $200,000-$300,000 + OTB

Centific is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

About the Role

We’re seeking a self-motivated, detail-oriented Accounting Specialist who is comfortable with both tactical and strategic responsibilities. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on accounting experience, particularly in accounts payable and core accounting operations, along with mandatory experience using QuickBooks Online.

This is initially a part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to expand hours and responsibilities as the firm grows.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, proactive, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

Depending on experience and skill level, responsibilities may include:

  • Process and manage accounts payable (AP), including invoice entry, coding, and payment coordination.
  • Support accounts receivable (AR) processes and customer invoicing.
  • Prepare and post journal entries.
  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date general ledger records.
  • Assist with monthly and year-end closing activities.
  • Support the preparation of financial statements and management reports.
  • Assist with budgeting and forecasting, where applicable.
  • Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation.
  • Work across multiple client accounts and ensure accuracy and timely completion of assigned tasks.
  • Collaborate directly with the co-founders to improve accounting workflows and processes.
  • Depending on seniority, review accounting work, identify discrepancies, and provide oversight or guidance to junior team members.

What We're Looking For

  • Practical experience in accounting, bookkeeping, accounts payable, or financial operations.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) – mandatory, along with experience using Bill.com and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Understanding of basic accounting principles and financial processes.
  • Experience with AP processing, reconciliations, journal entries, and general ledger maintenance.
  • Ability to manage tasks independently and meet deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Comfortable working remotely and communicating with a distributed team.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work with multiple clients and manage competing priorities.

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with outsourced accounting firms or multiple client accounts.
  • Knowledge of GAAP and month-end close procedures.
  • Experience with Xero, NetSuite, Bill.com, or other accounting platforms.
  • Experience preparing financial statements, budgets, and forecasts.
  • CPA, ACCA, or equivalent accounting qualification (preferred, depending on experience level).
  • Previous experience reviewing work or mentoring junior accounting staff.

Work Schedule & Compensation

  • Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week.
  • Employment Type: Part-time, with potential to expand to additional hours as the business grows.

Benefits

You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard.
