What Strategic Sourcing - Global Products contributes to Cardinal Health

Global Sourcing is responsible for creating and managing diverse strategic supplier partnerships that drive enterprise value with innovation, best cost and competitive advantages that benefit customers, suppliers and patients. Develops and executes strategic plans by leveraging market intelligence, industry knowledge and cross-functional collaboration. Competitive advantage is created through supplier selection and management, contract negotiation, supply chain optimization and risk mitigation.

This position is responsible for coordinating and executing new product introduction and commercialization projects for medical products sourced from third-party medical device manufacturers and/or self/contract manufactured. The Manager collaborates with Marketing, Sourcing, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Logistics, and external suppliers to facilitate the identification, sourcing, setup, and launch of products that fill portfolio gaps. This role will be responsible for their own portfolio, as well as 1-2 direct reports who will be responsible for additional work to support the Launch Team needs.


Responsibilities

  • Own and lead the top 5 to 6 highest-priority, highest-revenue, and most complex product opportunities within the Portfolio Gap Launch pipeline, driving execution from initial opportunity assessment through commercialization and launch.
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for new Private Brand medical products, including supplier discovery, RFQs/RFPs, bid analysis, supplier selection, award recommendations, negotiations, and implementation.
  • Lead complex cross-functional product launches by coordinating Marketing, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Planning, Logistics, Trade Compliance, Warehousing, Distribution, Legal, Finance, and external suppliers.
  • Evaluate sourcing and product opportunities using revenue potential, landed cost, should-cost analysis, margin impact, supply risk, supplier capabilities, and time to market to support data-driven business decisions.
  • Develop integrated project plans, identify risks and barriers that could impact product launches, establish corrective actions, and drive stakeholder accountability to keep high-priority initiatives on schedule.
  • Lead supplier engagement and commercial negotiations, including pricing, critical terms and conditions, NDAs, amendments, contract routing, and other requirements necessary to establish and maintain strategic supplier relationships.
  • Serve as the primary sourcing leader for high-visibility opportunities, effectively influencing stakeholders across, upward, downward, and across peer relationships within a large, matrixed organization.
  • Manage and develop 1 to 2 Strategic Sourcing Advisors, providing work prioritization, coaching, guidance, escalation support, and clear expectations for sourcing and project execution.
  • Maintain visibility across the broader Portfolio Gap Launch pipeline and consolidate the work and outputs of the sourcing team into portfolio-level reporting for functional leaders, senior leadership, and executives.
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level updates that clearly communicate portfolio progress, financial opportunity, sourcing status, launch readiness, key risks, decisions required, and recommended actions.
  • Establish and continuously improve processes, governance, tools, templates, metrics, and best practices for the evolving Portfolio Gap Launch program, identifying recurring barriers and opportunities to accelerate execution.
  • Ensure product and launch deliverables meet applicable quality, regulatory, commercial, sourcing, operational, logistics, and supply-chain requirements, while proactively resolving issues that could affect successful commercialization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, category management, supply chain, or product commercialization, preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the end-to-end strategic sourcing process, including supplier discovery, RFQs/RFPs, supplier selection, cost analysis, negotiations, and contract execution, preferred.
  • Strong project management experience, with the ability to lead multiple complex, high-priority initiatives and drive them from strategy through implementation, preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams across functions such as Marketing, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and external suppliers, preferred.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience with should-cost analysis, landed cost, business cases, and evaluating revenue or margin opportunities, preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and present to senior leaders, including clearly articulating project status, risks, financial impact, recommendations, and decisions needed, preferred.
  • People leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to coach, develop, prioritize work, and hold team members accountable, preferred.
  • Experience identifying and resolving complex sourcing, supplier, or project issues and developing corrective actions to maintain business and launch timelines, preferred.
  • Experience in medical devices, healthcare, FDA-regulated products, finished goods, private-brand products, or another regulated industry preferred, preferred.

What is expected of you and others at this level:

  • Deliver on yearly tangible corporate goals
  • Applies advanced knowledge and an understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
  • Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models
  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope
  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact
  • Provides solutions that may set precedent
  • Independently determines method for completion of new projects
  • Received guidance on overall project objectives

Job Summary

The Bill Review Specialist connects our clinical data with strategy. In this role, you will apply specialized expertise in medical data entry, and national repricing systems to analyze complex, high-exposure medical claims and litigation demands. By conducting precise line-item audits, you uncover billing irregularities and deliver clear, defensible insights that attorneys and adjusters rely on to make fair, evidence-based decisions. Your work directly safeguards reimbursement integrity and upholds Dane Street’s reputation for excellence in the legal and healthcare communities.

Mission, Culture and Values

At Dane Street, we believe exceptional employee experiences create exceptional client experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous improvement, accountability, and care.

We care for our customers, we care for our employees, and we care for one another. Every team member plays an important role in creating an environment where people feel respected, supported, empowered to grow, and inspired to do meaningful work.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct regular quality control of reports
  • Software & Payer System Repricing Optimization
  • Apply knowledge of repricing payer guidelines to maximize accuracy and identify erroneous billing/overbilling.
  • Ensure correct application of fee schedules, line-item audits,CCI edits, and clinical validation rules across commercial, auto/PIP, and workers' compensation lines.
  • Translating complex coding systems (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, DRG) into plain language for attorneys.

What Makes this Role Successful

The Bill Review Specialist role combines analytical precision with a sharp eye for clinical coding and reimbursement integrity. You thrive in the details, moving effortlessly between line-item audits and national repricing platforms to spot billing anomalies, unbundling, and fee schedule discrepancies. By consistently applying NCCI edits and clinical validation rules, you ensure every report produced is audit-proof, accurate, and aligned with current payer guidelines. You can also successfully translate dense coding structures into straightforward, plain-language insights that attorneys and adjusters can confidently stand behind during litigation and settlement negotiations.

What Your First 90 Days May Look Like

First 30 days

  • Become familiar with Dane Street's Medical Bill Review processes, systems, and workflows.
  • Learn national repricing systems, payer guidelines, and client-specific requirements.
  • Understand fee schedules, UCR benchmarks, NCCI edits, and coding guidelines.
  • Review sample medical bills and reports to understand quality and accuracy expectations.
  • Become familiar with CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and DRG coding.

First 31-60 days

  • Independently review and audit medical bills and supporting documentation.
  • Identify duplicate, excessive, unsupported, unbundled, or incorrectly billed charges.
  • Apply appropriate fee schedules, repricing guidelines, and coding edits.
  • Prepare accurate and detailed bill review reports.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and turnaround time expectations.
  • Communicate billing discrepancies and findings clearly to the appropriate teams.

First 61-90 days

  • Consistently manage assigned bill review workload with accuracy and efficiency.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in repricing systems and medical billing guidelines.
  • Produce accurate, complete, and defensible reports.
  • Independently identify billing irregularities and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Translate complex billing and coding information into clear, understandable findings.
  • Identify opportunities to improve review accuracy, workflow efficiency, and overall quality.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. Examples:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting or remaining stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Constant operation of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital productivity tools.
  • Close visual acuity required to view computer screens, analyze data, and read extensive digital documentation.
  • Frequent communication with team members, leadership, and external partners via email, chat, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
  • Occasional moving or positioning of office equipment or files weighing up to 10–15 pounds.

Why Join Dane Street?

  • Collaborative remote culture
  • Professional growth opportunities
  • Meaningful work supporting the healthcare industry
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Great Place to Work Certified since 2021
  • Commitment to employee development

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support your own internet services.

Maintain an uninterrupted internet connection.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

At Dane Street, caring for people is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

A High School Diploma or equivalent

Must Haves:

  • Experience reviewing invoices, billing statements, or financial documentation.
  • Ability to identify incorrect, duplicate, or unsupported charges.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify improperly bundled, unbundled, or redundant charges (if this is essential to the role).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience identifying improperly bundled, unbundled, or redundant charges.
  • Experience in the specific industry or billing environment.
  • Familiarity with applicable billing guidelines and regulations.
  • Experience resolving billing discrepancies and communicating findings.
  • .Experience in Fee schedule UCRs /Bench Mark surveys.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

About Empowerly

Empowerly (Empowerly.com) is an education technology company that personalizes college and career counseling, with a mission to empower students to become the most successful version of themselves.

We provide data-driven education technology, start-up and research internship programs, and personalized counseling led by former Admission Officers and experienced College Admissions Counselors. We are a rapidly growing, mission-driven, and venture-backed company. It takes a unified team committed to our core values (collaboration, data driven, and empowerment) to achieve this goal and a fast-moving team committed to serving the needs of our students and families.

Each student is holistically evaluated through our Empowerly Score™ — the only predictive technology that can also quantify subjective material. Each student is offered a three-pronged approach to evaluate academics, essays, and extracurricular activities, providing them with a 360-degree view of how to be competitive against other applicants.

We are a fully remote, global workforce focused on building world-class, college admissions advisory services and programs.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced BS/MD College Admissions Counselors to guide ambitious high school students pursuing highly selective colleges and combined medical programs.

Our ideal counselor has significant college admissions counseling experience and/or experience as a former admissions officer at a highly selective university. We strongly prefer counselors who graduated from a top 50 university and bring a strong STEM background, particularly in medicine, pre-med, engineering, computer science, or related fields.

Many of our students are high-achieving students applying to top 50 universities, including the University of California campuses and Ivy League institutions. A significant portion of our students are aspiring physicians pursuing competitive BS/MD and pre-med pathways, making firsthand knowledge of STEM-focused admissions, medical extracurricular development, and BS/MD programs especially valuable.

As a BS/MD College Admissions Counselor, you will work closely with students and families to build thoughtful, individualized admissions strategies. This includes developing academic and extracurricular roadmaps, identifying meaningful research, clinical, volunteer, and leadership opportunities, building balanced college and BS/MD program lists, and providing structure and strategic feedback throughout the application process.

Beyond admissions, our counselors help students discover their interests, develop authentic passions, and make intentional decisions about their academic and early career paths.

**This is a part-time opportunity with weekly hours based on counselor availability and student needs.

Responsibilities

  • Stay current on college admissions trends and requirements, particularly for top 50 universities, BS/MD programs, and STEM-focused applicants.
  • Manage a caseload of approximately 20-25 students based on availability and bandwidth.
  • Develop individualized academic and extracurricular roadmaps aligned with students' college and career goals.
  • Advise students on meaningful extracurriculars, leadership opportunities, research, clinical experiences, internships, competitions, community service, and summer programs.
  • Create standardized testing strategies and develop balanced college lists, including reach, target, and likely schools.
  • Guide students through the full application process, including personal statements, supplemental essays, activities, resumes, recommendations, and final application review.
  • Provide BS/MD-specific guidance, including program selection, medical-focused extracurricular development, supplemental essays, and interview preparation.
  • Develop application strategies across Early Action, Early Decision, Regular Decision, waitlists, and final college selection.
  • Maintain consistent communication with students and families, prepare for sessions, document progress, and meet application deadlines.
  • Attend team meetings and utilize Empowerly's resources, email, and Slack to stay connected and provide students with comprehensive support.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience working with BS/MD applicants and 5+ acceptances.
  • Bachelor's degree from a top 50 national university. Advanced degrees such as an MD, PhD, MBA, JD, or master's degree are a plus.
  • College counseling experience with a track record of helping students gain admission to top 50 universities.
  • Experience advising students interested in BS/MD, pre-med, STEM, healthcare, or other highly competitive academic pathways.
  • Strong knowledge of selective college admissions, application strategy, and extracurricular development.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and communication skills.
  • Strong organization, time management, and commitment to student and family service.
  • Consistent availability after 3:00 p.m. and/or on weekends.
  • Ability to support students enrolled in multi-year counseling packages.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Former admissions officer at a top 50 university.
  • Demonstrated success counseling students applying to BS/MD programs, Ivy League institutions, top 20 universities, and/or highly selective STEM programs.
  • Academic or professional background in medicine, healthcare, biology, engineering, computer science, or another STEM field.
  • Advanced degree such as an MD, PhD, or master's degree in a relevant field.
  • Experienced independent college counselor with involvement in NACAC, WACAC, IECA, or similar professional organizations.

raw.excerpt: About BuildersBuilders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference, grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division.
raw.description:
About Builders

Builders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference, grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division. Founded by Daniel Lubetzky, our community spans 5M+ citizens, 650M video views, and 400+ movement partners including José Andrés, Katie Couric, Adam Grant, Lonnie Ali, and Karl Rove. Through a growing ecosystem of content, tools, partnerships, and activations, we turn civic engagement into meaningful action, empowering people to participate, collaborate, and deliver real-world impact to enact lasting change.

About the Position

Builders is searching for a communications leader who is already operating in what comes next. This role leads traditional comms/PR and extends into all communication verticals, including CRM, SMS, social, and key campaign messaging. We are looking for a plugged-in leader in the news, politics, media, or lifestyle space who has mastered the fundamentals of earned media and brings deep, trusted relationships across the political media landscape on both sides of the aisle.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own Builders' communications and editorial strategy and lead its earned media operation, driving coverage across national and Texas outlets, independent media, creator, and emerging platforms.

This is a communications-first role with editorial upside. The editorial scope gives the right leader room to shape how Builders thinks and speaks across channels and strengthen our audience strategy.

Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Leadership

  • Set and own Builders' communications strategy, aligning earned media, editorial, and organizational priorities with clear goals and measures of success.
  • Serve as the judgment-setter on if, when, and how Builders engages in cultural, political, and civic conversations at the national and Texas levels.
  • Lead crisis and rapid-response communications, aligning messaging across channels during key news cycles.
  • Develop messaging and communications frameworks for dedicated campaigns and evergreen content, ensuring consistency, clarity, and cross-partisan credibility across all channels.
  • Lead and develop communications and editorial team members and freelancers, setting a high bar for quality, speed, and voice.
  • Own the communications tech stack and champion the thoughtful use of AI tools.
  • Report on coverage, share of voice, and audience impact, using data to make strategic decisions, not just report metrics.

Earned Media and Pitching

  • Lead the proactive earned media operation, identifying story angles, shaping pitches, and securing coverage across national outlets and key regional markets, most notably Texas.
  • Monitor the news and culture cycle in real time to spot reactive opportunities and move credibly and quickly.
  • Treat creators as a core earned media channel, building relationships to reach audiences traditional press does not, in partnership with the Social team.

Political and Media Relationships

  • Bring and expand a network of trust-based relationships with journalists, producers, and editors who cover politics, civic life, and solutions-oriented news, positioning Builders as a go-to source for cross-partisan civic stories.

Editorial Voice and Content

  • Help define and operationalize the "Builders lens": balanced, solution-oriented, values-driven commentary that safeguards organizational reputation and public trust.
  • Distill complex policy and political issues into compelling content with non-partisan framing that moves audiences beyond "us vs. them" thinking and surfaces common ground.
  • Lead the editorial calendar for the Builders and Builders TX newsletters, blog, and SMS, and contribute to social channels, aligning earned media moments with owned content.

Requirements

  • 7-10 years of PR or communications experience, with the majority in earned media (pitching, placing, and managing press) and at least 2 years leading strategy or managing people.
  • A proven pitching track record: you can point to placements you drove in national and major regional outlets, and you know what made them land.
  • Established relationships with political, civic, and national news reporters, producers, bookers, and creators, with demonstrated credibility across the political spectrum, and deep familiarity with the beats, outlets, and fault lines that shape civic life.
  • Experience advising senior leaders on communications strategy, reputation, and rapid response, including supporting executive spokespeople or public figures in media contexts.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and editorial judgment: you can draft or edit a pitch, press release, op-ed, or reactive statement that is clean and compelling under deadline, and you know what will land with a skeptical, politically diverse audience.
  • A servant leader with experience managing team members or freelancers and building a high-performing function, willing to roll up your sleeves and get the work done.
  • A technology-forward mindset and fluency in the modern PR tech stack, including AI tools.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment where priorities shift.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for Builders' cross-partisan mission: you believe most Americans share more common ground than our political moment suggests, and you see reaching both sides of the aisle as a feature, not a constraint.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the Texas political and media landscape, including key outlets, reporters, and civic players.
  • Experience building or growing a trusted editorial voice, publication, or newsletter, including the use of audience analytics.
  • Experience in nonprofit, advocacy, or civic sector communications.

Benefits

What Builders Offers

  • Competitive annual compensation
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision insurance with company coverage options of 100%
  • 25 days Paid Time Off (20 personal, 5 sick)
  • 401K with company match
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • Charitable gift matching program
  • The opportunity to make a real impact through your day-to-day work

EEO

At Builders, we are committed to an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is championed. Builders is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. For applicants with disabilities, our recruiting team will actively work with you to accommodate any needs in order for you to be able to interview at your best.

Job Description

The Director, HR Business Partner serves as the senior HR advisor to the Regional Vice President and regional leadership team, translating business priorities into an actionable people strategy across 600+ stores. As a member of the regional leadership team, this role uses workforce insights and business acumen to strengthen leadership capability, build talent pipelines, improve organizational effectiveness, and support regional performance.

The Director leads a team of HR Business Partners and is accountable for consistent, high-quality HR partnership across the region. Working across HR Centers of Excellence, Employee Relations, and Legal, this role anticipates workforce needs and risks, delivers integrated talent solutions, and leads organizational change aligned with regional and enterprise priorities.


What will you do?

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Partner across HR Centers of Excellence to integrate talent acquisition, organizational development, compensation, benefits, and employee relations solutions into a cohesive regional people strategy.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of field operations through regular store and market visits, using firsthand insights to shape regional people strategies and enterprise HR decisions or program design
  • Use workforce data (case trends, turnover, staffing, engagement, labor spend) to diagnose region-level issues, influence decisions, and develop proactive plans that strengthen leadership practices and team member experience
  • Partner with Employee Relations and Legal to identify and proactively address workforce risks, recurring employee relations trends, and compliance concerns across the region
  • Ensure leaders consistently apply company policies, performance expectations, and talent practices while balancing business needs, team member experience, and organizational risk

Talent, Organization & Culture

  • Own regional talent and succession planning, identifying critical roles, talent risks, bench gaps, and development actions that strengthen leadership capability and internal mobility.
  • Partner with Organizational Development and Training to build targeted development strategies that address regional capability needs.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to establish workforce and staffing priorities, leadership selection standards, and talent-pipeline strategies.
  • Lead organizational design and change initiatives that align structure, roles, talent, and labor models with current and future business needs.
  • Own the regional engagement and retention strategy, using employee feedback and workforce insights to address the underlying drivers of turnover and performance.
  • Champion an inclusive, high-accountability culture and consistent team member experience across all districts.

Team Leadership & Execution

  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of HR Business Partners, establishing clear priorities, consistent service expectations, and measurable outcomes aligned with regional business needs
  • Build HRBP capability through ongoing coaching, talent development, succession planning, and differentiated performance management
  • Create an effective operating rhythm across the regional HRBP team to identify emerging workforce trends, align priorities, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution across districts
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-impact people matters, coordinating the appropriate Employee Relations, Legal, and HR Center of Excellence partners

Qualifications:

  • Proven multi-unit, geographically dispersed retail, restaurant or field-based HR experience
  • Demonstrated success partnering with and influencing senior executives to improve business outcomes
  • Strong analytics capability; comfortable building a people plan with data
  • Demonstrated ability to apply critical and strategic thinking to complex business and workforce matters, make sound decisions amid ambiguity, and translate insights into practical, measurable actions.
  • High degree of business and financial acumen
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, as well as champion change
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and conflict management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Workday
  • Ability to travel as necessary

Certifications, Experience, and Education:

  • Certifications: PHR or SPHR preferred, not required
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience preferably in a business partner capacity including at least 3 years in a leadership role; and
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications or related field; or equivalent combination of education and/or experience

Location & Work Availability:

This position is a Remote based role, up to 50% travel required for market visits and leadership team engagement. Overnight travel may be required. This role will cover territories in Georgia, Alabama, and Florida.


Benefits Summary:

We believe in supporting our Team Members and those they love through comprehensive health & wellness benefits. Learn more here:


Company Overview:

Advance Auto Parts, Inc. is a leading automotive aftermarket parts provider that serves both professional installer and do-it-yourself customers. As of January 3, 2026, Advance operated 4,305 stores primarily within the United States, with additional locations in Canada, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The Company also served 809 independently owned Carquest branded stores across these locations in addition to Mexico and various Caribbean islands. Please review the job details below.

Lanteris Space LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Intuitive Machines, is currently seeking a Principal Embedded Flight Software Engineer to join our team in our Palo Alto, CA offices. This role may also be performed remotely within the U.S. with periodic visits to our Palo Alto location. Intuitive Machines is a leading space infrastructure company that builds spacecraft, connects networks, and operates infrastructure-as-a-service for commercial, civil, and national security customers. With a proven track record across the space domain, the Company, through organic growth and portfolio expansion, has built over 300 spacecraft, delivered over 260 kilograms of payload to the lunar surface, and provided precision navigation expertise that has guided spacecraft across our solar system.

• Develop software verification plans, unit level and open loop test suites, and procedures, executing the test procedures and documenting test results to ensure that software system requirements are met.

• Develop, select, tailor, and deploy software processes, tools, and metrics.

• Serve as a subject matter expert for software domains, processes, and system-specific issues.


Minimum requirements:

• Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident

• Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or related field. Four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree.

• 15 years of software development experience

• Embedded C++ programing skills on multicore-processor architecture

• VxWorks experience

  • Ability to travel to Palo Alto, CA office as needed

  • cFS experience

About the role

Help train and evaluate AI agents on expert-level fluid simulation tasks. You'll take CAD geometry, set up and run simulations, build verified reference solutions, and write Python checks for the agent's results.

Requirements

  • A degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, or a related field such as energy or oil & gas. A PhD is preferred but not required.
  • Several years of hands-on industry or research CFD with OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent/CFX or STAR-CCM+, including meshing.
  • Solid verification and validation practice: mesh-independence studies, and validation against experiment or benchmarks.
  • Comfortable with Python and GitHub.
  • English at B2 level or above.
  • Nice to have: aerospace, automotive, offshore or turbomachinery background; multiphase or particle-laden flow experience.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $31 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

Become a part of our caring community

Full-Time, Remote Telephonic opportunity



The UM Administration Coordinator 2 supports the administration of utilization management by performing a variety of moderately complex administrative, operational, and customer service tasks.

Responsibilities may include significant telephonic interaction with providers, members, and other stakeholders, including receiving inbound calls, providing customer service, and supporting the intake of utilization management and prior authorization requests. Some associates may be assigned primarily or fully to telephonic responsibilities based on business needs.

Additional responsibilities may include creating and processing authorization cases, generating correspondence, triaging faxes and shared mailboxes, processing documentation, conducting calculations and data processing, and performing other administrative functions supporting utilization management. Specific work assignments may vary and may change over time based on business needs, volume, and operational priorities.

Assignments are generally semi-routine in nature.

The UM Administration Coordinator 2 provides non-clinical support for policies and procedures ensuring the best and most appropriate treatment, care, or services for members.


This role may serve as a key point of contact for providers and members through inbound telephonic interactions, including responding to questions and supporting the intake and processing of utilization management requests. Associates must be comfortable working in a phone-based customer service environment, and some assignments may require the majority or entirety of the workday to be dedicated to inbound calls. Other assignments may include building and updating authorization cases, creating letters and other correspondence, processing and routing faxes, triaging shared mailboxes, reviewing and routing documentation, and completing other non-clinical administrative activities supporting the utilization management process. Associates are expected to demonstrate flexibility as work assignments may change based on business needs and operational priorities.


Decisions are typically focused on interpretation of area/department policy and process for completing assignments. Works within defined parameters to identify work expectations and quality standards but has some latitude over prioritization/timing and works under minimal direction. Follows standard policies/practices that allow for some opportunity for interpretation/deviation and/or independent discretion.

Success in this role requires the following:

  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.
  • Strong customer service and verbal communication skills, including the ability to professionally manage a high volume of inbound telephone interactions.
  • Comfort providing telephonic support while simultaneously navigating multiple systems, documenting interactions, and accurately processing information.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Technical savvy and ability to navigate multiple systems and screens while working cases.
  • Collaboration skills to effectively interact with multiple parties, both internal and external.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to work across telephonic and non-telephonic utilization management functions and transition between assignments based on business needs.
  • An understanding of department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas.
  • Ability to make decisions regarding your own work methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations and with minimal direction, receiving guidance where needed.
  • Ability to follow established guidelines, processes, and procedures.



Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 1 or more years of administrative, technical support, customer service, or related experience
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability and willingness to provide customer service and intake support through high-volume inbound telephone interactions; telephonic duties may comprise the primary assignment
  • Ability to simultaneously communicate by telephone, navigate multiple systems/screens, accurately document interactions, and process information
  • Working knowledge of MS Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook in a Windows-based environment, and an ability to quickly learn new systems
  • Must have accessibility to high-speed DSL or cable modem for a home office

About the Team/Role

As a Recovery Agent, you are an essential contributor to safeguarding WEX’s financial health and reducing credit exposure. This is an impactful individual contributor role designed for a focused collections professional whose core mission is clear: to successfully cure past-due debt, resolve account delinquency, and secure predictable cash flow for our standard commercial portfolios.


You will own the daily management of a portfolio of moderately complex, past-due business accounts. Utilizing standard commercial collection techniques and structured negotiation protocols, you will work directly with clients to resolve outstanding balances, make payment arrangements, and maintain positive ongoing business relationships.

We look to our Recovery Agents to execute tasks with high accuracy, maintain tight compliance, and call out workflow bottlenecks or system errors so we can continuously improve.


How you'll make an impact


  • Manage daily inbound and outbound communication channels (phone, email, system queues) with delinquent commercial customers to successfully cure past-due debt and secure immediate payments.
  • Execute sound communication (oral and written) to educate customers on account terms and conditions and effectively resolve complex delinquent balances.
  • Monitor and manage shared group inboxes, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of customer payment inquiries and disputes.
  • Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with customers to negotiate and obtain immediate payment and resolve delinquent account balances.
  • Engage in on-going education with customers on terms and conditions and alternative payment methods.
  • Ability to manage multiple portfolios and risk levels.
  • Utilize judgment and experience to make decisions that effectively balance risk, quality, productivity, corporate objectives and customer retention.
  • Apply industry knowledge, departmental policies and procedures, and Fair Debt Collection Practices Act to make appropriate collection decisions.
  • Proficient use of multiple systems and collections tools to be able to reach a decision maker in the collections process.
  • Self-motivated, dependable and able to work productively in a dynamic, high energy, rapidly changing environment.
  • Perform skip tracing on required accounts using multiple systems/tools
  • Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as required.
  • Embrace opportunities to integrate AI tools and automation technologies into daily operational processes to improve speed, efficiency and accuracy.

These statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed rather than give an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of customer and company information
  • Organized/Time Management ability
  • Ability to be productive while maintaining quality
  • Results-Oriented
  • Self-motivated
  • Effective oral and written communication skills
  • Working knowledge of Google Sheets
  • Working knowledge of FDCPA and any other applicable Federal laws
  • Basic accounting knowledge
  • Analytical skills
  • Sound decision making/judgment
  • Flexible/Adaptable to change

You will be responsible for designing solutions, leading workshops and webinars, supporting RFPs/RFQs, and shaping our Managed Services offerings around Microsoft technologies.

Solution Architecture & Delivery

Leadership & Governance

Certifications (Preferred)

Who Should Apply

Our team is a vibrant tapestry of different cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives, and we are proud to celebrate this diversity every day. raw.description:
Job Title: Master Class - Business Consultant - Life Sciences Commercial (Germany)

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the Life Sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.

We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.

Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.

Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.

The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

    • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
    • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
    • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions
REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
    • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
    • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
    • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
    • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
    • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
    • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team
THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
    • You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
    • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
    • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise
    • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
    • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Compensation

    • Starting Salary: 70,000 EUR
    • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates should be legally authorized to be employed in the EU.

Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. There is no requirement to live near a Veeva office if a candidate is in proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

#RemoteGermany
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Sales Assistant – CRM, Sales Support & Pipeline Coordination

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Assistant to support day-to-day sales operations, CRM management, scheduling, pipeline coordination, reporting, proposals, and client communication.

This is a hands-on sales support role designed to keep the sales process organized and moving forward so Account Executives and sales leaders can focus on selling, closing deals, and building client relationships.

You’ll maintain CRM accuracy, coordinate meetings and follow-ups, prepare sales materials, track pipeline activity, and ensure no lead, task, or opportunity falls through the cracks.

What You’ll Own

CRM Management & Pipeline Support

  • Maintain accurate records for leads, contacts, deals, and opportunities
  • Update pipeline stages, activity notes, next steps, and follow-up tasks
  • Work within CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or Pipedrive
  • Identify and clean duplicate, incomplete, or outdated CRM records
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and pipeline visibility
  • Ensure sales activities and next steps are properly documented
  • Flag stalled opportunities and overdue follow-ups

Scheduling & Sales Coordination

  • Schedule discovery calls, sales meetings, product demos, and follow-ups
  • Coordinate calendars across multiple time zones
  • Manage scheduling through Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, or similar tools
  • Handle confirmations, reminders, reschedules, and calendar changes
  • Ensure sales representatives have the necessary context and materials before meetings
  • Keep follow-ups and next steps moving on schedule

Proposals & Sales Documentation

  • Draft, format, proofread, and organize:
    • Proposals
    • Quotes
    • Presentations
    • Sales collateral
    • Client-facing documents
  • Support RFP and RFI preparation when required
  • Create polished materials using Google Slides, PowerPoint, Canva, or similar tools
  • Maintain organized records of contracts and sales documentation
  • Ensure client-facing materials are accurate and professional

Sales Reporting & Pipeline Tracking

  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports
  • Maintain pipeline summaries and leadership dashboards
  • Track:
    • Pipeline movement
    • Sales activity
    • Conversion rates
    • Follow-up completion
  • Assist with sales forecasting and operational reporting
  • Keep reporting data accurate, organized, and accessible
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into pipeline activity

Client Communication & Follow-Up

  • Draft professional follow-up emails, meeting recaps, reminders, and client communications
  • Support inbound lead routing and prospect coordination
  • Track outstanding follow-ups and ensure timely completion
  • Coordinate communication between prospects, sales representatives, and internal teams
  • Maintain a professional customer experience throughout the sales process

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations
  • Coordinate contracts, approvals, documentation, and internal handoffs
  • Support smooth transitions from prospect to customer onboarding
  • Track outstanding internal requirements and task ownership
  • Identify and help resolve administrative bottlenecks affecting deal progression

Requirements

  • 1–2+ years of experience in sales support, sales coordination, administrative support, or operations
  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
    • Pipedrive
  • Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office
  • Experience coordinating meetings, calendars, and sales follow-ups
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational ability
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities
  • Strong follow-through and accountability
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting B2B sales teams or Account Executives
  • Experience preparing proposals, quotes, or sales presentations
  • Familiarity with SDR/BDR and lead-generation workflows
  • Experience in SaaS, agencies, professional services, or other sales-driven businesses
  • Excel or Google Sheets experience with pivot tables, dashboards, and KPI tracking
  • Familiarity with sales forecasting and pipeline reporting

Tools & Platforms

HubSpot | Salesforce | Zoho | Pipedrive | Google Workspace | Microsoft Office | Calendly | Google Slides | PowerPoint | Canva | Excel / Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and naturally detail-oriented
  • Proactively follow up instead of waiting for reminders
  • Enjoy keeping CRMs, calendars, and pipelines organized
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Can manage multiple priorities without sacrificing accuracy
  • Take ownership of tasks through completion
  • Thrive in fast-paced, sales-driven environments
  • Enjoy helping sales teams operate more efficiently

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing the CRM for missing information, upcoming meetings, stalled opportunities, and overdue follow-ups.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate demos and sales calls, prepare proposals and presentations, update pipeline stages, communicate with prospects, maintain reports and dashboards, and ensure Account Executives have everything they need before client conversations.

In short: you keep the sales engine organized, accurate, and moving so the sales team can focus on generating revenue.

What Success Looks Like

  • High CRM accuracy and data cleanliness
  • Consistent completion of sales follow-ups
  • Accurate and timely meeting coordination
  • Error-free proposals and sales documentation
  • Reliable sales reports and dashboards
  • Improved pipeline organization and visibility
  • Smooth sales-to-onboarding handoffs
  • Strong responsiveness and follow-through
  • Positive feedback from Account Executives and sales leadership

Career Growth

This role can provide a path into:

Sales Coordinator | Sales Operations Specialist | Revenue Operations | Account Management | SDR/BDR | Executive Sales Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Task – CRM Cleanup + Proposal Exercise
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have experience in sales support, CRM management, scheduling, pipeline coordination, or sales operations and enjoy keeping teams organized and opportunities moving forward, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and build your career in sales operations while directly supporting a high-performing sales team.

Atuará de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento e evolução das soluções, desde a concepção e implementação até a integração, implantação e monitoramento em produção, utilizando principalmente tecnologias Python e Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Principais atividades:

  • Implementar e integrar modelos de Machine Learning e IA Generativa (GenAI) em aplicações e sistemas corporativos.

raw.title: Enterprise Network Engineer
raw.excerpt: Love Your Mondays again! Join the Future of Connectivity with Metronet!
raw.description:
Love Your Mondays again!

Join the Future of Connectivity with Metronet!

Are you ready to launch your career with one of the nation’s fastest-growing fiber-optic powerhouses? Welcome to Metronet, where we don’t just build networks; we build communities.

Enterprise Network Engineer

As an Enterprise Network Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, securing, optimizing, and supporting Metronet's enterprise network infrastructure and network security systems. You will help ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of our wired, wireless, WAN, data center, cloud-connected, and remote-site environments while supporting critical business operations across the organization.

This role is ideal for an experienced network professional who has successfully designed, deployed, and supported enterprise-scale network and security solutions within medium to large business environments. You will lead network and security initiatives, manage infrastructure upgrades, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and contribute to the continued modernization of our enterprise technology environment.

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who can take ownership of projects from planning through implementation, work independently with minimal supervision, and bring practical, real-world experience with enterprise networking technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting large-scale firewall deployments, data center networking, routing and switching infrastructures, and multi-site enterprise environments. Success in this role comes from combining strong technical expertise with sound decision-making, problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead the design, deployment, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of enterprise network infrastructure and network security platforms, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, WAN circuits, VPNs, and related technologies.
  • Independently manage assigned network engineering projects from planning and design through implementation, documentation, testing, and operational support.
  • Design and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, and cloud-connected network architectures to support business requirements, remote site connectivity, resiliency, performance, security, and future growth.
  • Develop, maintain, and evolve network and network security standards, reference architectures, implementation practices, and engineering best practices that support scalability, security, and operational excellence across the enterprise.
  • Design, implement, review, and maintain network security controls including firewall policies, ACLs, segmentation, VPN access, NAT, secure management access, zero trust-aligned controls, and access control frameworks.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex network and network security incidents, including routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, DNS, DHCP, WAN, cloud connectivity, performance, availability, and policy-related issues.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews, network access reviews, security policy cleanup, and assist with vulnerability remediation efforts related to network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain network and security documentation including diagrams, standards, configurations, procedures, support records, implementation plans, firewall rule documentation, and maintenance window documentation.
  • Respond to, document, update, and resolve assigned network and security operations tickets in accordance with established service levels, escalation procedures, and change management practices.
  • Drive network growth initiatives, capacity planning, infrastructure refresh projects, technology standardization efforts, and network security platform modernization across the enterprise.
  • Lead and collaborate with vendors, service providers, contractors, security teams, and internal stakeholders to successfully deliver network projects, site deployments, migrations, cutovers, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Occasional travel to Evansville, IN for team meetings and collaboration events (approximately twice per year).
  • All other duties as assigned

JOB QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or better in related field or 4+ years of related network engineering and network security experience minimum.
  • Strong experience with NGFW firewalls such as Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto, or FortiGate, including firewall policy management, NAT, VPN, logging, troubleshooting, rule review, and problem resolution.
  • Experience with enterprise networking technologies and management platforms such as Arista, Juniper, Cisco Nexus, Cisco ISE, Cisco ACI, NDFC, or similar enterprise networking and infrastructure management solutions preferred.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale network infrastructure within medium-to-large multi-site business environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking architectures, standards, and protocols, including routing, switching, VLANs, spanning tree, wireless, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, NAT, QoS, and high availability concepts.
  • Experience with network security concepts including segmentation, ACLs, least privilege access, secure remote access, zero trust principles, logging, monitoring, and incident response support.
  • Experience with Cisco Catalyst 9000 switching platforms and enterprise wireless solutions such as Cisco Catalyst Wireless or Meraki preferred.
  • Experience with dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, or EIGRP, including route filtering, redistribution, and troubleshooting preferred.
  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies, VPN technologies, WAN provider coordination, and remote-site connectivity preferred.
  • Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining Cisco network devices in enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, security, and data center environments.
  • Understanding of cloud networking and hybrid network connectivity concepts, including public cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and related security controls.
  • Experience with network monitoring, firewall logging, NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, packet analysis, and performance troubleshooting tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex network engineering projects, troubleshoot advanced technical issues, and drive solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to communicate technical and security matters clearly to peers, leadership, vendors, contractors, and non-technical counterparts.
  • Good oral and written communication skills with the ability to document technical designs, changes, security decisions, and operational procedures.
  • Detail-oriented organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, operational issues, and security-related requests.
  • Dependability, adaptability, flexibility, creativity, professional attitude, and the ability to understand complex issues, drive troubleshooting efforts, escalate appropriately when needed.
  • Willingness to work as a team and independently.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

ADDITIONAL JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support network and security incidents outside normal business hours.
  • Industry-recognized certifications such as CCNP Enterprise, CCNA, Cisco Security, Palo Alto, Fortinet, AWS Networking, CompTIA Network+, Security+, or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience designing, implementing, securing, and supporting enterprise network infrastructure in a multi-site environment.

Join us and find out what it means to love your career!

At Metronet, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology combined with exceptional customer care. Our 100% fiber-optic technology ensures that we provide our customers with some of the fastest internet speeds in the world. As industry leaders in fiber-to-the-premise TV, voice, and internet services, we’re not just focused on expanding our networks—we’re focused on enriching the lives of those we serve.

We value our associates because they are the cornerstone of our success. By joining the Metronet family, you’re stepping into a rewarding career in technology with a company dedicated to your growth and success. We’re in it to win it, and a key part of our strategy is to strengthen our business-to-business technology sales team with talented and hard-working individuals who aspire to be the next generation of technology leaders.

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work, we offer a competitive total compensation package, including 80% of medical premiums paid by the company, company-paid disability and life insurance, and a 401(k)-company match. Plus, enjoy discounted services within our coverage areas and thrive in a locally owned, friendly, and fun atmosphere.

Discover more with Metronet — a company where your success builds stronger communities, and your future is limitless.

Metronet is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, race, gender, religion, age, national origin, color, disability, or veteran status. EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran

Pay Range: $75,000 - $95,000/yr.

raw.description:
💼 Senior Deployed AI Engineer (Gemini)

🌎 Peru, Argentina, Brazil

🏠 Remote

About Our Client

Our client is a global data and AI consulting firm serving enterprise clients across multiple industries, including FMCG, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, and the public sector, with a team of data and AI experts spread across 20+ countries.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Deployed AI Engineer specialized in Gemini Enterprise and the Google AI stack to design, build, and deliver full-stack AI products for enterprise clients. You'll work embedded with clients, take AI features from idea to production, and serve as the team's reference for Google's enterprise AI platform.

You'll own your components end to end: the front end, the service behind it, the data and retrieval pipelines feeding it, the deployment, and the evaluations proving it works. Beyond Google platform depth, you'll be expected to deliver confidently across the full stack, including full-stack development, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and client communication.

Responsibilities

  • Develop user-facing interfaces in TypeScript and React, along with the backend services and APIs behind them in Python or Node
  • Implement agentic behavior including orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, and guardrails
  • Build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector and hybrid search
  • Design and build agents with Gemini models, Vertex AI, the Agent Development Kit, and Agent Engine
  • Implement and configure Gemini Enterprise for clients, including Agent Designer, the Inbox for managing long-running agents, and agent sandboxes
  • Connect Gemini Enterprise to client application landscapes through first-party and partner connectors with proper permissions, governance, and auditability
  • Build grounded, retrieval-backed applications with Vertex AI Search, RAG Engine, grounding with Google Search, and BigQuery as the data backbone
  • Implement agent interoperability through the A2A protocol and MCP, and track Google's releases closely to translate new capabilities into client value
  • Write evaluation suites and regression tests for LLM-powered features, monitoring cost, latency, and quality in production
  • Deploy on cloud infrastructure across GCP, Azure, or AWS, and build and maintain the data pipelines feeding AI systems
  • Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Cursor daily with good judgment about verification and review
  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, and blockers clearly to clients and project leads, and support pre-sales when needed
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal accelerators, reusable components, and engineering standards

What We're Looking For

  • 3 to 5 years of software or data engineering experience, with extensive hands-on use of AI tools and LLM-based development over the past year
  • Strong hands-on experience with the Google AI stack, including Gemini models, Vertex AI, and ideally Gemini Enterprise or ADK, with at least one solution taken to production on GCP
  • Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript or JavaScript, with experience building and consuming APIs
  • Experience with front-end development in React or similar frameworks, and at least one backend framework
  • Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector search, and with at least one agentic framework such as Google ADK, LangGraph, or LangChain
  • Strong working experience with GCP; Azure or AWS is a plus
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Cursor, and experience building and maintaining data pipelines
  • Professional English proficiency at C1 or C2 level minimum, as you'll work daily with international clients and colleagues
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • A Google Cloud certification is a strong differentiator at application; if you don't hold one yet, obtaining one within the first two months is required, with exam sponsorship and prep time provided. The preferred certification is Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, covering Vertex AI, generative AI, and production ML

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MCP servers, multi-agent patterns, or LLM evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or promptfoo
  • Experience with Terraform or CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with GCP, BigQuery, or Google Workspace integrations alongside Gemini Enterprise

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US business hours

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A GitHub link or portfolio showing AI systems or full-stack projects you've built and shipped in production, with a focus on the Google AI stack or agentic work
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, walking through one production AI system you owned end to end on the Google stack, and explaining how you approached evaluation and reliability alongside the feature build

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

raw.description:
Director of Talent Acquisition

About SSA

Scientific Safety Alliance (SSA) exists to Accelerate Science. Delightfully. We provide mission-critical safety and compliance services to pharmaceutical, biotech, hospital and research organizations across the US, Puerto Rico, the UK and Europe. Since 2023 we have grown from $0 to $20M EBITDA with no outside equity (#175 on the Inc. 5000).

The Opportunity: Director of Talent

SSA has acquired 28 companies in three and a half years, and our ability to keep growing depends on finding, hiring, and keeping exceptional people. As our Director of Talent, you will oversee SSA's talent acquisition function and build our global talent attraction strategy across every branch in the United States, Puerto Rico, the United Kingdom, and Austria. You will lead our recruiting team and turn a decentralized, branch-by-branch approach to hiring into one scalable, global engine that brings in field service technicians, engineers, scientists, and corporate professionals at the speed our business demands.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who loves both strategy and execution. You will partner closely with branch leaders and the executive team to forecast hiring needs, build pipelines for hard-to-fill technical roles, build an employer brand that attracts top talent in every market where we operate, and give leaders the data they need to make good hiring decisions. You will also play a key part in our acquisition strategy, helping integrate newly acquired teams and planning the talent needed as each branch grows. If you want to build a best-in-class talent function at a fast-growing, employee-owned company, we want to talk to you.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Global talent attraction strategy: Design and execute SSA's global talent attraction strategy across the U.S., Puerto Rico, the U.K., and Austria, defining how and where we find talent in each market and aligning it with business growth, acquisitions, and branch-level forecasts.
  • Talent acquisition oversight: Own SSA's full talent acquisition function, including recruiting operations, sourcing, hiring standards, and candidate experience, for every branch and corporate role.
  • Team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop SSA's team of recruiters; set clear goals, manage priorities across branches, and build a high-performing, accountable culture.
  • Branch partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to branch leaders and executives on workforce planning, role design, compensation positioning, and selection decisions.
  • Technical and field hiring: Build sourcing channels and talent pipelines for hard-to-fill roles such as field service technicians, certification specialists, engineers, and laboratory professionals, including partnerships with technical schools, military transition programs, and industry networks.
  • Process and systems: Standardize the end-to-end recruiting process, from requisition approval through offer; own SSA's applicant tracking system and recruiting technology, and hand new hires off seamlessly to the HR team for onboarding.
  • Global employer brand: Build SSA's employer brand across all of our markets, including careers content, social presence, and candidate messaging, highlighting our employee ownership, culture, and mission to Accelerate Science. Delightfully.
  • Metrics and reporting: Build talent dashboards covering time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and new-hire retention, and use the data to improve results.
  • M&A integration: Support due diligence and integration of acquired companies, including talent assessments, retention of key employees, and post-close hiring plans.
  • Vendors and budget: Manage recruiting agencies, job boards, and talent acquisition budget to get the best return on every dollar spent.
  • Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with employment laws in every country and state where we operate, including EEO, pay transparency, and background check requirements.

Deliverables & Outcomes

  • A documented global talent attraction strategy, with clear sourcing plans for each country and role family.
  • A single, documented recruiting process used consistently across all branches.
  • A recognizable SSA employer brand that drives a growing share of direct applicants and referrals.
  • Reduced time-to-fill, with clear targets set by role family (field, technical, corporate).
  • Healthy pipelines in place for critical, hard-to-fill technical roles before openings occur.
  • Strong offer acceptance rates and 90-day and first-year retention of new hires.
  • Lower reliance on, and spend with, outside recruiting agencies.
  • Monthly talent reporting delivered to branch and executive leadership.
  • A recruiting team that is well-trained, accountable, and consistently meeting its goals.
  • Acquired companies integrated with key talent retained and hiring plans in place.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of talent acquisition experience, including 3+ years leading a recruiting team.
  • Proven success building a talent attraction or employer branding strategy across multiple countries or regions.
  • Proven success building or scaling a talent function in a high-growth, multi-location organization; experience in a private equity-backed or acquisitive company strongly preferred.
  • Track record of hiring field service, skilled trades, technical, or scientific talent at volume.
  • Experience with recruiting across multiple states and, ideally, internationally (U.K., EU, or Puerto Rico).
  • Strong command of recruiting metrics, with the ability to turn data into action.
  • Experience selecting, implementing, or managing an applicant tracking system and modern recruiting tools.
  • Excellent influencing and communication skills, with credibility among executives, branch leaders, and candidates alike.
  • A builder's mindset: comfortable creating structure where little exists and moving quickly.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred.

Benefits

  • Equity ownership in SSA
  • 401k Match
  • 100% paid Medical Dental & Vision insurance
  • Health insurance (100% for employee and family)
  • Life insurance
  • Generous Paid time off
  • Parental leave
Salary: $140,000 – $180,000 / year
