raw.description:
Immersive Fusion (immersivefusion.com) is redefining the Application Performance Monitoring and Management (APM) space with a focus on 3D and VR in addition to conventional user experiences. Our flagship product, Immersive APM, serves engineers, architects, operations, and quality assurance personnel to troubleshoot, diagnose and improve their applications. We believe the power of ambient information, rapid feedback loops, and improved ergonomics will revolutionize the APM industry.

THIS IS A PART-TIME, REMOTE, COMMISSION-ONLY POSITION

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Sales Development Representative to join our team. As a Sales Development Representative, you will be responsible for generating new business opportunities and driving revenue growth through the sale of our application performance monitoring tools. This is a remote position with flexible working hours and a commission-only compensation structure.

Responsibilities:

  • Prospect and generate new business leads through various channels, including cold-calling, email, and social media
  • Conduct research to identify potential customers and their needs
  • Qualify leads and set up meetings for the sales team to close deals
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets
  • Build and maintain relationships with customers and provide exceptional customer service
  • May attend industry events and conferences to network and generate leads
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and product knowledge
  • Provide feedback for marketing material to ensure it is effective and engaging
  • Contribute to the improvement of marketing and sales materials by providing insights and suggestions
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop materials that meet the needs of the target audience
  • Use customer feedback and market research to inform the creation of marketing and sales materials
  • Ensure that all marketing and sales materials are consistent with brand guidelines and messaging
  • Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of marketing and sales materials and make improvements as needed.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales, preferably in application performance monitoring tools
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Familiarity with observability tools and industry, OpenTelemetry is preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is a plus

Skill Enhancement:

  • B2B sales experience, including lead generation, prospecting, and closing deals
  • Experience with start-up business development, including building a sales pipeline and scaling a business
  • Marketing and content creation skills for a target audience, including writing effective sales pitches and creating engaging marketing materials
  • Customer relationship management skills, including building and maintaining long-lasting relationships with clients
  • Understanding of market research and analysis to identify customer needs and preferences
  • Proficiency in using sales tools and techniques to effectively manage the sales process
  • Collaboration and teamwork skills to work effectively with other members of the sales and marketing team

Compensation:

  • One-month trial period or until the first customer subscription is procured, after which the onboarding process to the company with a company email address will be conducted
  • Commission-only compensation structure with a 25% commission rate on every subscription monthly amount for the first three months for Basic, Professional, and Enterprise packages
  • Commissions are issued 30 days after the billing cycle and only apply to active subscriptions
  • Opportunity for growth and advancement within the company based on performance and potential
  • After a year of successful employment, there will be opportunities for company share ownership, providing additional incentives for long-term commitment and success.

Metered Billing:

  • Metered billing system is used to determine customer invoice amount each month
  • Invoice amount is based on the number of nodes and amount of data storage used by the customer
  • The amount of the invoice may fluctuate from month to month based on customer usage
  • This system allows for fair and accurate billing based on actual usage, rather than a flat rate
  • Customers are able to monitor their usage and adjust their usage as needed to control costs
  • The metered billing system provides transparency and clarity in billing, ensuring that customers are only charged for what they actually use.

Commission example:

Immersive Fusion lists plan pricing on our web site. Metered billing based on node code and data storage determines the customer invoice amount for any given month. Customer invoice amount may fluctuate based on usage.

Customer A subscribed to the Visualize plan on May 1st, with a monthly fee of $20. The customer maintains 50 nodes across their environments each month, with minimal data retention (which is not factored into this example). As a result, the customer's total invoice amount is $1000 per month. The possible commission amount for this subscription would be $250, which will be paid for the first three months of the subscription. If the subscription remains active, commission payments will be issued on July 5th, August 5th and September 5th. Offer ID: on 4de920cb-9fa7-4797-bda4-fe7aad5c7f5f our affiliate portal.

Development representatives are entitled to receive commissions even after they have willfully terminated their employment.

If you are a self-starter with a passion for sales and a strong understanding of application performance monitoring tools, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Immersive Fusion, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Job Description:

Technical Adoption Manager – Application Networking & Security
The Elevator Pitch: Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?

  • Do you "live and breathe" Security Tools and Security Concepts such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, and Security/Trust Zones?
  • Are you fascinated by Application Load Balancing and multi-cloud application service?
  • Are you always looking for better and more efficient ways of performing common data center tasks?
  • Are you insanely curious and knowledgeable about the way that modern data centers work?
  • Hyper-converged Infrastructure is changing the landscape of data centers…are you part of the revolution?
  • Want to join an innovative team of Customer Advocates?
  • You will consult closely with customers to ensure their satisfaction and return on investment of VMware solutions. You are the customer’s primary liaison into VMware and are accountable for identifying and directly addressing all business and technical issues impacting customer success.
  • You will engage resources across the entire VMware organization (sales, product management, education, R&D, and support). You will actively expand adoption of VMware solutions within accounts by driving relationships at every level, both internally and externally, to influence positive change. In addition to the customer facing activities, TAMs report key account metrics and insight to VMware internal teams and contribute to TAM program development activities.

Success in the Role: What are the performance outcomes over the first 6-12 months you will work toward completing?

  • Establish long-term relationships within assigned accounts while developing an understanding of the client’s strategic goals and overall impact on business results.
  • Provide project leadership, coordination and architectural guidance for the customer’s Network Virtualization and major VMware initiatives.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional VMware project teams which could consist of VMware consultants, engineers, product management and support staff.
  • Map additional VMware solutions to the customer’s unique business and technical requirements
  • Maintain a current knowledge of VMware’s load balancing and security solutions, along with a high-level technical knowledge of VMware’s product line and future product direction.
  • Lead and drive challenging requests across simultaneous client engagements.
  • Provide clear and constructive product feedback to VMware Product Management teams based on customer use-cases and requirements.
  • Understand the customer’s high-level business challenges while functioning as an advisory resource for “Best Practices” and driving adoption of VMware solutions within your accounts.
  • Managing customer engagement milestones
  • Customer Advocate; extraordinary customer liaison
  • Map VMware solutions to the customer’s unique business and technical requirements to ensure strategic long-term value
  • Understand the customer’s relevant business challenges while functioning as a trusted advisor for “best practices” and drive adoption of VMware solutions within your assigned accounts
  • Agility: respond to the needs of your customers with confidence and ease

The Work: What type of work will you be doing? What requirements, skills, or assignments will you be performing on a regular basis?

As part of the Application Networking and Security TAM team, you will be working for a long-term period with a small number of assigned customers or dedicated accounts. Along with the VMware account teams, you will:

  • 5+ years’ proven strong networking experience and knowledge of VMware networking products.
  • 2+ years proven experience in customer-facing positions in a role (e.g. TAM or technology consultant preferably with a management consulting, IT vendor or professional services organization)
  • BS degree preferred or relevant years experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
  • Must have solid knowledge and understanding of VMware products including core product suite, virtualization, networking and security products, solutions, and services.
  • Must have solid technical background in advanced networking and security (preferably with technical certifications). Additionally, a background in data center infrastructure, operating systems, desktop deployments, system administration and/or technical architecture is preferred.
  • Travel: Although this is a home-office based position, candidates must have the ability to travel up to 20% locally/regionally (NOTE: Most travel will be local or within the nearby region, and there will likely be a few out of state/country client visits and/or 1-2 conferences or training that require travel throughout the year)
  • Domain-level understanding of Cloud Infrastructure & Networking (Data Center Design, Network Architecture, Network Design, System Architecture Virtualization, Systems Management, Security)
  • Network Security Tools and Network Security Concepts such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, and Security/Trust Zones.
  • Network components and concepts such as: Routers, switches, load balancers, and other networking and security components from a variety of vendors. Virtual networking components such as VSG, Nexus 1000V, and vDS Networking protocols such as BGP & OSPF VLANs, VPN, Unicast vs Multicast, Management Networks, IP subnetting, and network design.
  • Demonstrable experience and deep knowledge of the networking and load balancer technologies and vendors such as Cisco, F5, Riverbed, Force10, Vyatta/Brocade, A10 Networks, Arista, Infoblox, Palo Alto Networks
  • Experience with integrating heterogeneous networking and security environments
  • Understanding of modern IT and DevOps production data center and Cloud (ISP/ASP) operations.
  • Familiarity with systems management concepts, processes and standards (e.g. SNMP); capacity/performance management and tuning
  • Fast learner with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Strong business insight and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence internal and external partners at all levels.
  • Effective working independently and in a team setting.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple client demands.
  • Superb communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate effectively and build relationships with CxO level personnel.

Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law.

If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence.

Job Title: Senior CTM, Internal Medicine (Dermatology, Nephrology, Cardiovascular, Women's

Job Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

Join Us as a Senior Clinical Team Manager within our Internal Medicine Therapeutic Business Unit- Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

The Senior Clinical Trial Manager is accountable for achieving the final clinical deliverable (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. Interprets data on complex issues and makes good business decisions with support from line management. The role involves working to ensure that all clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations, and maintaining profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the clinical team. Typically the Senior Clinical Trial Manager works independently on projects of moderate to high complexity, and may assume regional lead or Clinical Study Manager responsibilities.


The therapeutic scope includes Cardiovascular & Internal Medicine- This need is for Nephrology, Dermatology, GI, (UC/CD), Cardiovascular (in particular Cardiovascular outcome trials), Liver, Nephrology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Diabetes, Obesity, Dyslipidemia, Women's Health, Rheumatology, (RA, SLE, Gout), Endocrinology.


We are currently looking for experienced CTMs who are currently working in at least one or more of the above indications.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage all clinical operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of moderate to high complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Lead CTM responsibilities on regional level, Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities or take on additional responsibilities, e.g. process improvements, manage complex programs, have wider management or project coordination responsibilities.
    •Develop clinical tools (e.g. Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the Data Quality Plan. Contribute to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensure timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborate with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings.
    •Collaborate with the clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicate with the team and leads team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department.
    •Ensure achievement of the final clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitor clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. May routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials.
    •Communicate with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study-related issues.
    •May coordinate all start-up activities, and ensure that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Ensure timely regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Reviews and follows up on all questions raised by ethics committees. Responsibility may vary based on project timelines.
    •Provide input into preparation of forecast estimates for clinical activities.
    •Responsible for clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements.
    •In North America, where assigned to GPHS (Government & Public Health Studies) projects, may have limited line management responsibilities.

    Education & Experience Requirements:
    •Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
    •Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 8+ years).

    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:
    •Strong leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teams.
    •Strong planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload and workload of team members
    •Strong interpersonal and problem solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organization
    •Solid understanding of change management principles
    •Comprehensive understanding of the practices, processes, and requirements of clinical monitoring
    •Strong judgment, decision making, escalation, and risk management skills
    •Effective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiency
    •Capable of evaluating own and team members workload against project budget and adjust resources accordingly
    •Strong financial acumen and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management
    •Strong attention to detail
    •In-depth understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc.
    •Strong computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.
    •Capable of independently managing clinical only studies.


    Why Join Us?

    When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

    Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

We are unable to consider junior applications at this time.

ROLE SUMMARY

This role is strategic leader for Investigator Contract and Budget negotiations for all Pfizer Portfolio globally. They function as the primary SME delegated from ELT for authorised signatory processing related to Site Contracting.

Functionally leads a multi regional team of contract professionals to execute and/or oversee all investigator site contracts.

Partners with Country Operations Enablement Lead in developing and implementing processes for effectively and efficiently triaging and managing contract requests with excellent compliance to legal and financial controls

Responsible for maintenance and delivery of operational guidelines in Investigative Site contracting and budgets

Collaborates with invoicing specialists and/or invoice service provider and Site Budgets Team to ensure alignment with lnvestigative Site contracting and compensation requirements.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Accountable for global and local compliance with all legal and financial laws and controls, including Sarbanes-Oxley, Transparency Laws, Data Privacy Laws.

Leads a team of contract professionals to facilitate clinical related investigator site and specialty contracts

Ensures alignment with a team of budget professionals to manage per subject cost development, ensuring benchmark value is applied.

Serves as primary subject matter expert for all potential integration activities ensuring smooth adoption of contracting terms and continuous payment for integrated studies.

Sets strategic priorities to continuously improve processes to ensure contract quality.

Ensures priority actions are taken in response to changes in legal, finance or compliance external factors, including trade controls, inflation and inspection or audit findings.

Accountable for oversight of Contract Research Organizations, performing duties in scope of the Site Contracting group.

Provides situational outsourcing consultation and guidance

Accountable for the escalation of significant budget exceptions to leadership for consideration

Accountable for management of key performance expectations for Site Contracting.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Demonstrates advanced understanding of legal concepts and principles as they relate to all clinical trial contractual documents.

Advanced degree (JD, MBA or other graduate degree), professional qualification, or extensive experience

in clinical development operations or clinical trial outsourcing

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience with investigator contracts and negotiation principles, practices, processes, and activities

Demonstrated experience building Investigative Site budgets, understanding of protocol-required procedures and contingent cost coverage as they relate to constructing, modifying, and negotiating budgets.

Demonstrated understanding of global issues around investigator budgets and FMV principles including country and region specific knowledge.

Solid negotiation skills, with the ability to arbitrate difficult situations to reach an equitable outcome

Demonstrated understanding of finance and activity based budgeting

Excellent analytical and financial skills

Excellent oral/written communication skills

Experience with Ariba Contract Workbench, Grants Manager, Grants Plan and I or other industry cost and planning tools preferred


Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Work Location Assignment: Remote

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $214,900.00 to $358,100.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer.

U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future.

Sunshine Act

These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.

Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
Working within the Finance Controller's Office, the Director, Finance Shared Service and Experience provides strategic and operational leadership for AskFinance, the finance shared services function supporting Stanford Health Care Finance. This role is responsible for service delivery, intake and case management operations, performance oversight, process standardization, customer experience, and continuous improvement. The director partners closely with finance leaders, subject matter experts, and enabling teams to strengthen service effectiveness, advance operational discipline, and scale shared services capabilities in alignment with organizational priorities.

Locations

Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • AskFinance Operations and Service Delivery:

  • Lead AskFinance operations, including intake and triage, case management, escalation processes, and day-to-day service delivery.

  • Oversee staffing, workload balancing, and resource planning to meet service demand and operational priorities.

  • Monitor service volumes, cycle times, backlog, quality, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities and drive performance.

  • Service Strategy, Metrics, and Governance:

  • Establish and monitor service levels, operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting to assess performance and drive accountability.

  • Lead governance for AskFinance, including escalation pathways, service review routines, prioritization, and performance communication to leadership.

  • Define and evolve the AskFinance service model, including service scope, intake pathways, routing logic, service catalog, escalation criteria, and ownership across shared services and subject matter teams.

  • Ensure operational controls, documentation, and standard work align with Finance policies, service expectations, and audit requirements.

  • Process Design and Continuous Improvement:

  • Develop and maintain standardized procedures, workflows, decision trees, and knowledge resources to support consistent service delivery.

  • Partner with enabling teams, including technology and process owners, to enhance tools, workflows, reporting, and user experience.

  • Lead continuous improvement efforts that strengthen service quality, operational discipline, and the effectiveness of Finance shared services.

  • Develop and advance a strategic roadmap for AskFinance to mature, expand, and scale services in alignment with organizational priorities.

  • Stakeholder Partnership and Service Coordination:

  • Partner with Finance leaders and subject matter experts to define support models, clarify ownership, improve handoffs, and strengthen issue resolution.

  • Build effective relationships across Stanford Medicine to understand business needs, align priorities, and identify service opportunities.

  • Collaborate with operational, technical, and enabling partners to support service consistency, issue resolution, and operating model effectiveness.

  • Partner with the program and change management team to support readiness, communications, training coordination, and adoption of new processes, tools, and service enhancements.

  • Customer Experience and Communications:

  • Gather stakeholder and customer feedback to improve the AskFinance experience and strengthen service delivery.

  • Lead communications regarding service priorities, performance, and changes affecting AskFinance customers and stakeholders.

  • Team Leadership and Culture:

  • Lead, coach, and develop staff while fostering a customer-focused, accountable, and continuously improving culture. Perform supervisory responsibilities including interviewing, hiring, training, performance management, employee relations, and other personnel actions as needed.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelors Degree from an accredited college or university.

  • Master Degree preferred from accredited college or university.

Experience Qualifications

  •  Eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in shared services, finance operations, customer support operations, or other relevant operational leadership roles.

  • Experience leading service-oriented operations with accountability for performance, staffing, workflow management, and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience improving operational processes, service delivery models, reporting, knowledge resources, or customer support practices in a complex organization.

  • Experience in finance shared services, ERP support, service desk operations, or business operations within healthcare, an academic medical center, or a similarly matrixed environment preferred.

  • Experience with service management, case management, workflow, or reporting tools to support operational oversight and continuous improvement preferred.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • AskFinance Operations and Service Delivery:

  • Ability to lead service-oriented operations with a focus on service quality, responsiveness, operational discipline, and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong knowledge of intake, triage, case management, workflow oversight, and escalation management.

  • Service Strategy, Metrics, and Governance:

  • Strong knowledge of service metrics, reporting, dashboards, service model design, and governance practices.

  • Ability to establish service standards, intake and routing frameworks, service catalog definitions, escalation paths, and operating routines.

  • Strong understanding of operational controls, documentation standards, policy compliance, and audit readiness.

  • Process Design and Continuous Improvement:

  • Strong knowledge of process standardization, knowledge management, and service delivery practices.

  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, implement operational enhancements, and strengthen service effectiveness.

  • Strategic thinking related to service maturity, scalability, and roadmap development.

  • Stakeholder Partnership and Service Coordination:

  • Ability to build effective partnerships across finance, operational, technical, and program teams in a complex, highly matrixed organization.

  • Strong collaboration, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to clarify ownership and drive cross-functional alignment.

  • Ability to support change adoption through stakeholder engagement, communications, and training coordination in partnership with the team responsible for change management.

  • Customer Experience and Communications:

  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor communications to varied audiences.

  • Commitment to customer service excellence and continuous enhancement of the user experience.

  • Team Leadership and Culture:

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop teams while fostering an accountable, customer-focused, and continuously improving culture.

  • Strong judgment, prioritization, and leadership skills, with the ability to manage competing demands and drive results through others.

These principles apply to ALL employees:

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience

Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.

You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:

  • Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care

raw.description:
South Africa, a role for someone who decides

This opening is for South Africa. Take ten minutes over our website and LinkedIn first. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. If your answers could belong to any company, they will fall at this stage.

The company and the job

Drop Zero Digital is a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person in South Africa who is good at making decisions. The AI image service is our fastest growing line, and your area, whichever it is, will help it along.

You will have one named area. It is chosen in the trial, after we have seen where your strengths lie. It will be one of two:

  1. The hiring machine: how people are found, screened and hired here. The funnel runs through you from sourcing to scheduling, with chasing, an accurate tracker, and a warning to us when the process has a fault.
  2. Client delivery operations: how client work is planned, briefed, chased and shipped. You hold the timelines, brief the team in full and keep tasks from going quiet.

At heart it is one job. You see something slip, decide the answer and close it before being asked.

We want a decider, not an assistant and not a coordinator. Every day brings real calls, and we weigh the quality of them above the volume. We want a team that decides well without management, which means this is not the job for anyone who waits for instructions each morning.

What we need to see in you

  1. You make decisions and answer for them, including bad ones.
  2. You know whose call it is, yours or someone else's, and you get that right either way.
  3. You use feedback and change, without giving up a view you have good reason for.
  4. You get better fast. A person at seventy percent and climbing is worth more than one flat at eighty five.
  5. You tell us when something is failing, even when it is our process at fault.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially when the subject is a problem.

Steps from application to trial

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

Our decision is made in the trial, and so is the choice of your area. You work on live work from week one and hear straight how each decision landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

On experience

No number of years is asked for. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever you list is verified, covering employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. Having held a full-time job in the last 12 months is the one requirement. Beyond that there is no minimum, so a short history costs you nothing. Misrepresenting what you have is disqualifying, and the true account is never held against you.

Requirements

      1. Full time once hired, and it is your only job. During the paid trial you put in 4 hours a day, 2 of them at a fixed time within our working day, and you can keep your current job. Pass, and you give notice and come on full time within 30 days.
      2. Internet you can rely on: minimum 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in South Africa.
      5. You track your working hours in our time tracking tool from the start.

Benefits

1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

For those who earn it, responsibility and pay grow quickly. Authority over decisions that reach a client grows slowly and deliberately, and comes from a track record, not a good first month. We would rather you knew that now than found out two months in.

Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.

Managed Services Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead


The Managed Services Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead provides independent oversight of the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of Managed Services delivery across the client portfolio.

The role operates separately from day-to-day Service Delivery and Service Management. While those teams manage operational performance, SLAs, incidents, requests, problems, changes, and client governance, this role looks beneath traditional service metrics to identify opportunities that may not surface through normal operational management.


The role uses ticket-level, analyst-level, knowledge-management, client-process, and service-performance data to identify opportunities to:

  • Improve the consistency and effectiveness of analyst execution.
  • Identify analyst coaching, training, and knowledge needs.
  • Improve ticket resolution quality, speed, and efficiency.
  • Reduce unnecessary escalations and handoffs.
  • Improve knowledge articles and knowledge utilization.
  • Identify recurring demand that could be eliminated.
  • Increase client self-service and automation.
  • Recommend client process changes that reduce ticket volumes.
  • Identify systemic opportunities that can be applied across multiple Managed Services clients.

The overarching objective is not simply to determine whether Nordic is meeting SLAs, but to determine how the service can continuously become better, faster, more consistent, and less dependent on manual support.


Experience Required

  • 10+ years of experience in IT services, managed services, IT operations, service management, continuous improvement, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience working within a managed services or recurring IT support environment, preferably supporting complex enterprise or healthcare clients.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing ticket-level and operational performance data to identify recurring issues, resolution inefficiencies, knowledge gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • Experience evaluating analyst-level work patterns to identify coaching, training, knowledge, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end service lifecycle, including incident, request, problem, change, escalation, and knowledge management.
  • Experience identifying drivers of ticket demand and developing strategies for:
    • Ticket elimination and deflection
    • Shift-left
    • Self-service
    • Automation and self-healing
    • Knowledge improvement
    • Process simplification
  • Experience conducting root-cause analysis and translating findings into corrective and preventive actions.
  • Experience identifying systemic issues across multiple clients, teams, applications, or service areas rather than evaluating individual incidents in isolation.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently from Delivery and Service Management while constructively challenging existing practices and identifying issues that may not be visible through routine operational reporting.
  • Experience presenting quality findings, trends, and recommended improvements to senior operational leaders and client stakeholders.
  • Healthcare IT experience strongly preferred, particularly within Epic application support, Service Desk, infrastructure, security, ServiceNow, or other healthcare managed services environments.
  • Establishing or leading a Managed Services quality or continuous improvement function.
  • Developing quality frameworks, assessment methodologies, or service health scorecards.
  • Building cross-client benchmarks and identifying reusable best practices.
  • Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL continual improvement, or similar improvement methodologies.
  • Experience converting operational findings into measurable client outcomes such as reduced ticket demand, faster resolution, greater self-service adoption, or improved end-user experience.

Education & Certifications

  • Equivalent combination of education and significant relevant managed services experience may be considered.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following would be beneficial:

  • ITIL 4 Foundation or advanced ITIL certification
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
  • ServiceNow certifications or formal ServiceNow training
  • Quality-management or continuous-improvement certifications
  • Relevant Epic certifications or significant Epic operational experience for candidates coming from healthcare IT

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply, including women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans.

The AI Operations Administrator is a member of the IT Engineering & Operations function, responsible for the administration, configuration, and day-to-day operation of SitusAMC’s enterprise AI tools and the API management layer that connects and governs them. The role centers on Gravitee, the API management and gateway platform through which AI services, integrations, and agent traffic are published, secured, and monitored, and on the enterprise AI tools in use across the business: ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Microsoft Copilot. Hands-on Gravitee experience is essential to this role. The Administrator keeps these platforms secure, available, and well-documented, provides operational support to users, and supplies the logs, usage data, and configuration records needed to support audit and governance reporting.

As a regulated service provider to major financial institutions, SitusAMC is subject to client, regulatory, and contractual obligations governing AI use. This role implements and operates platform configuration to the requirements defined by Information Security and AI GRC. Governance, policy, risk acceptance, control requirements, and independent control assurance remain with those teams, and design and build of enterprise security infrastructure remains with Information Security Architecture and Engineering. The Administrator does not set or self-attest the control baseline. The position works under the direction of senior engineering and architecture staff and provides a foundation for growth into the AI Operations Engineer role.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Administer and operate the Gravitee API management platform as the primary responsibility of the role, including environments, organizations, gateways, management console, developer portal, users, groups, and role-based access.
  • Configure and maintain APIs, plans, applications, and subscriptions in Gravitee for AI services, LLM provider endpoints, and AI-related integrations, applying the authentication, authorization, rate-limiting, quota, and traffic-control policies defined by AI GRC and Information Security.
  • Manage the API lifecycle in Gravitee, including publishing, versioning, promotion across environments, and deprecation, following change control and maintaining configuration in version control (e.g., through Gravitee management APIs, the Kubernetes operator, or exported definitions).
  • Operate and maintain Gravitee gateways and supporting components, including monitoring, patching and version upgrades, certificate and secret rotation, capacity, and high availability, in partnership with Infrastructure and Information Security Engineering.
  • Onboard approved AI use cases, connectors, MCP servers, and agent endpoints onto Gravitee using standard policy templates, and verify that traffic is authenticated, logged, and routed only through approved paths.

  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise AI tools such as ChatGPT (Enterprise or Business), Claude (Team or Enterprise), Cursor, and Microsoft Copilot, including admin console configuration, SSO/SCIM integration, role-based access, and license management. Experience with several of these tools is expected; experience with all four is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of API concepts and security, including REST, HTTP troubleshooting, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, API keys, mTLS, rate limiting, and gateway patterns.
  • Experience with SSO, SCIM provisioning, and role-based access using an enterprise identity provider (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID or Okta).

raw.description:
Operations Associate, remote from Georgia

Georgia is where this hire lives. Give our website and LinkedIn ten minutes before you do anything else. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. We reject answers that could be pasted onto any other company.

Who we are

Drop Zero Digital is a lifecycle marketing agency. Right now our AI image service is the quickest growing part of the business, and the person we hire in Georgia will help it grow through whichever area they run.

What you would do

One named area will be yours. The trial decides which, because we want to see where you are strongest first. Your area will be one of these:

  1. Hiring. You own how we find, screen and hire people: the whole funnel, with sourcing, chasing and scheduling, a tracker that tells the truth, and a warning from you when the process itself is faulty.
  2. Client delivery. You own how client work is planned, briefed, chased and shipped: timelines held, briefs that are complete, and nothing allowed to stall unseen.

Both come down to the same thing. You spot what slipped, you pick the fix, and you finish it unprompted.

The role is built on judgement. You will not be assisting, and you will not be coordinating. Each day brings real decisions, and the measure is how well you make them, not how much you clear. Our aim is a team of people who decide well unmanaged, so a job that starts with someone handing out tasks is not this one.

The people who do well here

  1. They decide and carry the consequences, wrong calls included.
  2. They sort their calls from other people's calls and get that boundary right each time.
  3. They take feedback as information and change, without caving on a view they have reason to hold.
  4. They improve fast: seventy percent and rising is worth more to us than eighty five and flat.
  5. They flag failure when they see it, even when the failing thing is our process.
  6. They write honestly and clearly, particularly when the news is bad.

The steps, start to finish

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial carries the decision, including which of the two areas you end up with. Live work begins in week one, and every call you make gets a straight answer from us on how it landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Experience and checks

We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Each employer you name gets verified on dates, title and paid status, using a contract and payslips, in one exchange. We need one full-time job within the last 12 months. We set no other minimum, so a short history is fine. A misrepresented history is not fine, and it disqualifies. The true version, however short, is never penalised.

Requirements

      1. Full time after hire, as your only job. The paid trial is 4 hours a day, of which 2 sit at a fixed time within our working day, and you may stay in your current job throughout. After a pass you give notice and move to full time within 30 days.
      2. Dependable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, checked live together.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in Georgia.
      5. Your working hours are logged in our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

People who earn it see pay and responsibility rise quickly. Decisions that reach a client are handed over slowly and deliberately, on the strength of a record and never on a good first month. You should hear that now, not discover it in month two.

Why choose iVigee?

iVigee is a physician-lead pharmacovigilance exclusive company, combining deep regulatory expertise with AI-enabled tools (such as iViReg, iViTracker, iViSight) to support clients' drug safety life cycles.

Founded in 2021, all our leaders have years of experience in all areas of pharmacovigilance - science, regulations, and technology. Our acquisition strategy allows us to attract and choose both the best global talent, and companies.

Our world leading Pharmacovigilance Intelligence platform iViReg is the first to truly focus on the needs of PV professionals, and as we open that system up with our AI interface, we continue to embrace the current and future needs of the pharmacovigilance community and demonstrate our commitment to it.

Our advanced expertise in pharmacovigilance and technology keeps us two steps ahead, delivering sustainable, progressive, and seamless solutions. With strategic centres of excellence in Europe and the US, and our network of experts in over 150 countries, we service the complex global needs of our clients with speed and ease.

We hire for values as much as we hire for expertise. Our culture is built on a shared belief in doing PV the right way, with honesty, ambition, and a genuine care for the work. If these values resonate with you, you'll fit right in.

Fearless

We are not afraid of big tasks and challenges. Not timid to speak up, not timid to ask. Always seek and speak the truth.

Trustworthy professionals

Our competence gives us confidence that we will deliver on our promises. We do it with integrity and quality that earns trust. We do it with a smile, as we love our work that makes our clients happy, saves life and prevents harm.

Enabling innovation

Best practices and tools are giving us our competitive advantage. We are early adopters. We iterate frequently to be better than yesterday, every day.

Sustainable manner

We are interested in long-term relationships, lasting solutions, and good work-life balance. We improve our environment, support communities, raise talent, and build our company to last.

As a company applying the Topgrading methodology, we conduct a thorough recruitment process covering your career history, achievements, challenges, important decisions and key professional relationships. At the final stage, shortlisted candidates will be asked to arrange reference calls with selected former supervisors.

Purpose of the job position:

  • To lead and oversee complex pharmacovigilance (PV) projects, ensuring high-quality service delivery in line with regulatory requirements and client expectations
  • To serve as the main point of contact for key PV initiatives and important client projects
  • To provide senior-level guidance, mentorship, and supervision to junior PV colleagues and project teams
  • To contribute to the development and implementation of department strategy, processes, and quality standards

MAJOR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Full responsibility for the delivery of complex PV services to clients, including strategic oversight, planning, and coordination of cross-functional PV activities
  • Authoring or review of PV documents in compliance with the client´s specification, project-specific instruction, internal working rules, and applicable legislation
  • Participation in iVigee quality management system development and maintenance, preparation of internal SOP/working instructions, and preparation of client’s SOPs
  • Compliance of PV activities with legislation, internal and client’s procedures
  • Participate in or lead interactions with regulatory authorities, including inspections and audit responses; act as audit coordinator during vendor qualification audits, audits conducted as a service for clients, inspections by regulatory authorities, or audits performed by clients on iVigee’s PV services
  • Effective deputizing in accordance with the internal responsibility matrix
  • Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across PV project teams
  • Actively participate in management-level meetings and represent the PV department in cross-functional initiatives
  • Maintain current awareness of PV legislation and regulatory guidance and apply it to strategic decision-making
  • Mentor, support, and train junior PV team members; provide input into individual development and performance management
  • Be open to new areas of vigilance (e.g., medical device vigilance, cosmetovigilance) and participate in building relevant systems
  • Support other PV activities as requested

Specific requirements for the position:

Education

University degree in medicine, pharmacology, life sciences or other healthcare professional fields

Experience

5+ years of experience directly in pharmacovigilance

Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF) authoring and management

Local PV Network management

Coordination and management of additional Risk Minimisation Measures (aRMM) — an advantage

EU QPPV or Deputy EU QPPV role — an advantage

Special skills

Managerial and organization skills

Communication skills

Presentation skills

Team working

Ability to motivate people, leadership

Language skills

English (fluent)

Computer skills

Advanced literacy (Microsoft Office applications)

From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

Requirements

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:We’re evolving our engineering culture so every developer learns to build with modern, agentic workflows, eliminating the repetitive friction so we can solve harder, more interesting problems together. You’ll be the person building the tools, establishing the practices, and coaching our team into the next era of software engineering.

As a Senior Software Engineer reporting to the Engineering Manager, your purpose will be to help make the team AI native: half your time building the agentic workflows, tools and guardrails we ship with, half shipping product with them yourself.

  • Design how a ticket moves from idea to merged code, with agents doing almost all of the implementation
  • Build our coding and review agents, MCP integrations, CI hooks and shared skills library
  • Set up review gates and evaluations so agent output meets the same quality and security bar as human work
  • Own the web side of our product in Vue and represent the team in the Web Developers Guild
  • Coach engineers and share what works with other teams to help everyone adopt and master new AI-driven ways of working

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…

  1. Hands-on experience building AI developer tooling others use: agent skills or rules, MCP servers, custom agents or AI steps in CI
  2. Senior-level experience shipping production software, with solid web development in JavaScript or TypeScript
  3. Daily use of coding agents on production work, and a clear view of where they fail and how to catch it
  4. Sound architecture judgement and the ability to change how other engineers work through coaching, curiosity, and practical enablement
  5. At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

It will also help you to have…

  1. Production experience with Vue
  2. Python backend, iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) experience
  3. A track record of leading a change in engineering practice across more than one team

How to stand out: show us something you built, such as skills or MCP servers you wrote, or an agentic workflow you introduced and what changed.

Benefits

  • We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first.
  • Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
  • Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.

Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:

We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at , so we can best support you.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

  • A strong track record of not only meeting, but exceeding KPIs to drive both your and the team’s performance.

  • Brilliant communication skills with an excellent telephone manner and a passion for delighting customers.

  • A growth mindset that is engaged in our mission, helping us to improve how we convert and serve our customers and motivated to collaborate with team mates.

Bonus:

  • Experience working in financial services.

  • A strong background in compliance and call QA.

  • Understanding on the lending/loan market.

The salary

Our base salary range in Leeds is £30,000 - £37,000 + bonus (OTE 20%). Our base salary range in London is £34,000 - £41,000 + bonus (OTE 20%). We want to pay all of our employees fairly, so that’s why we regularly benchmark salaries based on market rates and to recognise your increasing value to our business.

For the first month of the role to complete training, there is a requirement to be in the office three times per week. This will then drop to once/twice per week after completion of training.

The team

Our Account Management team is one of the largest and fastest-growing at iwoca, with nearly 60 Account Managers and more growth ahead. It’s an exciting time to join a team that plays a key role in supporting small businesses.

You’ll be supported by 11 experienced mentors and team leads, focused on coaching and development.

There are clear progression pathways into Senior Account Manager roles, specialist positions, and management, with many team members advancing internally.

Please see the link below to learn more about Conor’s career journey, progressing from a Customer Service Agent to a management role within our organisation.

iwoca.co.uk/inside-iwoca/life-as-a-customer-success-mentor-at-iwoca

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £30K - £41K

raw.title: IT Project Manager
raw.excerpt: Who We AreWelcome to Jolera, where traditional managed services transform into extraordinary IT adventures!
raw.description:
Who We Are

Welcome to Jolera, where traditional managed services transform into extraordinary IT adventures! For over 20 years, we’ve been the backstage tech wizards for MSPs & IT solution providers across the globe, from North America to Europe. We’re not just any company; we are a catalyst for IT magic, creating award winning solutions that empower businesses worldwide. Our team of seasoned experts brings not just skills but passion to the table, ensuring each partner receives customized, top-tier service. Join us and be part of a team that crafts unique IT experiences for Fortune 500 clientele in the US and Canada.

Who You Are

You are the entrepreneurial spirit personified—a Technical IT Project Manager with a knack for 'getting things done.' With your extensive experience in managing IT infrastructure projects, you understand the gravity of scope, schedule, and budget yet know when to think outside the box. You’re not just managing projects; you’re leading quests to conquer technological challenges with creativity and precision, productivity and efficiency are the foundations that drive you.

What You’ll Do

  • Transform high-level scope requirements into actionable, innovative project plans.
  • Steer the project ship through its entire lifecycle, ensuring timely, high-quality deliverables.
  • Maintain an iron grip on scope, schedule, and budget, but with the flair of a startup guru.
  • Proactively sniff out potential issues and risks, taking charge before they become showstoppers.
  • Juggle project dependencies and navigate the critical path with the finesse of a seasoned captain.
  • Deploy resources like a master strategist, ensuring all hands are on deck and fully utilized.
  • Serve as the chief communicator, crafting updates and presentations that keep everyone, from team members to stakeholders, in the loop and motivated.
  • Drive the team forward, mentoring and inspiring like a coach during playoff season.
  • Embrace additional responsibilities with gusto, always adding your unique touch to tasks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify resource requirements, allocate resources efficiently, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Motivate and influence your teams to be successful in their roles.
  • Lead a high-performing team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

This is a remote role that requires working hours aligned with the Eastern Time (ET/EST) zone.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Solid educational background in IT or mountains of relevant experience.
  • Must be located in Bucharest.
  • At least 5 years in the trenches, managing IT infrastructure projects with tenacity and creative flair.
  • A strong understanding of what drives healthy, efficient teams • Holder of a PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
  • Skilled in MS Office, MS Project, or similar tools—your shield and armor in the battle of deadlines.
  • Proven experience in managing sprawling, distributed IT deployments across various terrains (physical and digital).
  • A maestro of virtualization and networking technologies.
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex project scopes into victorious project outcomes.
  • Expert at navigating the complexities of multinational and multi-disciplinary environments.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary and benefits package that appreciates your worth.
  • Perks that make every day a bit more special.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development that will push your career to new heights.
  • Join Jolera and be part of a team that values creativity, drive, and a bit of quirkiness, all while delivering serious results.

At Jolera, we are committed to creating a diverse, equal and inclusive. Our goal is to attract and retain the best talent while embracing diversity in all its forms. We value and respect differences in ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.excerpt: ᐱᔭᕆᐊᖃᒻᒪᕆᒃᑐᖅ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᕐᒥᒃ ᐊᔪᙱᓐᓂᖃᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᖅ: ᑖᓐᓇ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑦ ᐅᖃᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕆᐊᓕᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᕐᓗᒋᑦ ᑲᒪᒋᔭᐅᔪᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑐᐊᖅ ᐅᖃᓪᓚᒍᓐᓇᖅᑐᑦ.
raw.description:
ᐱᔭᕆᐊᖃᒻᒪᕆᒃᑐᖅ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᕐᒥᒃ ᐊᔪᙱᓐᓂᖃᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᖅ: ᑖᓐᓇ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑦ ᐅᖃᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕆᐊᓕᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᕐᓗᒋᑦ ᑲᒪᒋᔭᐅᔪᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑐᐊᖅ ᐅᖃᓪᓚᒍᓐᓇᖅᑐᑦ. ᖃᐅᔨᒪᓂᐊᖅᐳᓯ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅᑖᕋᓱᒃᑐᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑦ ᐅᖃᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᙱᑦᑐᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᒋᔭᐅᔪᓐᓇᔾᔮᙱᑦᑐᑦ.

CCA−ᑯᓐᓂ, ᓇᓗᓇᐃᖅᓯᒃᑲᓐᓂᖅᐳᒍᑦ ᖃᓄᖅ ᑲᑎᖅᓱᖅᑕᐅᔪᓐᓇᕐᒪᖔᑕ. ᐃᓄᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᒃᐱᒍᓱᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒃᐳᒍᑦ, ᑐᓴᐅᒪᖃᑎᒌᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒃᖢᑕ, ᑕᐅᑐᒐᖃᓪᓗᐊᑕᖅᖢᑕᓗ ᓇᓂᓯᓇᓱᒃᖢᑕ ᐋᖅᑭᒍᑎᒃᓴᓪᓚᑦᑖᓂᒃ−ᐊᑭᓖᓇᓱᑐᐃᓐᓇᙱᖦᖢᑕ.

ᐅᒃᐱᕆᔭᖃᕈᕕᑦ ᓇᒡᓕᒍᓱᖕᓂᖅ ᐊᑑᑎᖃᕐᓂᖓᓂᒃ, ᐱᓗᐊᙳᐊᖅᖢᓂ ᑭᓇᑐᐃᓐᓇᕐᒥᒃ ᐊᒃᓱᕈᕐᓇᖅᑐᒃᑰᖅᑐᖃᖅᑎᓪᓗᒍ ᐃᓅᓯᕐᒥᓂ, ᑖᓐᓇ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅ ᐱᕕᒃᓴᖃᖅᑎᑦᑎᕗᖅ ᑐᑭᖃᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᒥᒃ ᐊᒃᑐᖅᓯᓂᖃᕈᓐᓇᕐᓂᕐᒥᒃ. ᑲᑎᖃᑎᖃᖃᑦᑕᕐᓂᐊᖅᐳᑎᑦ ᐃᓄᖕᓂᒃ, ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᐃᕙᒡᓗᑎᑦ, ᓈᓚᒃᐸᒡᓗᑎᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᖅᑐᖅᑕᐅᙱᓪᓗᑎᑦ, ᐃᑲᔪᖅᐸᒡᓗᒋᓪᓗ ᐊᔪᕆᖅᓲᔾᔨᕙᒡᓗᑎᑦ ᑮᓇᐅᔭᑎᒍᑦ ᐊᒃᓱᕈᕐᓇᖅᑐᒃᑰᖅᑎᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᔨᒻᒪᕆᐅᓗᑎᒃ ᐃᒃᐱᒋᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒡᓗᒋᓪᓗ.

ᕿᓂᖅᑐᒍᑦ ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᓕᕆᔨᒥᒃ ᑐᑭᓯᐅᒪᔪᒥᒃ ᐱᒻᒪᕆᐅᓂᖓᓂᒃ ᑐᓴᐅᒪᖃᑎᒌᖕᓂᖅ, ᐅᒃᐱᕆᔭᐅᓂᖅ, ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᖅ ᓄᓇᕗᒻᒥ ᓄᓇᓕᖕᓂ. ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅᑖᖅᑐᖅ ᐊᑐᕐᓂᐊᖅᑐᖅ ᖃᓪᓗᓈᑎᑐᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᓪᓗ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᕐᒥᓂᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᕐᓂᕐᒥᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᑦᑐᓂᑦ ᐃᑉᐱᒍᓱᑦᓯᐊᕐᓂᕐᒥᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒍᑎᑦᓴᓂᓪᓗ ᑐᕌᒐᖃᕐᓂᕐᒥᑦ ᐅᖃᖃᑎᒌᓐᓂᕐᒥᑦ.

ᑭᓱᓕᕆᔨᐅᖕᒪᖔᑦ

ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᓕᕆᔨᐅᓗᑎᑦ, ᐃᒪᐃᓕᐅᖃᑦᑕᕐᓂᐊᖅᐳᑎᑦ:

  • ᐅᖃᖃᑎᒋᓗᒋᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᑦ ᐊᑭᓖᙱᖦᖢᑎᒃ − ᐃᓚᖏᑦ ᖃᖓᑦᑎᐊᓵᖅ, ᐃᓚᖏᑦ ᐊᑯᓂᐅᔪᒃᑯᑦ
  • ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᓗᓂ ᖃᐅᔨᒋᐊᕐᕕᒃᓴᒥᒃ ᑎᑭᑉᐸᓪᓕᐊᔪᓄᑦ ᐊᓂᕙᓪᓕᐊᔪᓄᓪᓗ ᐅᖄᓚᔪᓄᑦ
  • ᐱᓕᕆᕙᒡᓗᓂ ᑐᑭᓯᓇᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᐊᑐᐊᒐᕐᓂᒃ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᓯᕐᓂᒃ ᐊᔾᔨᒌᒃᑎᑦᑎᔪᓂᒃ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒋᐊᕈᑎᒃᓴᓂᒃ
  • ᐋᔩᖃᑎᖃᖅᐸᒡᓗᓂ ᐊᑭᓕᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᑕᐅᓯᒪᔪᓂᒃ ᒪᓕᒡᓗᓂ ᐱᓕᕆᕝᕕᒋᔭᐅᕙᒃᑐᒧᑦ ᑲᒻᐸᓂᒋᔭᐅᔪᒧᓪᓗ ᒪᓕᒃᑕᐅᔭᕆᐊᖃᖅᐸᒃᑐᓄᑦ
  • ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖅᐸᒡᓗᓂ ᐅᖃᐅᔾᔪᐃᕙᒡᓗᓂᓗ ᐊᑭᓕᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐱᕙᒌᔭᖅᑕᐅᓯᒪᔪᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓕᖅᑎᑦᑎᓂᕐᒧᓪᓗ ᐊᑐᖅᑕᐅᖔᕈᓐᓇᖅᑐᓂᒃ
  • ᖃᐅᔨᒋᐊᕐᕕᐅᓗᑎᑦ/ᑐᑦᑕᕐᕕᒋᔭᐅᓗᑎᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᒃᓴᕆᑎᑕᐅᔪᒧᑦ ᑮᓇᐅᔭᖁᑎᖃᕐᕕᒋᔭᕐᓄᑦ
  • ᑎᑎᕋᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᓗᒋᑦ ᐅᖄᓚᔪᑦ ᑕᒻᒪᖅᑕᙱᓪᓗᑎᒃ ᒪᓕᒡᓗᑎᒡᓗ ᒪᓕᒋᐊᓕᖕᓂᑦ
  • ᐊᐅᓚᑉᐸᒡᓗᒋᑦ ᐅᖄᓚᔪᑦ ᓇᓗᖅᑯᑎᙱᓪᓗᑎᑦ, ᓈᓚᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒡᓗᑎᑦ, ᑐᑭᓯᓇᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒡᓗ ᑭᒡᓕᒋᑎᑕᐅᔪᓂᒃ
  • ᐊᑐᕐᓗᒋᑦ CCA−ᑯᑦ ᐱᓇᓱᐊᑦᑎᐊᕆᐊᖃᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᒪᓕᒋᐊᓕᖏᑦ ᑲᒪᒋᓗᒋᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᓕᒫᑦ ᓱᓕᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᑎᒃ, ᓱᓕᓗᑎᒃ, ᐱᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᑎᒃ, ᐊᒻᒪ ᐃᒃᐱᒍᓱᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᑎᒃ..

ᑭᓱᒥᒃ ᓇᒃᓴᕐᒪᖔᖅᐱᑦ

ᕿᓂᖅᑐᒍᑦ ᐃᓄᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᒪᐃᑦᑐᓂᒃ:

  • ᖃᓪᓗᓇᐅᔭᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕆᐊᓕᒃ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᓪᓗ ᑖᔅᓱᒧᖓ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᒧᑦ ᑐᓴᐅᒪᖃᑎᖃᕆᐊᖃᖕᓂᖓᓄᑦ ᓄᓇᕗᒻᒥᐅᓂᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᓂᑦ.
  • ᐋᔩᖃᑎᖃᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐊᑲᐅᙱᓕᐅᕈᑕᐅᔪᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᔪᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ
  • ᓇᖕᒥᓂᖅ−ᐱᓇᔪᒍᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᓂ, ᑐᕌᕆᔭᖃᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᓂ, ᐃᓗᓕᓕᒫᖏᓐᓂᒡᓗ ᑕᐅᑐᒐᖃᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ
  • ᐃᓕᖅᑯᓯᖃᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᖅ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓕᕆᔨᒻᒪᕆᐅᓂᖅ ᑕᒪᐃᓐᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᒍᓯᕐᓂᒃ
  • ᐊᑲᐅᒃᓴᕐᓗᓂ ᐃᓄᑑᓗᓂ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕆᐊᒃᓴᖅ ᓱᒃᑲᓕᔪᒥᒡᓗ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᒃᑐᓂ ᐊᕙᑎᓕᖕᒥ
  • ᖃᕋᓴᐅᔭᓕᕆᔪᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐊᔾᔨᒌᙱᑦᑐᓂᑦ ᖃᕆᓴᐅᔭᓕᕆᔾᔪᑎᓂᑦ ᐊᑐᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ

ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑦᑕᖅᓯᒪᓂᑰᓗᓂ ᐊᑮᑦᑐᐃᔭᐃᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᓂᒃ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᕐᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᐅᖄᓚᕝᕕᐅᕙᒃᑐᓂᒡᓘᓐᓃᑦ ᐱᕚᓪᓕᕈᑕᐅᔪᓐᓇᖅᐳᖅ ᑭᓯᐊᓂ ᑕᐃᒪᐃᑦᑕᕆᐊᖃᙱᖦᖢᓂ. ᐃᓕᑦᑎᔪᒪᑦᑎᐊᕈᕕᑦ, ᐱᕈᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᔪᒪᒍᕕᑦ, ᐊᓯᔾᔩᔪᒪᒍᕕᓪᓗ, ᑐᓴᕐᕕᒋᔪᒪᕙᑦᑎᒋᑦ.

ᖃᓄᖅ ᐃᓕᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᐃᕙᖕᒪᖔᑦᑕ

ᖃᐅᔨᒪᔪᒍᑦ ᑕᒪᓐᓇ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅ ᐊᒃᓱᕈᕐᓇᕈᓐᓇᕐᓂᖓᓂᒃ, ᑕᐃᒪᐃᓐᓂᖓᓄᓪᓗ ᓴᓇᓯᒪᕗᒍᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕐᕕᒋᔭᐅᔪᒥᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᐃᔪᒥᒃ ᑲᔪᓯᓂᖃᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᕆᔭᕐᓂᒃ ᖃᓄᐃᙱᑦᑎᐊᕈᓐᓇᕐᓂᕐᓂᒃᓗ, ᐱᓕᕆᔨᓪᓚᕆᐅᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᓇᖕᒥᓂᕐᓗ. ᐅᕝᕙᐅᑯᐊ ᓇᓂᔪᓐᓇᖅᑕᑎᑦ CCA−ᑯᓐᓂ:

  • ᐊᑭᓕᖅᑐᖅᑕᐅᓗᑎᑦ ᐱᓕᒻᒪᒃᓴᖅᑎᑕᐅᓗᑎᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓚᐃᓴᓐᓯᑖᕐᓗᑎᑦ ᖁᓱᙱᓪᓗᑎᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᕙᒌᔭᖅᓯᒪᓗᑎᑦ ᐱᒋᐊᕐᓂᖓᓂ
  • ᐅᓪᓗᓕᒫᒧᑦ ᐃᑲᕐᕋᑦ, ᐃᓚᐅᓪᓗᑎᒃ 8:00−ᒥᑦ ᐅᓪᓛᒃᑯᑦ 4:30−ᒧᑦ ᐅᓐᓄᒃᓴᒧᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓇᓱᐊᕈᓯᐅᑉ ᓄᙳᐊᓂᑦ ᓇᓖᕌᒐᒃᓴᑦ
  • ᐊᑭᑦᑐᕋᐅᑎᓂᒃᑯᑦ ᐊᑭᓕᖅᑕᐅᔾᔪᑎᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓂᖏᑦ ᑐᓂᓯᓲᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᕐᓄᑦ ᓈᒻᒪᒃᑐᒃᑯᑦ
  • ᑲᑎᙵᔪᓄᑦ ᐱᕚᓪᓕᕈᑎᒃᓴᓄᑦ ᐸᕐᓇᐅᑎᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᖃᓄᐃᙱᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓴᐃᓕᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᒃᑯᑦ
  • ᑐᙵᓇᕐᓂᖅ, ᐃᓚᐅᑎᑦᑎᓂᖅ, ᐃᑲᔪᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᓗ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᑦ ᐃᓕᖅᑯᓯᖃᕐᓂᖅ ᑕᒫᓃᑉᐳᒍᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖃᑦᑕᐅᑎᔪᒪᓪᓗᑕ ᑲᔪᓯᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ
  • ᐊᕙᑎᒧᑦ ᓈᒻᒪᒃᑐᖅ ᓄᒃᑕᕐᓂᖅ (ᐊᖏᕐᕋᒥ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕐᓂᖅ)
  • ᐱᕕᒃᓴᐃᑦ ᐱᕈᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐱᕙᓪᓕᐊᓂᕐᒧᓪᓗ, ᐊᑯᓂᐅᔪᒃᑯᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᕆᔪᒪᔭᕐᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓱᐃᕙᓪᓕᐊᒍᕕᑦ ᐅᕝᕙᓘᓐᓃᑦ ᐱᕚᓪᓕᕐᓂᐊᕈᕕᑦ ᐱᒻᒪᕆᐅᔪᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑦᑕᖅᓯᒪᓂᑰᓂᕐᒥᒃ
  • ᐱᓕᕆᓪᓚᑦᑖᕐᓗᑎᒃ ᐃᓕᑦᑎᕙᓪᓕᐊᓂᖅ ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᖃᐅᑎᓄᑦ ᐅᓂᒃᑳᓕᐅᕐᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᖃᐅᑎᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓱᐃᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᓇᖕᒥᓂᕐᓗ ᑮᓇᐅᔭᓂᒃ ᐊᑐᖅᑐᒃᓴᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓱᐃᓂᕐᒥᒃ
  • ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᑦ ᓯᕗᓕᖅᑎᖏᑦ ᑐᑭᓯᐅᒪᔪᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᒥᒃ ᐊᖏᖅᓯᒪᑦᑎᐊᖅᖢᑎᒡᓗ ᐃᓕᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᕈᒪᓪᓗᑎᒃ ᑲᔪᓯᔪᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᖁᓪᓗᑎᑦ
  • ᑐᑭᓯᓇᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᑎᒃᓴᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᑕᐅᓂᐊᖅᑐᓂᒡᓗ ᖃᐅᔨᒪᔾᔪᑎᒃᓴᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓕᖅᑎᑕᕐᓄᑦ ᐊᔾᔨᒌᒡᔫᒥᑎᑦᑎᔾᔪᑕᐅᔪᓐᓇᖅᑐᓂᒡᓗ

ᐅᒃᐱᕈᓱᒃᐳᒍᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒋᕙᒃᑕᕗᑦ ᐃᒃᐱᒋᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᒋᑦ ᑲᒪᒋᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒡᓗᒋᓪᓗ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᖅᐸᒃᑕᕗᑦ. ᐃᓚᐅᓕᕈᕕᑦ CCA−ᑯᓐᓄᑦ, ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᓕᓵᑐᐃᓐᓇᙱᓚᑎᑦ−ᐃᓚᐅᓕᖅᐳᑎᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᒃᑐᓄᑦ ᐱᒻᒪᕆᐅᒋᔭᖃᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᓂᐱᖕᓂᒃ, ᐱᕈᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᓂᕆᔭᕐᓂᒃ, ᖃᓄᐃᙱᑦᑎᐊᕈᓐᓇᕐᓂᕐᓂᒃᓗ.

ᖃᓄᐃᓕᖓᓂᖏᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ

  • ᑲᓇᑕᒥ ᐊᕕᒃᑐᖅᓯᒪᔪᓂᒃ ᓚᐃᓴᓐᓯᑖᕈᒪᒍᕕᑦ, ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕈᓐᓇᐅᑎᖃᕆᐊᖃᖅᐳᑎᑦ (ᑕᖅᑭᓄᑦ 6-ᓄᑦ ᐊᑐᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ ᐱᓇᔪᓚᐅᖅᑎᓪᓗᑎᑦ), ᓄᓇᖃᐃᓐᓇᓕᕐᓗᑎᑦ, ᐅᕝᕙᓘᓐᓃᑦ ᑲᓇᑕᒥᐅᑕᐅᓗᑎᑦ.
  • ᐊᑐᐃᓐᓇᐅᔪᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ ᐅᓪᓗᓕᒫᒧᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ.
  • ᐱᕋᔭᖕᓂᑰᖕᒪᖔᑦ ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖅᑕᐅᔭᕆᐊᓕᒃ ᓂᕈᐊᖅᑕᐅᔪᓄᑦ

ᐅᓂᒃᑳᕗᑦ

ᑕᐃᒪᙵᑦ 1991−ᖑᓚᐅᖅᑎᓪᓗᒍ, ᑮᓇᐅᔭᓕᐅᕋᓱᖕᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᖃᐅᑎᓄᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒋᐊᖅᓯᔨᑦ ᓕᒥᑎᑦ ᐅᒃᐱᕆᔭᐅᑦᑎᐊᖅᖢᑎᒃ ᓯᕗᓕᖅᑎᒋᔭᐅᖃᑦᑕᖅᓯᒪᕗᑦ ᑮᓇᐅᔭᓂᒃ ᐅᑎᖅᑐᒃᓴᓂᒃ ᐊᐅᓚᑦᑎᓂᕐᒥᒃ ᑲᓇᑕᓕᒫᒥ. ᐱᓕᕆᐊᖃᓪᓚᕆᒃᐸᒃᐳᒍᑦ ᓈᒻᒪᒃᑐᓂᒃ, ᑲᔪᓯᓂᖃᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᑲᑎᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᔪᓂᒃ ᑕᒪᐃᓐᓄᑦ ᓇᖕᒥᓂᕆᔭᐅᔪᓄᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᓄᓪᓗ. ᐊᖏᖅᓯᒪᓂᕗᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᔨᒻᒪᕆᐅᓂᕐᒧᑦ, ᓱᓕᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ, ᐊᒻᒪ ᓴᖅᑭᑉᐸᓪᓕᐊᔪᓄᑦ ᖃᐅᔨᒪᔭᐅᔾᔪᑎᒋᕙᕗᑦ ᐱᐅᓛᖑᓂᑦᑎᓐᓄᑦ ᓴᓇᕝᕕᖕᒥ.

ᖃᐅᔨᒋᐊᒃᑲᓐᓂᕆᑦ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᕐᓂᕆᕙᒃᑕᑦᑎᓐᓂᒃ ᐅᕙᓂ cca.ca

Mandatory Language Proficiency: This position requires complete fluency in Inuktitut in order to support clients who speak only Inuktitut. Please note that applications from candidates without proven Inuktitut fluency cannot be considered.

At CCA, we’re redefining what collections can be. We treat people with respect, communicate with clarity, and focus on finding real solutions—not just chasing payments.

If you believe compassion matters, especially when someone’s going through a tough time in their lives, this role offers a chance to make a meaningful impact. You’ll connect with individuals, to offer support, listen without judgement, and help guide them through financial challenges with professionalism and respect.

We are looking for a Collections Officer who understands the importance of communication, trust, and relationship-building within Nunavut communities. The successful candidate will use their English and Inuktitut language skills to support consumers through respectful and solution-focused conversations.

What the Role Involves

As a Collections Officer, you will:

  • Speak with consumers who’ve missed payments—some recently, some long-term
  • Establish contact through inbound and outbound calls
  • Work within clear policy and process to offer fair and firm solutions
  • Negotiate payment arrangements in accordance with client and company guidelines
  • Investigate and advise on payment plans and settlement options
  • Serve as the contact/liaison for your assigned account portfolio
  • Document calls accurately and meet compliance standards
  • Manage each call with confidence, an empathetic ear, and clear boundaries
  • Uphold the CCA Code of Conduct by treating every consumer with integrity, honesty, dignity, and respect..

What You Bring

We’re looking for individuals who are:

  • Fluency in English and Inuktitut is required for this role due to the need to communicate with Nunavut-based consumers.
  • Skilled in negotiation and conflict resolution
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and detail-focused
  • Ethical and professional in all interactions
  • Comfortable working independently and in a fast-paced team environment
  • Proficient with computers and able to navigate multiple software programs

Experience in collections, customer service, or call centers is a bonus but not required. If you're eager to learn, grow, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

How We Support You

We know this work can be challenging, so we’ve built a workplace that supports your success and well-being, professionally and personally. Here’s what you’ll find at CCA:

  • Paid training and licensing to help you feel confident and prepared from day one
  • Full-time hours, including standard 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM shifts and prime-time weekday options
  • Competitive commission structure that rewards your performance fairly
  • Group benefit plan to support your health and peace of mind
  • Friendly, inclusive, and supportive team culture we’re here to help each other succeed
  • Eco-friendly commute (Work from Home)
  • Opportunities for growth and development, whether you’re building a long-term career or gaining valuable experience
  • Hands-on learning in credit reporting, credit repair, and personal budgeting
  • Team leaders who understand the job and are committed to helping you thrive
  • Clear tools and frameworks that guide your decisions and keep things consistent

We believe in treating our team members with the same respect and care we offer to our clients. When you join CCA, you’re not just starting a job—you’re joining a team that values your voice, your growth, and your well-being.

Conditions of Employment

  • To meet provincial licensing requirements, you must have a work permit (at least 6 months of validity remaining at time of application), permanent residency, or be a Canadian Citizen.
  • Be available for full-time work.
  • Criminal Record Check is required for successful candidates

Our Story

Since 1991, Commercial Credit Adjusters Ltd. has been a trusted leader in Accounts Receivable Management across Canada. We specialize in ethical, effective collection solutions tailored to both businesses and consumers. Our commitment to professionalism, integrity, and results has earned us a reputation for excellence in the industry. Learn more about our services at cca.ca

Salary: $28 hour
