Job Title: Senior Systems Analyst – HR Technology Services (HRTS)

Job Location: Remote, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

About the Role

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific's Human Resources Technology Services (HRTS) team as a Senior Systems Analyst supporting the delivery of complex HR technology initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M&A), Phase X implementations, Workday enhancements, integrations, and other strategic projects.

This role combines strong HR technology and data expertise with hands-on project coordination, business analysis, and testing leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with HR, Payroll, IT, technical teams, and external partners to translate business requirements into actionable plans, coordinate activities across multiple workstreams, and drive successful implementation.


Job Summary

The Senior Systems Analyst will support and coordinate complex Workday and HR technology initiatives from requirements gathering through testing, deployment, and stabilization.

This position requires a strong understanding of Workday, HR and Payroll processes, employee data, and downstream system dependencies, along with exceptional analytical and organizational skills. The individual will be responsible for bringing structure to complex bodies of work, tracking progress, anticipating risks and dependencies, facilitating issue resolution, and ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility into activities and next steps.

The role will also play an important part in developing and coordinating end-to-end testing strategies, particularly for initiatives involving multiple Workday functional domains, integrations, data conversion, and downstream applications.


Responsibilities

Business Analysis & HR Technology

  • Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, business stakeholders, and technical teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for Workday and related HR technology initiatives.
  • Analyze HR business processes, Workday functionality, and employee data to identify gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications and coordinate with Workday domain architects, integration developers, and other technical resources to support solution design and implementation.
  • Understand Workday data structures, business processes, integrations, and downstream system dependencies sufficiently to identify potential impacts and facilitate cross-functional discussions.
  • Support data conversion activities, including data mapping, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, mass data loads, and downstream integration readiness.
  • Analyze large data sets using Excel and other analytical tools to identify discrepancies, validate results, troubleshoot issues, and support business decisions.

Project & Delivery Coordination

  • Coordinate defined bodies of work across M&A integrations, Phase X initiatives, Workday enhancements, integrations, Time & Absence, and other HR technology projects.
  • Develop and maintain detailed activity trackers, schedules, milestones, action items, and dependencies in alignment with broader project plans and timelines.
  • Proactively follow up with functional and technical teams to track commitments, identify blockers, resolve issues, and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Coordinate requirements gathering, solution discussions, implementation sequencing, testing readiness, and deployment activities across multiple workstreams.
  • Identify risks, issues, and downstream impacts; communicate status and recommended actions to project leads and stakeholders.
  • Facilitate working sessions and status meetings to ensure clear ownership, timely decisions, and accountability for deliverables.
  • Partner with project managers, solution architects, and domain leads to support implementation planning, change assessments, and production readiness.

Testing & Implementation Readiness

  • Coordinate end-to-end testing activities across Workday functional domains, integrations, downstream systems, and business stakeholders, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing.
  • Support development of testing strategies, scenarios, timelines, and execution plans to ensure appropriate coverage of business processes, employee populations, data flows, and downstream impacts.
  • Ensure testing prerequisites are identified and addressed, including access, test data, environments, scenarios, expected results, and resource availability.
  • Track testing progress, defects, blockers, risks, and outstanding decisions, driving follow-up and resolution across functional and technical teams.
  • Analyze defects and data discrepancies to identify potential impacts across related scenarios, employee populations, integrations, and downstream processes.
  • Facilitate testing status and defect triage meetings, ensuring clear ownership, priorities, and timely resolution.
  • Maintain visibility into overall testing health, completion status, unresolved risks, and readiness for deployment.
  • Support cutover preparation, production validation, and post-implementation stabilization activities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience supporting enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, HR technology implementations, business analysis, or related initiatives.
  • Strong experience with Workday HCM, including an understanding of core HR processes, reporting, employee data, business processes, and cross-functional system dependencies.
  • Strong knowledge of HR and Payroll business processes and how employee data flows between Workday and downstream applications.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex Workday implementations, M&A integrations, enterprise enhancements, or other large-scale HR technology initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience working with large data sets, performing data analysis, reconciliation, and validation using Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience coordinating activities across multiple functional and technical teams, managing dependencies, tracking progress, and driving timely completion of deliverables.
  • Experience supporting requirements gathering, functional analysis, testing, data conversion, and implementation activities.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners.
  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and ability to proactively identify issues, drive follow-up, and operate effectively in a fast-paced global environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating or leading complex Workday SIT, UAT, regression testing, or end-to-end testing activities.
  • Experience with testing management, defect tracking, test scenario development, and cross-system impact analysis.
  • Experience supporting M&A integrations, Phase X implementations, or divestitures.
  • Knowledge of Workday integrations, including EIBs, PECI, WECI, PICOF, and related downstream HR/Payroll systems.
  • Experience with ADP GlobalView or other enterprise payroll platforms.
  • Experience supporting Workday Reporting, Time Tracking, Absence Management, Security, or other HCM functional domains.
  • Proficiency with Smartsheet or similar project and testing coordination tools.

Success in this Role

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical, organized, and proactive HR technology professional who combines strong Workday and HR process knowledge with the ability to coordinate complex initiatives across multiple teams. They anticipate dependencies, connect issues across systems and workstreams, drive accountability, and maintain clear visibility into progress and risks. They are comfortable working independently, managing detailed execution activities, and helping ensure successful testing and delivery without requiring extensive direction or oversight.

BEAMON is the AI workspace for lawyers. Draft, review and research with legal AI you can trust, connected to the legal content lawyers already rely on and to a workflow engine that turns AI output into finished legal work.

700 clients in 10 months. That is how fast law firms and legal teams are moving to BEAMON.

  • Built for lawyers, not adapted for them. Assist, Draft (in Word) and Extract cover the daily work: research, drafting, redlining, contract review at scale.

  • Content no one else has. We were the fastest growing independent European AI assistant to integrate content from legal publishers, starting with Dr. Otto Schmidt.

  • The European challenger. Others have the headlines. We grow fast anyways.

The master plan:

  1. Own DACH. Become the default legal AI for every small and medium law firms and legal teams in Germany and Austria.

  2. Win multiple verticals. Lawyers, legal teams, notaries and municipalities. We help small teams win big – with BEAMON.

  3. Set the standard. Make BEAMON the benchmark for how legal experts work with AI.

We're early. Most of the work is ahead of us, so we are building a world-class team.

The opportunity: Event & Community Manager

Your job: make BEAMON the legal AI that German-speaking lawyers have met in person. When a Kanzlei partner thinks legal AI, they remember the dinner, the roadshow stop or the webinar where it clicked. And the BEAMON people who were in the room.

Harvey and Legora buy the headlines. We win the people.

You'll start by building our events engine across Germany and Austria including. webinars, and intimate dinners with partners, clients and prospects. Then you go bigger: blockbuster events and product launches people talk about. You know that in legal, trust is personal. A managing partner won't come to a "networking event". She will come to a dinner with six peers, a sharp topic and a host who knows her name. That instinct is your unfair advantage.

This is a role with senior-level ownership from day one. Nobody will hand you an event calendar. You build it, along with the playbooks, the supplier list and the budget that let it scale.

Every event we run meets YOUR standard. If it doesn't feel like BEAMON, it doesn't happen. If you nail it, you'll grow into leading events and community for BEAMON as we scale.

Full-time, remote, based in Germany or Austria. Hybrid if you are in Vienna. Frequent travel is part of the job.

This is a role that requires proactiveness, creativity and ownership. You’ll report to me, Chris (Head of Growth). I ask a lot and together we will achieve a lot.

You'll work closely with me (Chris, Head of Growth), Co-founder & CEO (Michael Grupp), Marketing, Sales, and our partners.

What you'll own

Because of you, lawyers and legal teams meet BEAMON, trust it and start a trial.

  • Events portfolio. You plan and run the full range: roadshows and webinars with partners, executive dinners and roundtables, flagship events, and BEAMON's presence at third-party conferences. In Germany, Austria and beyond.

  • Invites and outreach. You own the guest list. You reach the prospects, clients, partners and legal influencers we want in the room, and you get them there. You don't take no for an answer: a polite no is the start of the conversation.

  • Community. You are the focal point of the BEAMON community. You know our members by name, keep them engaged between events, and turn happy clients into champions who host, speak and bring peers.

  • Logistics and on-site. Scheduling, registrations, participant communication, Know Before You Go, speaker and staff briefings. On the day, you run the room and nothing falls through.

  • Budget and suppliers. You own event budgets, venues, caterers, agencies and contracts. You negotiate hard and every euro shows up in pipeline.

  • Content and brand. With the Legal Content Marketer, you create event identities, invites, promotional content and recaps that keep working after the lights go off. Every touchpoint looks and feels BEAMON.

  • Performance. You track every event from invite to pipeline and report back within a week. You know which formats work, and you kill the ones that don't.

How we measure success

Your success shows in pipeline and in who is in the room.

KPIs:

Primary| Event-sourced pipeline: Trials and demos where an event or community touchpoint was a touchpoint
Secondary| Audience quality:Share of attendees who are decision makers at target firms and legal teams, and show rate vs. registrations
Event ROI: Pipeline generated per euro of event spend

Events live: Hosted events, roadshow stops and webinars per quarter

Partner events: Events co-hosted with partners per quarter

Need to have

  • Events. 5+ years of B2B event marketing and management. You've run event programs, not just single events, from 10-person dinners to 300-person flagships. We love the challenge and scary timelines.

  • Organized under pressure. You run several events at once, and nothing falls through. You live by run-of-show docs, checklists and deadlines.

  • Budgets and suppliers. You've owned event budgets, managed venues and agencies, and negotiated contracts that held.

  • Bold. You want to BEAMON to be known for the super-cool events.

  • Ownership. Strong work ethic. You don't wait for a brief, you are proactive and want to see your ideas come to live (not mine ;) ) – because you know what great looks like.

  • Languages and location. Native German, English at C1 or better. Based in Germany or Austria.

Extra points for

  • Network. You already know people in the DACH legal scene: bar associations, legal tech meetups, publishers, in-house communities.

  • Partners and agencies. You've co-hosted events with partners or publishers and know how to get the best out of agencies.

What you get

  • A competitive salary according to your seniority level.

  • VSOP shares in the company

  • Learning budget, hardware, wellbeing contribution and more.

  • Exposure across every area of legal AI marketing, and a fast track to grow with BEAMON.

raw.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Director, Privacy, Digital Products & AI Governance
raw.excerpt: At Credit Acceptance, we are building on the foundation of a successful business while investing in the future through technology, data, AI, and continuous improvement.
raw.description:
At Credit Acceptance, we are building on the foundation of a successful business while investing in the future through technology, data, AI, and continuous improvement. As we continue to evolve, our Team Members play an active role in improving experiences, driving meaningful change, and shaping the future of our business. We foster an environment where people are empowered to contribute ideas, develop their careers, make an impact, and help lead our continued transformation.

Our Enterprise teams provide the expertise, insights, and partnership that help our business and people succeed. Team Members collaborate across the organization to solve challenges, support informed decision-making, and enable the strategies and initiatives that move our business forward. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and diverse perspectives from people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact on our customers, Team Members, and business.

Outcomes and Activities:

Digital Engagement

  • Serve as lead legal counsel for the privacy and consumer-information aspects of the Company’s digital consumer journey, from prequalification through contract origination.
  • Advise on the acquisition, use, and sharing of consumer information, including FCRA permissible purpose, consumer-report authorizations, fraud prevention, and related consumer notices and consents.
  • Partner with the business in evaluating and selecting vendor products and data solutions that use consumer-report or other FCRA-governed information for identity and income verification, fraud prevention, and other consumer-engagement purposes.
  • Provide legal guidance for consumer-facing digital communications and credit advertising, including TILA and Regulation Z advertising requirements, digital disclosures, adverse-action communications, and other consumer-protection requirements affecting the digital experience.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Compliance and origination counsel on the design and launch of marketplace capabilities, with this role owning the privacy, consumer-information, FCRA, digital consumer-engagement and consumer-facing credit-advertising framework.

Privacy & Security

  • Serve as the primary privacy and information security counsel to Marketing, Engineering, and business teams on new features, products, and initiatives, from design through launch.
  • Interpret developments in federal and state privacy laws, including GLBA and FCRA, and turn them into practical, risk-based guidance.
  • Support the privacy program with Information Security, Data Engineering, and Compliance, including risk and impact assessments, privacy rights requests, and data retention and minimization.
  • Draft and negotiate data protection agreements, data-use restrictions, audit rights, and security schedules structured to protect the Company’s interests.
  • Lead legal strategy for any data breach or cyber incidents, including privilege, notification, and regulator engagement.
  • Keep legal and business leadership informed about the privacy and security program and emerging risks.

AI Governance

  • Support the enterprise AI governance framework, including drafting policies, standards, risk classification, and the enterprise AI inventory.
  • Design and maintain the intake and assessment process used to enable the review and approval of AI tools and systems by Corporate Legal.
  • Draft and negotiate privacy and acceptable AI-use terms in dealer, technology, and vendor agreements, including permitted use, data rights, training restrictions, output ownership, and allocation of responsibility.
  • Partner with consumer finance counsel to advise on dealer and consumer disclosures when our AI tools shape what shoppers see or how dealers engage them.
  • Own the legal framework around AI training data, model documentation, and data retention, using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework as the standard.
  • Track AI regulation and agency guidance with Government Relations.
  • Interpret developments in Federal and state AI-related laws, and direct the business with compliant, practical, risk-based guidance.
  • Partner with other attorneys to support the business when developing and using AI that touches credit, fraud, or funding decisions, including ECOA/Regulation B, fair lending, model governance, explainability, and adverse-action considerations.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Deep knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity requirements, including GLBA and FCRA.
  • Ability to interpret statutes, regulations, case law, regulatory guidance, and industry standards and translate them into practical, risk-based advice, tailored to the Company’s business practices.
  • Knowledge of operational privacy and data governance programs, including risk and impact assessments, privacy rights requests, data retention, data minimization, and incident response.
  • Expertise in drafting and negotiating data protection agreements, privacy exhibits, data-use restrictions, audit rights, security schedules, and related technology agreements.
  • Ability to structure and advise on the legal architecture of marketplaces, including consumer terms of use and shopper accounts, dealer participation terms, lead-sharing and data-sharing arrangements, and technology, licensing, and partnership agreements.
  • Strong product-counseling skills, with the ability to advise Marketing, Engineering, Information Security, Compliance, and business teams throughout product development and launch.
  • Expertise in artificial intelligence products, responsible data use, AI governance, risk assessments, inventories, policies, and impact analyses.
  • Strong issue-spotting, legal judgment, problem-solving, negotiation, and decision-making skills in complex and rapidly changing areas.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with internal and external legal and technical experts.

Requirements:

  • J.D. and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar, with the ability to register as in-house counsel where required.
  • 8+ years of U.S. legal practice.
  • Demonstrated experience as product counsel for a consumer-facing digital platform or marketplace, including launching new products, categories, or marketplaces.
  • Deep working knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy and data protection law, and significant experience operating and/or building a privacy program.
  • Strong knowledge of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and emerging U.S. federal and state AI laws.
  • Hands-on experience advising on AI products and building AI governance (for example, AI risk assessments, inventories, policies, or impact analyses).
  • A track record of drafting consumer notices, consents, and terms of use, and of negotiating data protection agreements.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled legal tools responsibly and effectively, with examples of improved quality, speed, or risk identification.

Preferred:

  • Experience in online automotive retail, an automotive marketplace, or auto finance.
  • Knowledge of consumer financial services law, including ECOA/Regulation B, TCPA, UDAAP, TILA/Regulation Z, and FCRA.
  • Demonstrated technical fluency in software development, data architecture, cybersecurity, or machine-learning systems; a technical degree is helpful but not required.
  • Significant in-house experience at a technology, marketplace, e-commerce, or consumer financial services company.
  • ISO/IEC 42001 training.
  • Experience engaging with regulators, industry groups, or standards bodies.
  • CIPP/US, CIPM, or AIGP certification.

Targeted Compensation: $225,800 - $263,400 base salary + annual bonus plan

This position is not currently open to individuals who require sponsorship now or in the future to work legally for Credit Acceptance, such as H-1b / H-4 or F-1 OPT visa holders.

Benefits

  • Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work

Our Company Values:

To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be:

  • Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions
  • Respectful by collaborating and actively listening
  • Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self-awareness and making quality decisions
  • Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage
  • Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting

Expectations:

  • Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines
  • All other duties as assigned
  • Attendance as required by department

Advice!

We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application!

P.S.

We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk!


Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent.

raw.title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
raw.excerpt: Indonesia needs someone who can make the callLiving in Indonesia and ready to own decisions?
raw.description:
Indonesia needs someone who can make the call

Living in Indonesia and ready to own decisions? Start by spending ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that would suit any other employer do not get through.

Who gets on well with us

  1. Owns decisions, and owns them still when they turn out badly.
  2. Sees where their remit ends and someone else's begins, and is accurate about that edge from both sides.
  3. Hears criticism as useful information and shifts, but keeps a view that has solid reasons behind it.
  4. Gets better at pace. Seventy percent and climbing is worth more to us than eighty five and stuck.
  5. Raises the alarm when something is going wrong, even when the cause sits in our own process.
  6. Puts things in writing plainly and honestly, particularly the bad news.

What the work is

Drop Zero Digital is a lifecycle marketing agency, and in Indonesia we are taking on one person with a talent for deciding. Our AI image service is the fastest growing thing we sell, so wherever you land, you are helping that service grow.

A single named area will be yours. We assign it once the trial has shown what you do best, and it will be one of these:

  1. Hiring. You look after how we find, screen and take on people, running the funnel from sourcing through chasing and scheduling, keeping the tracker accurate, and telling us straight when the process itself needs fixing.
  2. Client delivery. You look after how client work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped, keeping to deadlines, giving the team a full brief and making sure nothing sits stuck.

The core is identical in both. Spot the slip, pick a response, finish the job without waiting for a nudge.

Do not expect an assistant seat or a coordinator seat. Real decisions arrive daily and we grade you on how sound they are, not on the size of your pile. Our plan is a team that decides well unmanaged, so a job that begins each morning with someone telling you what to do will disappoint you.

The steps, in order, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

In the trial we make our decision, and we also fix which of the two areas is yours. You are on live work from week one, with a frank account from us of each call. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

About your experience

We ask for no number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

For whichever roles you name, we verify employer, dates, title and paid status through a contract and payslips, all in one exchange. One full-time job inside the last 12 months is required. Past that, a short history is fine. If you misstate the history you have, you are disqualified, and an honest short account is never held against you.

Requirements

      1. Full time after hire, and this job is your only one. On the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 at a fixed time inside our working day, and your present job can continue. If you pass, you give notice and join full time within 30 days.
      2. Reliable internet of at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in Indonesia.
      5. Your working time goes into our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1000 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Those who earn it see pay and responsibility rise quickly. Authority over decisions that reach a client comes slowly and on purpose, built on a record instead of one strong month. Hearing that today beats finding it out in month two.

raw.description:
About the company

Who We Are

Ominis is a collective of forward-thinking, tech-savvy individuals on a mission to revolutionize the contact center space using AI. After over 15 years in telecommunications, we grew frustrated by the industry’s lack of true innovation—so we decided to change it ourselves. With Ominis, businesses get a fresh way to engage customers and discover in-depth insights into product and service experiences. Our tools bring clarity to what’s really happening, while empowering companies to deliver support that delights customers.

Our Culture

We see ourselves as owners, innovators, and customer-obsessed pioneers who always think big. High standards are non-negotiable here. We believe in fostering creativity, staying frugal, and embracing risks that push us forward. The best solutions are often the simplest ones, so we avoid over-engineering. Honesty and transparency fuel our growth—leaders become stronger when they’re genuine.

Because we’re a remote-first team, trust is ingrained in everything we do. Everyone at Ominis is a leader; we communicate openly, stay present, dive deep into challenges, and join forces with the best people to reach the best outcomes. Above all, we deliver results—proudly and joyfully.

If you want to be part of something bigger—working with top talents in a place that empowers you to get things done—we’d love to have you here.

Working at Ominis

Joining Ominis means betting on your potential and exploring what you once thought impossible. We constantly challenge ourselves and each other to level up. In this dynamic environment, you’ll have unlimited opportunities to sharpen your skills, grow your knowledge, and solve complex problems with elegant, straightforward solutions.

We pride ourselves on being resourceful, frugal, and relentless—all while staying fiercely committed to succeeding as a team. We trust, respect, and show up for one another every day. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, supportive environment where you can do your best work, you’ve found it at Ominis.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Front End Developer to spearhead the creation of our AI-driven contact center platform’s user-facing experience. You’ll work on everything from real-time data interactions and audio playback components to building out interactive dashboards and visual analytics. We’re looking for someone who can shape the overall front-end strategy, mentor other engineers, and ensure we deliver a fast, smooth, and future-proof product experience. If you’re excited about leveraging cutting-edge tech and pushing boundaries in a rapidly evolving space, this role is for you.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop user-facing features that seamlessly integrate real-time data, audio playback, and interactive visualizations.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Backend) to turn ideas into well-structured, maintainable front-end solutions.

  • Champion performance and scalability by writing efficient, modular code and ensuring it can evolve with our ever-growing platform.

  • Stay current on frameworks and libraries (we primarily use React) to build a maintainable, future-proof codebase.

  • Mentor and guide junior to mid-level front-end developers, fostering a culture of learning, innovation, and transparency.

  • Influence product direction by sharing insights on front-end capabilities and best practices that align with user needs and business goals.

  • Participate in architectural discussions to ensure front-end components are consistent with broader system design.

What we’re seeking

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional front-end development experience, ideally using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular).

  • Deep understanding of web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript) and responsive design principles.

  • Experience with real-time data (WebSockets or other push-based methodologies) to ensure smooth user interactions.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially in a remote-first environment.

  • Track record of building modular, maintainable front-end architectures, and a willingness to share knowledge with others.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with audio/video playback integrations in the browser.

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating interactive charts and data visualizations (e.g., D3, Chart.js, or third-party analytics platforms).

  • Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines for front-end deployments.

  • Comfort with Agile or sprint planning, ensuring timely, high-quality deliverables.

  • A background in AI or machine learning, or a keen interest in how AI shapes user experiences.

If you’re ready to take ownership, push the envelope on what’s possible, and build a platform that reimagines how businesses engage their customers, we’d love to hear from you. Join our team of innovators at Ominis, where big ideas, high standards, and real-world impact come together. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the table.

BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that leverages brand building, storytelling and digital presence to deliver more revenue on behalf of our clients.

Position: Social Media Manager

Location

Remote | Open to global candidates

Role Overview

BlackBox Strategies is seeking a proactive, results-oriented Social Media Manager to fully own and drive the performance of client's social media channels. You will be responsible for setting the strategy, defining the content roadmap, and overseeing execution across all key platforms. This role demands a creative and analytical leader who can identify content needs, coordinate with copywriters, designers, and marketing teams, and ensure the delivery of engaging, high-performing content.

As the Social Media Manager, you will shape our online brand presence and the digital voice of our clients, leading efforts to grow audiences, increase engagement, and drive measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of all social media channels for BlackBox Strategies and select clients, ensuring their ongoing growth and impact

  • Define and implement comprehensive social media strategies to engage target audiences and achieve brand and revenue goals

  • Develop and maintain an actionable content calendar, clearly identifying the types of content needed to meet growth and engagement objectives

  • Proactively leverage AI tools and platforms to generate, enhance, and optimize social content

  • Collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams—including creative, copy, design, and marketing—to source and deliver best-in-class content on deadline

  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics, proactively refining tactics to optimize reach, engagement, and conversion rates

  • Actively engage with online communities, respond to comments/messages, and foster brand advocacy across all channels

  • Stay current with industry trends, social tools (including the latest advances in AI-assisted content), and algorithm changes, proposing and testing innovative approaches

  • Nurture relationships with influencers and partners to extend campaign reach and impact

Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience managing and growing branded social media channels (agency or multi-client exposure preferred)

  • Proven track record of driving measurable performance and audience growth across multiple platforms

  • Strategic content planner with strong copywriting and storytelling skills

  • Proficient in major social media management and analytics tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, Later, etc.)

  • Experience in working collaboratively with creative teams to deliver on-brand visual and written content

  • Skilled in basic design or video editing; motion/animation experience a plus

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, derive insights, and continually improve

  • Organized self-starter able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines effectively

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible, remote work environment

  • Opportunity to make a visible impact on brand and revenue growth

  • Work with a fast-moving, creative team dedicated to excellence

  • Continuous learning, development, and cross-functional collaboration

We are one of the first work-from-anywhere companies with 2,000+ team members utilizing our virtual office called eXp World. This role is work-from-anywhere in Spain.

Who is eXp?

Doing the audacious is part of eXp Realty’s DNA. We are a company that rewards creative minds who can offer bold solutions, where opinions matter, anything is possible and the outcome can be revolutionary. As a global full-service real estate brokerage utilizing a 3-D, fully immersive, cloud office environment, offering 24/7 access to collaborative tools & training, eXp has broken the traditional mold of real estate. We are doing big things.Come join us!

What you will do:

As a Transaction Settlements, Sr. Analyst, you will oversee the end-to-end administration and coordination of real estate transactions, ensuring all documentation is accurate, complete and processed in accordance with local legal and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with agents, clients, legal professionals, notaries and internal stakeholders to facilitate smooth transaction settlements from contract initiation through to closing.

  • Transaction Management: Manage the full lifecycle of real estate transactions, from initial contract documentation through to closing, ensuring all required information and documentation are accurately recorded and maintained.
  • Document Review & Verification: Review and organise transaction files, including deposit agreements (Contratos de Arras), reservation agreements, listing agreements, land registry reports (Notas Simples) and other relevant real estate documentation.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Ensure transaction files are accurate, complete and compliant with applicable Spanish real estate requirements. Follow up with agents to obtain missing documentation and ensure all required documents are uploaded to the appropriate CRM and transaction management platforms.
  • Data Entry & Systems Management: Enter and maintain transaction details across relevant platforms, ensuring information is accurate and up to date throughout the transaction process.
  • Commission & Financial Tracking: Monitor bank accounts for commission payments, prepare invoices and maintain accurate records of transaction-related financial information.
  • Legal & External Coordination: Coordinate the preparation and submission of transaction documentation to legal professionals, notaries and other relevant external parties as required.
  • Closing & Pipeline Monitoring: Generate weekly and monthly reports identifying contracts approaching their closing dates, monitor outstanding tasks and proactively follow up to ensure transactions progress on schedule.
  • Issue Resolution: Identify and escalate outstanding documentation, compliance or transaction-related issues to agents and the designated Managing Broker to support timely resolution.
  • Sales & Transaction Reporting: Prepare weekly flash reports covering sales and listings, along with additional reporting and documentation relating to transactions and agent activity.
  • Agent Support & Training: Provide guidance and training to agents on local transaction platforms, documentation requirements and real estate transaction procedures.
  • Customer & Internal Support: Respond to HubSpot tickets in a timely manner, assist with the preparation of monthly newsletters and support general transaction-related inquiries.
  • Follow established transaction procedures and guidelines as directed by the Team Lead.
  • Other accountabilities as assigned.

How you will make an impact:

  • Ensure real estate transactions progress smoothly and efficiently from contract initiation through to closing.
  • Maintain accurate and complete transaction records while ensuring compliance with applicable local legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Minimise transaction delays by proactively identifying missing documentation, outstanding tasks and potential issues.
  • Support agents by providing timely guidance on transaction procedures, documentation and platform requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships with agents, notaries, legal professionals, conveyancers and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate financial and commission records to support transaction settlements and reporting.
  • Provide timely and reliable reporting to support operational visibility and effective decision-making.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in transaction processes, documentation management and overall agent experience.

How you will grab our attention:

  • 1+ years of experience in real estate transaction processing, transaction coordination or real estate operations.
  • Strong understanding of Spanish real estate transaction processes and associated legal documentation.
  • Familiarity with Spanish real estate laws, tax regulations and local transaction requirements.
  • Experience reviewing and handling real estate documentation, including deposit agreements (Contratos de Arras), reservation agreements, listing agreements and land registry reports (Notas Simples).
  • Knowledge of relevant local real estate compliance requirements and regulatory guidelines.
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms and real estate transaction management systems.
  • Experience working with Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing documentation and maintaining transaction records.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with agents, conveyancers, notaries and designated Managing Brokers.
  • A responsible, dependable and trustworthy approach to handling confidential transaction and financial information.
  • A proactive, task-oriented mindset with the ability to follow established processes and work independently.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify, escalate and resolve transaction-related issues.
  • A collaborative team player who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.

If you think you’d make a great match for this position but don’t meet all the requirements, we would still encourage you to apply!

What eXp provides:

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work with a globally recognised real estate organisation.
  • Access to eXp World, our immersive virtual office environment.
  • Collaborative and supportive company culture.
  • And more…

EEO Statement:

We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, eXp is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics under federal, state or local law.

Job Title: Bid Writer
﻿﻿Location: India (Remote)﻿

Role Overview

﻿We are seeking a skilled Bid Writer with at least 2 years of hands-on experience in government tenders and bids, who has contributed to or been involved in winning public-sector contracts. This role involves a combination of bid writing, tender tracking, and administrative coordination, supporting submissions across multiple countries and sectors.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing end-to-end bid processes, from monitoring new opportunities to submission and post-bid follow-ups. The selected candidate will be directly engaged on client assignments, working on global tenders and bids in a remote capacity from India.

Key Responsibilities

Bid Writing & Tender Management

  • Write, edit, and coordinate high-quality responses for government tenders, RFPs, RFQs, EOIs, and proposals across global markets
  • Contribute to successful and winning tender submissions, supporting narrative development, compliance, and formatting
  • Interpret tender documents, eligibility criteria, and evaluation frameworks accurately
  • Develop structured, persuasive bid responses aligned with scoring requirements
  • Customize content based on country-specific procurement rules and sector requirements

Monitoring & Tracking

  • Actively monitor new government contract opportunities across global tender portals
  • Track tender deadlines, submission requirements, and clarification timelines
  • Maintain bid trackers, opportunity pipelines, and status dashboards
  • Coordinate internal timelines to ensure timely and compliant submissions

Administrative & Coordination Support

  • Manage bid documentation, annexures, certifications, and supporting materials
  • Maintain and update bid libraries, templates, CVs, case studies, and credentials
  • Coordinate inputs from internal teams and external partners
  • Ensure version control, formatting, and quality checks before submission
  • Support post-submission clarifications, audits, and feedback reviews

Sectors & Markets

  • Government & Public Sector
  • Infrastructure, Development & Social Projects
  • Healthcare, Technology, Energy, and Consulting
  • Multi-country tenders across Asia, Middle East, Europe, Africa, and other regions

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in bid writing for government or public-sector tenders
  • Demonstrated involvement in winning or shortlisted government bids
  • Strong understanding of tendering and procurement processes
  • Excellent written English and editing skills
  • Strong organizational and administrative abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously
  • Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and document management tools

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience working on international tenders
  • Familiarity with global tender portals and procurement platforms
  • Exposure to compliance matrices, scoring methodologies, and bid governance

What We Offer

  • Fully remote role based in India
  • Exposure to global government contracts and multi-sector projects
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact and winning bids
  • Flexible working environment
  • Competitive compensation aligned with experience

💼 Sales Development Representative
🌎 Open to Latin America: This role is open to candidates based in Latin America.
🏠 Remote

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven women's fitness and nutrition coaching company with a strong brand, a loyal community, and strong customer reviews. They help women transform their health and fitness through a proven coaching program with real documented results.

About the Role

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to drive pipeline and book qualified appointments. You'll handle inbound lead follow-up, conduct outbound outreach, qualify prospects, and book discovery calls for the sales team.

This is a high-activity, results-driven role. You'll be communicating with women who are interested in transforming their health and fitness, so empathy, clear communication, and genuine enthusiasm for the mission matter as much as sales skill. If you're a confident communicator, organized, and motivated by clear metrics and measurable results, this role is a strong fit.

Responsibilities

  • Respond to inbound leads quickly and professionally across email, DM, and other channels, ensuring no lead waits or falls through the cracks
  • Qualify inbound prospects against defined criteria and move strong fits toward a discovery call
  • Conduct outbound outreach via email, social media, and other channels to generate pipeline
  • Write personalized, non-spammy outreach that resonates with women interested in health, fitness, and sustainable body transformation
  • Follow up consistently on open threads and keep prospects engaged without being pushy
  • Book qualified discovery calls for the sales team with full context and qualification notes, coordinating scheduling and confirmations to reduce no-shows
  • Ensure clean, accurate handoffs so the sales team walks into every call fully prepared
  • Log all outreach activity, conversations, and lead status accurately in the CRM
  • Track activity volume, response rates, and appointment-set metrics, and meet daily and weekly outreach targets and monthly booking goals

What We're Looking For

  • Prior experience in sales development, outbound outreach, or lead generation with a track record of booking qualified appointments
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a warm, confident, and professional tone
  • Comfortable communicating with a predominantly female audience about health, fitness, and personal transformation in a way that feels genuine and supportive rather than salesy
  • Organized and disciplined, with clean CRM habits and consistent follow-through on every open lead
  • Self-directed and motivated by clear metrics, able to hit daily activity targets independently
  • Resilient and persistent without being aggressive

Nice to Have

  • Experience in health, wellness, fitness, or coaching sales
  • Background working in a high-growth DTC or coaching business
  • Familiarity with women's health, nutrition, or strength training as a topic area
  • Experience with CRM tools and sales engagement platforms

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US business hours

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your sales development experience, and explaining how you approach following up with a lead who expressed interest but has gone quiet

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis.

Android Police is expanding its freelance roster and hiring multiple experienced features writers to deliver sharp, authoritative stories across the wearables and fitness tech world. You’ll pitch and produce original, reader-obsessed narratives (deep dives, hands-on experiments, timely takes) that power our site, social channels, and newsletters.

What We Cover

  • Smartwatches and fitness trackers
  • Smart rings
  • Smart glasses
  • Health, fitness, and sleep tracking features and apps
  • Wearable software and firmware updates, features, and hidden tricks
  • Wearable accessories, setups, and workflows

The Role

• Hands-on writing: Freelance contract with a minimum set of published stories per month.

• Pitch-driven: You own your ideas. Submit strong pitches weekly.

• Quick-response availability: Pitch and file same-day or next-day pieces on breaking news, OS drops, or viral trends.

• No commerce, affiliate, or sponsored content—100% editorial.

• Mix of formats: A healthy chunk of first-person pieces, plus reported features, how-tos, and analysis.

Requirements

• Proven experience: 3+ years writing features for established tech/consumer outlets (prior bylines required).

• Deep knowledge of at least one beat above; bonus for multiple.

• Hardware on hand: Current Android devices (Android 14+) and any smart home/E Ink gear you’ll cover.

• US or Canada-based preferred. We’ll consider exceptional writers elsewhere if you can reliably work within an Eastern time zone.

• Passion for your beat and a drive to deliver fresh, original takes.

Big Plusses

• Solid media contacts for exclusives and sourcing

• Bylines at outlets like Android Authority, 9to5Google, 9to5Mac, XDA, Pocket-lint, How-To Geek, or similar

• Strong social-media presence and engaged following

• Familiarity with Android Police’s voice and audience

How We Work

• Payment: Timely bi-monthly or monthly payments via PayPal, or Payoneer. Competitive per-story rates, paid on publication.

• Process: Every piece goes through professional copy edit; we create custom art; your work is promoted across our social channels and newsletters.

• Quality bar: Excellent, well-sourced writing (we fact-check everything).

• Long-term home: Most writers stay for years. We run training workshops, offer growth paths to fixed base roles, product-review gigs, and more.

Application Requirements

  1. Three relevant previously written articles (at least one hands-on)
  2. Brief note on your primary beat + hardware setup
  3. Fresh pitch idea tailored to Android Police
  4. Links to your social profiles / portfolio

We will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you'd make a solid addition to the team.

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you’ll play a key role in protecting patient safety, maintaining high-quality clinical data, and ensuring investigative sites deliver studies in line with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), regulatory requirements, protocols, and SOPs.

You’ll take ownership of the full site monitoring lifecycle, from qualification and initiation through interim monitoring, site management, and close-out. You’ll work closely with sites and study teams to strengthen protocol adherence, resolve data queries, maintain essential documentation, and ensure safety information is appropriately reviewed and reported.

You’ll also have the opportunity to bring your experience beyond individual sites, acting as a Lead CRA on global studies, coordinating and mentoring CRAs, contributing to monitoring plans, reviewing visit reports, delivering training, and supporting study milestones.


Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across Spain. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.


What You'll Do

  • Lead site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, management, and close-out activities, ensuring compliance with protocols, GCP, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
  • Protect patient safety and data integrity by reviewing informed consent and safety information, conducting source document verification, reviewing CRFs, and supporting timely query resolution.
  • Guide sites in protocol adherence, Investigator Site File maintenance, regulatory and ethics documentation, investigational product accountability, and ongoing study requirements.
  • Coordinate CRAs as a Lead CRA on global studies and provide mentoring, training, accompanied visits, and practical guidance to less experienced colleagues and site staff.
  • Partner with Project Management and study teams to evaluate deliverables, study milestones, site performance, and monitoring activities.
  • Develop monitoring plans, study-specific tools, templates, and training materials as requested to support consistent study delivery.
  • Review site visit reports and provide clear feedback and edits while ensuring relevant site documentation is maintained for filing in the Trial Master File.
  • Contribute your clinical monitoring expertise to study team and investigator meetings, bid defenses, and the design of protocols and CRFs.

What You'll Bring

  • Education and CRA experience: an MD or Pharmacy qualification (MSPH, PharmD, PhD, equivalent Pharmacy degree, or similar) with at least 3 years’ CRA experience; or a minimum four-year college curriculum in medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or another related science with at least 5 years’ CRA experience; or a two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training, preferably a nursing or equivalent life science degree, with at least 7 years’ CRA experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of clinical research principles and processes, with a thorough understanding of FDA and/or EU regulations and directives, ICH Guidelines, local regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Strong therapeutic-area expertise, with a thorough understanding of two to three therapeutic areas sufficient to operate as a Lead CRA where appropriate.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, planning, organizational, time-management, initiative, and problem-solving skills, alongside the ability to lead and motivate an assigned team when applicable.
  • Technical proficiency with Microsoft Office, IxRS, and electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Experience in full-service monitoring PREFERRED.
  • Valid current passport and driving licence, with willingness to travel as required.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English, together with fluency in the local languages of the countries under responsibility.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

This is a remote, flexible role. We ask that you're available for team syncs and client calls during US Pacific Time hours, with overlap until at least 3 PM PT (San Francisco time).

You don't need years of recruiting experience to apply. What we care about most is that you're thoughtful, motivated, coachable, and take ownership of your work. We'll teach you the rest - including every tool in our stack.

raw.description:
About Vouched

At Vouched we are building a powerful identity verification platform to provide worldwide access to life’s most critical services, including healthcare, financial services, rentals, and more. Companies use Vouched to verify identity while onboarding and authenticating users. We make identity verifi cation easy with a combination of machine learning and data checks. Our customers leverage our APIs, integrations, and no-code solution to onboard customers to their systems.

What We Do

  • Verify thousands of people every day across multiple countries and industries providing access to critical services
    • Serve fast-growing startups, unicorns, and large enterprises, with a focus on providing fast, easy integration for developers
    • Run on a modern cloud infrastructure powered by automated integration and unit testing, provisioning, deployments, monitoring, and notifications
    • Operate in a highly regulated, security-sensitive space. Safeguarding personal and identity data is core to everything we ship
    • Drive to own the market and deliver a world-changing client and end-user experience

We are a small but mighty team looking for people who align with our values and have a strong sense of hustle, creative problem solving, grit and energy to help us scale! We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a Senior QA/SDET who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is passionate about building quality into every release alongside a talented team. The ideal candidate blends a tester's instinct for finding what breaks with strong software engineering skills, partnering closely with engineering, product, and ML stakeholders to ensure the platform that powers identity verification for customers around the world works correctly, every time.

You will own quality across the full product lifecycle, from reviewing requirements and designs through test planning, automation, release validation, and production verification. You will build and maintain the test frameworks, automated suites, and quality gates that let our team ship quickly and with confidence across our APIs, web capture SDK, mobile SDKs, and customer dashboard.

Security and compliance are central to this role. Because Vouched handles sensitive personal and identity data, we expect you to treat security, privacy, and regulatory compliance as first-class, non-negotiable quality requirements. You will design tests that verify access controls, data handling, and auditability, help produce test evidence that supports our compliance posture across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, etc., and ensure that test environments and test data never expose real personal information.

You should be someone who is deep into the details, who partners with teammates to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Correctness matters at Vouched: a missed edge case can block a real person from accessing healthcare or financial services. We expect our Senior QA/SDET to foster a culture of shared ownership of quality by championing testability, facilitating open conversations about release risk, and working with the team to catch issues long before they reach customers.

A critical component of this role is the fluent use of modern AI-powered tooling to accelerate test development. You will be expected to leverage tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and similar platforms, to rapidly produce test plans, automated tests, test data, and quality tooling. We expect AI-accelerated workflows that turn product knowledge into reproducible, maintainable, and trustworthy automated coverage rather than manual, one-off regression passes. The ability to use AI tools to scaffold test suites, generate edge-case scenarios, accelerate failure triage, and build internal tooling that engineering can rely on is essential and not optional.

Experience working with distributed teams, strong written and verbal communication skills, and a bias toward action are essential. While knowledge of AI-based identity verification products is a plus, a passion for working with innovative technologies and helping to scale a dynamic team is key.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the test strategy for the Vouched platform, balancing unit, integration, API, end-to-end, and exploratory testing to maximize risk coverage and release speed.
    • Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for our REST APIs, web capture SDK, mobile SDKs (iOS and Android), and customer dashboard.
    • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines as quality gates, keeping suites fast, reliable, and free of flaky tests so every change ships with confidence.
    • Validate identity verification flows end to end across real devices, browsers, cameras, and network conditions, including document capture, selfie and liveness checks, and webhook delivery.
    • Build and curate safe, synthetic test data (ID documents, selfies, and identity records) that exercises edge cases across countries and document types without using real personal data.
    • Test for security and privacy: authentication and authorization, input validation, PII handling and redaction, and data retention, partnering with security on vulnerability findings.
    • Support compliance readiness by producing traceable test evidence and change-validation records for frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR (HIPAA a plus).
    • Drive performance, load, and reliability testing to ensure our APIs and processing pipeline meet latency and throughput targets as we scale.
    • Partner with ML engineers to validate model and pipeline changes using regression datasets and accuracy benchmarks before they reach production.
    • Own release validation and sign-off ; triage, reproduce, and root-cause defects, including production issues reported by customers, and turn every escaped bug into lasting automated coverage.
    • Define and report on quality metrics (defect escape rate, automation coverage, flakiness, time-to-detect) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
    • Leverage AI-powered tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others) to accelerate test creation, test data generation, and failure triage.
    • Champion a culture of quality across engineering by reviewing designs and pull requests for testability and mentoring engineers on testing best practices.
    • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve test speed, coverage, and reliability.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in software quality engineering, including at least 3 years as an SDET or test automation engineer within a software engineering organization.
    • Strong programming skills in at least one language used for test automation (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, or Kotlin/Swift) and a track record of writing clean, maintainable test code.
    • Hands-on experience building and scaling test automation frameworks for web UIs and APIs (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Selenium, Jest, Postman, or similar).
    • Experience testing mobile applications or SDKs on iOS and Android (Appium, XCUITest, Espresso, or similar), including real-device clouds such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs.
    • Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar) and working with containerized and cloud environments (Docker, GCP preferred).
    • Experience with performance and load testing tools (k6, Gatling, JMeter, or similar) and using observability tools (Datadog or equivalent) to investigate failures.
    • Solid understanding of security and privacy testing: authentication and authorization, OWASP Top 10, input validation, and safe handling of PII in test environments.
    • Experience working in regulated environments and supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, including test evidence and audit readiness.
    • Proficiency with AI-powered development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent; demonstrated ability to accelerate test development with them.
    • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills across the stack, from client to API to database.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write clear test plans, bug reports, and quality reports.
    • Experience working in a startup environment is required.
    • Experience managing or collaborating with distributed teams is essential.
    • Familiarity with identity verification, computer vision, or AI/ML-based solutions, or with testing ML model quality, is a plus.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Position:

Grant Management Consultant

Reports to:

People Leader, Program Excellence & Impact Delivery

Position Term:

Consultant / Independent Contractor

Primary Location:

Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Workplace Type:

Remote (Canada-based; international travel as required)

Job Purpose The Grant Management Consultant will work collaboratively across Program & Policy (P&P), the World Vision Partnership, and with Field Offices, Regional Offices, and the Global Centre to support delivery against P&P’s three strategic priorities: Impact, Income, and Influence. The Consultant will provide end-to-end grant management expertise to optimize resources, strengthen delivery quality, and ensure institutional donor-funded projects are implemented in line with approved project design documents, donor agreements, and World Vision standards. This includes providing technical guidance, monitoring and evaluation support, and strategic oversight throughout the grant lifecycle. The Consultant will serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned grants and relevant geographic, management and/or technical areas, synthesizing and communicating project progress, results, risks, and learning to a range of internal and external stakeholders. They will work alongside peer consultants and internal teams to coordinate workloads, troubleshoot challenges, and contribute to communities of practice and knowledge sharing. Responsibilities

Provide grant management and advisory support to ensure high-quality execution, effective risk management, delivery of intended outcomes, and fulfillment of donor commitments and contractual obligations.

Oversee implementation progress to ensure results and donor reports are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with institutional donor requirements.

Design and operationalize reporting and learning processes that communicate results clearly and incorporate lessons learned to strengthen ongoing and future grant implementation.

Apply Results-Based Management (RBM) approaches and tools to track progress against objectives, outputs, and outcomes.

Coordinate and/or contribute to key grant deliverables, including project start-up workshops, partner agreements, workplans, donor reports, annual reviews, evaluations, and project close-out activities.

Support knowledge management and learning by documenting and sharing project achievements and insights through partnership meetings, donor engagement, academic forums, and print and digital communications.

In collaboration with WVC MEAL and technical specialists, provide technical support for assessments, surveys, evaluations, and the establishment of monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning (MEAL) systems.

Work closely with the Grant Finance Officer and WVC Legal team to support the preparation, review, and negotiation of donor contracts and amendments.

In collaboration with Program Finance, monitor project financial performance, including expenditures, cash flow, recovery of overheads, financial risks, and funding timelines, and flag risks or issues requiring corrective action.

Qualifications

University degree in international development, community/social development, business development, or a related field.

5–7 years of demonstrated experience managing or advising on institutional donor-funded international grants and projects.

Strong experience applying Results-Based Management approaches and designing or supporting Monitoring & Evaluation systems.

Proven experience supporting or coordinating remote, cross-functional, and cross-cultural teams delivering development projects.

Experience engaging with academic and/or research partners is an asset.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information clearly for diverse audiences.

Strong attention to detail, particularly in reviewing project documentation and providing high-quality technical feedback.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively across organizational boundaries and cultures to support alignment with strategic priorities.

Ability to manage multiple streams of work simultaneously with sound judgment, initiative, and confidence.

Availability and willingness to travel internationally as required (approximately once per year), including to higher-risk environments.

Why Consider Us?

World Vision Canada has consistently been awarded Canada and GTA top employer awards. We are Canada’s largest development, relief, and advocacy non-profit organization. We embody an Agile mindset here.

Nature of the Engagement This is a consulting engagement, and the successful candidate will operate as an independent contractor or consultant. Specific deliverables, timelines, level of effort, and engagement duration will be defined in a contract or terms of reference. This posting is to establish a pre-qualified consultant talent pool for grant-funded work. It is not an active role and does not represent an immediate contract or employment opportunity. We are proactively identifying independent consultants who may be engaged on a contract basis should grant funding be approved.
