raw.description:
Position: Sales Development Representative

Salary: 25,000 ZAR to 30,000 ZAR

Working Hours: Aligned with UK Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor



ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is redefining human risk and secure behaviour management in cybersecurity. Trusted by global enterprises and high-growth mid-market organisations—including Vodafone, Merck, Arriva, and Hershey—the company reduces human cyber risk through AI-driven automation and cutting-edge Agentic AI solutions. We are scaling rapidly year-on-year, bringing our UK outbound engine in-house, and investing heavily in a modern, data-backed sales development function built for high performance and high autonomy.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As UK Outbound Sales Development Representative, you will sit at the very front of our growth engine. This is an autonomous, phone-first, results-driven seat responsible for establishing our in-house outbound presence in the UK market. You will target, engage, and qualify enterprise and mid-market security decision-makers—CISOs, Heads of Security, and IT Security Managers—booking high-value Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs) that directly build Keepnet’s sales pipeline.

Armed with an advanced outbound stack (including parallel diallers like Orum and Nooks, alongside HubSpot CRM), you will operate with freedom, high trust, and end-to-end account ownership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive Phone-First Multichannel Prospecting: Execute outbound campaigns across phone, email, and LinkedIn into UK B2B organisations, maintaining high daily call volumes via parallel dialling tools (Orum, Nooks) to maximise live decision-maker conversations.
  • Deliver Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs): Book meetings that actually take place with verified decision-makers (CISOs, IT Security Managers, and budget holders) in target accounts, operating against a target of your first QHM within 30 days and 10 QHMs per full production month post-ramp.
  • Execute Deep Discovery & Qualification: Apply the company's SDR Playbook (lightweight BANT and MEDDPICC frameworks) to uncover tooling gaps across phishing, vishing, smishing, and quishing, while assessing security awareness maturity.
  • Capitalise on Contract Renewal Windows: Identify current vendor relationships, contract lengths, and renewal dates, leveraging company's buy-back program to convert "in-contract" objections into active sales opportunities.
  • Maintain Channel & Conflict Awareness: Pre-screen accounts for existing partner relationships (MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and resellers) and existing clients, resolving routing questions collaboratively before initiating outreach.
  • Ensure Seamless Handoffs: Document comprehensive, actionable discovery notes and transition booked meetings to Account Executives within 24 hours of scheduling.
  • Uphold Strict CRM Hygiene: Maintain HubSpot as the single source of truth—logging all interactions, preventing duplicate entries, and populating all mandatory qualification fields.
  • Operate with Built-In Compliance: Adhere strictly to UK GDPR, PECR, TPS/CTPS screening protocols, suppression list governance, opt-out handling, and approved messaging standards.
  • Feed Frontline Intelligence: Share objection patterns, competitor movement, and market feedback with Sales and Marketing to continuously sharpen outreach messaging and value propositions.

Requirements

  • 2 Years+ of B2B SaaS Outbound Experience: Proven track record in a dedicated SDR or BDR seat carrying quota, generating pipeline, and booking qualified discovery meetings.
  • Phone-First Craftsmanship: Exceptional cold-calling confidence and conversational fluency; skilled at hooking senior prospects in the opening seconds, navigating initial brush-offs, and steering live phone discovery.
  • Enterprise Prospecting Capability: Credibility and commercial acumen to hold substantive, peer-level conversations with senior IT, Security, and Compliance stakeholders in organisations with 1,000+ seats without needing to be an engineer.
  • Parallel Dialler & Tooling Literacy: Practical experience using parallel diallers (such as Orum, Nooks, or equivalent high-velocity calling software) alongside modern sales engagement tools.
  • CRM Discipline: Rigorous data and pipeline tracking habits, with willingness to complete HubSpot certifications if not already held.
  • Flawless Communication: Outstanding verbal and written English skills, capable of composing compelling, error-free executive messaging without supervision.
  • Self-Directed Remote Discipline: Strong operational independence to manage daily activity, pipeline numbers, and metrics aligned strictly with UK business hours from South Africa.
  • Independent Contractor Readiness: Legally set up to operate as an independent contractor or registered entity in South Africa, maintaining a professional home office, high-spec workstation, noise-cancelling headset, and stable fibre internet.

PREFERRED:

  • Direct experience prospecting into the UK B2B market from an offshore/remote setup.
  • Prior background selling or setting appointments within Cybersecurity or related high-compliance technical SaaS sectors.
  • Experience operating as an early or founding SDR, building outbound cadences, lists, and messaging frameworks from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with indirect channel sales models, including MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and value-added resellers.
  • Active hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and HubSpot CRM.

What You’ll Bring:

  • A Builder’s Mindset: You take full commercial ownership of your territory. If a workflow or list is suboptimal, you diagnose it, propose a solution, test it, and build a repeatable process.
  • High Question-to-Talk Ratio: The discipline that defines elite SDRs: asking sharp, incisive questions, actively listening, and documenting what prospects say—including negative signals—rather than pitching over objections.
  • Commercial Acumen over Rote Scripting: You do not rely on rigid scripts; you understand how enterprise businesses make procurement decisions, how risk is evaluated, and how to unearth real urgency.
  • Responsible Innovation: Familiarity with leveraging modern AI tools (such as Claude) within approved security and compliance guardrails to accelerate prospect research, personalise outreach, and streamline account tiering.
  • Resilience and Accountability: A relentless work ethic that thrives on pipeline creation, celebrates closed business, and takes pride in being the definitive first voice of the company in the UK market.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android Developerto build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Ciklum is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team full-time in Bulgaria.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Our client's infrastructure powers millions of live sports events worldwide - from raw video capture at remote venues to real-time stream delivery and ML-driven monetization. As a DevOps & Platform Engineer, you will be a core contributor to the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our cloud platform.
You'll work inside a self-service, pod-based engineering model where your job is to build the platforms, pipelines, and guardrails that let product teams ship independently - at high velocity and with full operational ownership. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact individual contributor role with a clear technical growth path.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain GitOps-based delivery pipelines (ArgoCD) so product pods deploy safely without DevOps intervention
  • Design and evolve self-service tooling - golden paths, deployment templates, scaffolding - that reduce pod dependency on the platform team
  • Implement deployment safety guardrails: config diffing, change ownership, rollout strategies, and audit trails
  • Adopt industry-leading AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, automation, and operational delivery

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering roles
  • Production-grade Kubernetes experience: EKS/GKE, GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux), service mesh, multi-tenant cluster operations, resource management
  • Deep hands-on GitOps and CI/CD: ArgoCD or Flux, Kustomize/Helm, rollout strategies, deployment safety, change ownership, audit trails
  • AWS platform depth: EC2, EKS, S3, CloudFront, IAM/IRSA, VPC networking, RDS, cost optimization levers
  • Platform engineering orientation - you think in platforms and self-service, not one-off scripts or manual runbooks
  • AI-first approach - actively uses AI tools to accelerate development and operations; not just aware of them, but fluent
  • Ownership mentality - own outcomes end-to-end, escalate only when truly blocked, and translate infrastructure complexity into business impact

Desirable:

Ready to make your career legendary? Join us as we bring the magic of Vegas to our players.   • Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities

  • Swag, ticket giveaways, and more!

At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win.

The Opportunity

About the Role

The Director, Customer Operations Platforms, will be responsible for developing and evangelizing the business strategy for BetMGM’s contact center platforms ecosystem. These tools include internal customer support and back office end users as well as some player-facing support journeys such as chatbot, help pages, IVR, etc. The ideal candidate will be data and customer-obsessed, understand how to use qualitative and quantitative research as well as a consultative approach to ensure our associate and player-facing support solutions are built with the flexibility, performance and scalability needed to serve our evolving business.

Your team is also responsible for ensuring the administering routine requests from contact center users, such as working triage tickets, updating user permissions, on/off-boarding, modifying voice and digital channel prompts, performing user access audits, ensuring compliance with Company policies and more.

Leveraging your experience in the contact center industry, you’ll develop best practices around contact center technology procedures, utilize technology solutions to solve business problems, embrace a continuous improvement culture, foster feedback loops with key stakeholders, define KPIs for your business area, and more. We work in a blended in- and out-sourced agent environment which will require you to supervise external partners in the discharge of their obligations as defined by BetMGM Security & Technology teams.


The Director, Customer Operations Platforms must be a dynamic leader and highly impactful communicator who can galvanize the team around a clear vision for the future. You will also keep a close eye on the agentic-AI and contact center technologies landscape, drawing inspiration from a wide variety of digital products and experiences to inform your strategy. 

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Define and articulate a clear contact center platform business strategy across multiple technology platforms which includes telephony platform(s), chat/messaging services, CRMs, WFM forecasting & planning tools, and best practices around the same
  • Represent BetMGM in discussions with internal and external stakeholders regarding contact center platforming needs
  • Mentor and guide direct reports in their professional development
  • Partner with colleagues from the Product organization to align player support with Product’s vision and roadmap for the overall player experience
  • Actively participate in prioritization discussions and, when necessary, advocate for the advancement of contact center initiatives
  • Form strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Define and report out KPIs for the contact center platforms team and the applications they support
  • Manage internal and external vendors for performance and assigned deliverables
  • Build scalable structures for such things as deferred workload (e.g. queued tickets, triaging incidents, etc.); feedback loops, communication strategies, vendor management, change management, version control, SOPs, etc.
  • Act as day-to-day POC for outsource partners regarding platforming and security items, then interface internally as needed with other stakeholders for such things as:
  • Collecting AOCs
  • Handling incidents other than those that require notification to NOC
  • Periodic testing to ensure compliance with policies (e.g. agent inability to reach Gmail, Facebook, etc.)
  • Maintain playbooks for outages/incidents within Customer Service and with Business Process Outsourcers (partnering with others internally as needed)
  • Develop and maintain process/procedure documentation for agent tools

What You Bring to the Table (Qualifications)

  • 10+ years of experience as a direct owner of and decision-maker for contact center platforms and technology
  • 5+ years leading teams responsible for administering contact center platforms
  • 5+ years hands-on experience building and/or administering contact center-related platforms
  • Proven experience developing and executing against a contact center technology strategy
  • Experience directly leading transformative change project such as platform migrations, cross-platform integrations, etc.
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence managing varying levels of stakeholders
  • Adaptability and ability to pivot easily to keep pace with changing business demands
  • Experience working at innovative and fast-paced environments

Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration sponsorship. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship including H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN, OPT, etc.

137,200.00--182,900.00

Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for participation in a performance-based bonus plan.

Gaming Compliance & Licensing Requirements

As an online gaming company, BetMGM is required to comply with state gaming regulations which includes licensing obligations. Applicable employees must be licensed by at least one jurisdictional agency, although certain positions require licensing by multiple agencies. Failure to become licensed or maintain licensure with each agency as required for the role may result in termination of employment. Please note that the licensing process includes comprehensive background checks which may include a review of criminal records, financial history, and personal background verification.

In addition, candidates must comply with and support BetMGM's responsible gambling policies, procedures, and initiatives.

About BetMGM

BetMGM is revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We are a partnership between two powerhouse organizations—MGM Resorts International and Entain Group. You know our name through our exciting portfolio of brands including BetMGM Casino, BetMGM Sportsbook, Borgata Online, Party Casino and Party Poker. About Our Client

Our client is a busy founder who needs dependable support across personal administration, scheduling, household coordination, and family logistics. They've documented their systems for recurring tasks, including travel preferences, ordering habits, and decision-making processes, so the right hire can execute with confidence from day one.

About the Role

We're looking for a Personal Executive Assistant to support a founder and their family across personal administration, scheduling, household coordination, family logistics, and social events. The role is primarily personal: the starting point is appointment making, and everything else builds from there as trust is established.

You'll access a shared brain of documented preferences and systems daily and execute from it. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. The ideal hire is proactive, confident stating their own needs and preferences, takes full ownership of tasks end to end, and uses AI tools, including Claude Cowork, as a real part of how they work.

Responsibilities

  • Make outbound calls during business hours to schedule and coordinate appointments, the starting point and core of the role
  • Set up medical, personal, and professional appointments for the founder and their family
  • Sync across multiple calendars, including the founder, partner, and childcare, and manage conflicts proactively
  • Coordinate with the nanny on scheduling and logistics
  • Use the shared brain daily to execute tasks from documented preferences and systems rather than asking repeated clarifying questions, and help keep it current
  • Use Claude Cowork and other AI tools as a core part of planning and executing tasks, and help refine how AI is used across personal and household operations
  • Support planning and logistics for hosted dinners and community events
  • Manage takeout ordering from documented preferred restaurants and order history, placing orders directly via DoorDash or similar platforms
  • Assist with family logistics, including baby-related tasks and family administrative tasks, using established systems

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience as a personal assistant, household manager, or family EA supporting a high-trust principal
  • Genuinely proactive, taking ownership of tasks end to end without waiting for detailed direction
  • Comfortable stating your own preferences and needs as part of a healthy working relationship
  • Confident making outbound calls during US business hours to coordinate appointments and logistics on behalf of others
  • Familiarity with Claude Cowork, or strong willingness and aptitude to learn it quickly, as AI fluency is expected
  • Discreet, reliable, and highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable working within documented systems and preferences rather than building from scratch

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Claude Cowork or similar AI workflow tools
  • Background coordinating household staff, childcare logistics, or family scheduling
  • Experience supporting social event planning or community hosting
  • Familiarity with managing shared documentation systems or knowledge bases

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US Pacific Time business hours

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your experience supporting a principal across personal and household logistics, and explaining how you use AI tools as part of your daily workflow

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Director, Procure to Pay Operations to lead our Accounts Payable function and guide it through its next stage of growth.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Director, Procure to Pay Operations to lead our Accounts Payable function and guide it through its next stage of growth. You will own the end-to-end AP lifecycle: non-PO invoice processing, payment runs and bank file management, supplier onboarding and master data integrity, and the handling of returned EFTs, stale-dated checks, and unclaimed property. You will lead a team of AP Managers who oversee back-office and shared services staff. You will set the standard for accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows payment operations in detail. You will manage ACH, wire, check, and international payment processes. You will make sure every payment, including ad hoc and off-cycle payments, goes out accurately, on time, and with proper controls. You will protect the organization through strong internal controls, SOX compliance, tax reporting oversight, and proactive defense against fraud, including business email compromise and payment redirection schemes.

You will also shape the future of AP. Working closely with IT, Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Purchasing, and Sourcing, you will develop a forward-looking strategy built on automation and self-service. You will lead system enhancements on Oracle Fusion Cloud, and you will contribute to migrations, acquisitions, and process integrations.

What You Bring

You are a seasoned AP leader with at least 5 – 7 years of experience. You have managed managers, and you have run a back-office or shared services operation. You have deep knowledge of payment methods and banking, including ACH/NACHA, and you have hands-on experience with return EFTs, stale checks, and escheatment. Oracle Fusion Cloud experience is a must. You communicate clearly, influence people at every level, and stay effective in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent experience is required.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop AP Managers, who in turn manage back-office staff.
  • Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.

Invoice Processing

  • Oversee the full invoice lifecycle for non-PO invoices.
  • Reduce manual work through automation, improvements, and analysis of exceptions.
  • Handle invoice questions, discrepancies, duplicate invoice prevention, and recovery of overpayments and credits.

Payment File Management

  • Own the scheduled payment run process, including ACH, wire, check, and international payments.
  • Oversee creation, transmission, and reconciliation of payment files to banks.
  • Manage ad hoc and off-cycle payment files, including manual, and exception payments, with proper approvals and controls.
  • Ensure compliance with bank cutoffs and payment policies.
  • Coordinate with Treasury on cash forecasting, funding, and payment timing.

Return EFTs, Stale-Dated Checks, and Unclaimed Property

  • Manage the process for returned or rejected EFT/ACH payments. This covers investigating the cause, validating bank details, re-issuing payments, and correcting the supplier master data.
  • Manage voids and reissues.
  • Manage the stale-dated check process.
  • Ensure compliance with escheatment and unclaimed property regulations, working with Legal, Tax, and Accounting.

Supplier Onboarding and Change Requests (Internal and External)

  • Own the supplier onboarding process, including W-9/W-8 collection, TIN matching, and bank account validation.
  • Manage supplier master data change requests from internal requestors and external suppliers. These include banking changes, remit-to updates, and legal name or address changes.
  • Maintain supplier data integrity through regular cleansing, duplicate detection, and inactive-supplier handling
  • Work to enhance supplier portal and self-service tools to reduce manual intervention.

Controls, Compliance, and Audit

  • Maintain a strong internal control environment, including SOX controls where applicable.
  • Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, and Compliance on testing and remediation.
  • Ensure compliance with tax reporting (1099, VAT/GST, and withholding) in partnership with Tax.
  • Define, document, and update policies, procedures, and desk-level instructions.
  • Monitor and mitigate fraud risk, including business email compromise and payment redirection schemes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • IT: Partner on ERP, AP automation, bank connectivity, and system integrations. Lead UAT, defect resolution, and roadmap prioritization.
  • Purchasing and Sourcing: Align on AP processes, supplier setup, and payment terms.
  • Treasury, Accounting, Tax, and Legal: Coordinate on working capital initiatives, cash management, month end close, reconciliations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Business Stakeholders: Resolve escalations and communicate expectations on approvals and turnaround times.

Strategy, Process Improvement, and Reporting

  • Develop a forward-looking AP strategy that considers automation
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to system implementations, migrations, acquisitions, and process integrations.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • 5 – 7 years required, 10+ years desired of AP experience, including at least 5 – 7 years managing an AP operations team.
  • Demonstrated experience managing managers and a back office or shared services team.
  • Deep knowledge of the full AP lifecycle, including invoice processing, payment runs, supplier maintenance, and exception handling.
  • Hands-on experience with ad hoc payment files, return EFTs, stale checks, and escheatment processes.
  • Strong understanding of payment methods and banking, including ACH/NACHA, wires, and checks.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud is a must.
  • Strong knowledge of internal controls, fraud prevention, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent critical thinking, forward planning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to move swiftly, multitask, and reprioritize in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels and across departments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.

May require a background check due to job duties requiring routine access to DIRECTV and DIRECTV customer’s proprietary data. Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction will be considered for employment in accordance with local ordinances and state law.

This is a remote position that can be located anywhere in the United States, excluding Alaska. Candidates located in the Central or Eastern U.S. are preferred to best align with AP operational hours.

A career with us comes with big rewards:

Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Australia-based Product Marketing Manager to give this high-growth market our dedicated, full-time focus within our Product organisation.

Sitting directly alongside our Australian commercial teams, you will take full ownership of ensuring that what we build globally lands with genuine impact locally. You will translate product capabilities into compelling customer narratives that reflect how Australian salon and clinic owners actually talk, work, and grow their businesses.

You won't be starting from zero. You will plug into established launch playbooks and share learnings with peer PMMs based in North America, DACH, and the UK and Ireland. Working during Australian business hours, you will lead local launch readiness, educate our regional Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams, and drive sustainable adoption and revenue growth across the region.

What You'll Do

  • Customer and Market Intelligence:Act as the strategic voice of the Australian customer. Phorest strongly champions direct customer contact, so you will regularly jump on calls with local salon, spa, and clinic owners to understand how they run their day-to-day, what causes friction, and the actual language they use. You'll also have the option to attend key local customer and industry events alongside our regional Sales and Marketing teams. While event travel isn't mandatory, our PMMs find it one of the most effective ways to meet clients and prospects face-to-face, soak up market dynamics, and gather unfiltered feedback.

  • Narrative and Positioning:Own how our products are positioned in Australia. Take global feature sets and translate them into human, ‘feelings over features’ customer stories that cut through technical jargon and resonate directly with local operators.

  • Commercial Partnership and Strategic Enablement:Work hand in hand with our regional Sales, Customer Success, and Education teams on the ground. Act as a strategic partner rather than an order taker. You will listen to field feedback, push back constructively on low-impact ad hoc requests, and build the foundational talk tracks, battlecards, and objection guides that set local teams up to hit regional revenue and retention targets.

  • GTM Execution and Launch Readiness:Lead regional go-to-market execution for product releases. Partner closely with Product Ops and peer PMMs across other regions to keep launch milestones on track, ensuring local commercial teams are thoroughly trained, confident, and equipped with client-facing materials before features go live.

  • Experimental Communication:Bring a curious, test-and-learn mindset to how we reach the market. If standard channels like email or webinars aren't landing with local customers or sales teams, proactively test new formats, messaging angles, and delivery methods to drive engagement and adoption.

What Success Looks Like

  • There is always a clear line between your day-to-day work and the region's commercial objectives.

  • Regional Sales, CS, and Marketing teams feel confident pitching new capabilities because your messaging reflects how Australian salon and clinic owners actually talk and work.

  • Local customer-facing teams actively bring you into customer challenges and rely on your strategic advice, viewing you as an indispensable partner rather than an order taker.

  • You stay self-directed and productive during Australian business hours while maintaining smooth, asynchronous alignment with teammates across other time zones.

Who You Are

You are a curious, commercially minded storyteller who loves turning complex product features into clear, relatable stories. You enjoy setting other people up for success, and you get genuine satisfaction from doing the deep groundwork that helps customer-facing teams shine in front of clients.

You'll thrive in this role if you are:

  • You bring a calm head to shifting priorities and view the absence of rigid process as an opportunity to build practical solutions that leave a mark.

  • You listen carefully to what sales and commercial teams ask for, but step back and evaluate the bigger picture before jumping into execution.

  • You don't need a huge army of specialists to get things done; you're comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write clean copy, pull your own Looker reports, and test ideas directly.

  • You enjoy having daily ownership over your calendar and priorities. You know when to run ahead independently and when to sync asynchronously with global counterparts, with the flexibility to occasionally overlap with European/US hours to connect with your manager and global peers.

What You Bring

  • Typically 3 to 5 years of Product Marketing experience (or equivalent B2B/Vertical SaaS commercial experience), with a track record of taking features to market and driving adoption.

  • Demonstrated experience marketing to distinct, niche audiences or complex ecosystems where different users within the same business have different motivations.

  • Practical experience across the full product marketing lifecycle, including customer research, positioning, messaging, launch planning, and sales enablement.

  • Comfort using Looker (or similar BI dashboard tools) to evaluate adoption numbers, track funnel metrics, and assess launch performance.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to strip away jargon and articulate value simply to both technical teams and busy business owners.

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.

Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

raw.title: International Recruiter – European Customer Service Roles – Cebu City
raw.excerpt: European roles, your afternoon hours.  No night shift.
raw.description:
European roles, your afternoon hours. No night shift. If you recruit for foreign clients from the Philippines, this is the same game, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Cebu City and across the Philippines.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

This is NOT for you if

  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • A direct line to us for any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

Senior Electrical Engineer, Analog & Mixed-Signal

Location: NYC

About Us

Voyant Photonics is transforming machine perception with a new class of LiDAR devices that are compact enough to fit in the palm of your hand and powerful enough to measure range, velocity, and reflectivity with unparalleled accuracy. By leveraging cutting-edge silicon photonic chips smaller than your fingertip, we deliver sensors that are not only revolutionary in performance but also affordable enough to integrate into any system.

Our technology disrupts the status quo of bulky, expensive, and power-hungry LiDAR systems, making high-precision sensing accessible for widespread adoption in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, industrial automation, and beyond. With Voyant, the next generation of machines can see, understand, and navigate the world like never before.

Discover how we're redefining what's possible by making real products out of cutting-edge research in silicon photonics.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a senior hardware leader to set the technical direction for the analog and mixed-signal electronics behind our LiDAR modules. You'll operate at the intersection of product design, silicon photonics, and machine perception — owning the hardest trade-offs, setting the standard other engineers build to, and mentoring the team as we scale. This is a high-leverage role for someone who wants their fingerprints on a foundational technology, not just a single product.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the analog and mixed-signal architecture for next-generation LiDAR modules, setting technical direction across TIAs, ADCs, precision current sources, and power delivery (LDOs, switching regulators).

  • Act as the technical authority on signal integrity, power integrity, and EMI/EMC across the product line — establish the design standards and review processes the rest of the team works to.

  • Lead bring-up, characterization, and validation strategy (EVT/DVT/PVT) across multiple concurrent programs, with accountability for robustness, repeatability, and manufacturability at scale.

  • Own the highest-stakes design trade-offs (performance, cost, power, integration complexity) that shape product roadmap and unit economics.

  • Mentor and provide technical direction to other hardware engineers; serve as the senior technical voice in cross-functional reviews with system architects, mechanical engineering, and firmware.

  • Drive supplier and component strategy for critical analog parts, engaging directly with vendors and foundries on custom or constrained components.

  • Represent hardware engineering in technical deep-dives with customers, partners, and investors as needed.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in hands-on hardware development, with end-to-end ownership of multiple systems shipped at high volume.

  • Leadership: Track record of setting technical direction for a team or product line — not only individual delivery.

  • Technical Strengths:

    • Recognized expert in low-noise analog and high-speed digital design.

    • Go-to authority on signal/power integrity, high-density interconnect, and EMI mitigation techniques.

    • Proven success driving designs through high-volume DFM, reliability testing, and yield optimization.

  • Tools & Skills:

    • Expert in schematic capture and simulation (e.g., SPICE), with deep fluency in Altium or similar.

    • Advanced use of SI/PI simulation tools (e.g., HyperLynx, SiWave) and measurement tools (GHz-range scopes, VNAs, spectrum analyzers).

    • Extensive experience integrating FPGAs, microcontrollers, and custom analog ASICs at the board level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in photonics, LiDAR, or other precision-sensing hardware.

  • Experience building or scaling a hardware engineering team, or serving formally as a technical lead/architect.

  • Knowledge of flex and rigid-flex PCB design.

  • Familiarity with Verilog-AMS, mixed-signal modeling, or FPGA development.

  • Experience designing for high-reliability or harsh environments (e.g., automotive, aerospace, defense).

Benefits Package

  • Competitive base salary and a meaningful equity package.

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision).

  • Unlimited PTO and paid company holidays.

  • Team events and company meetups.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Voyant Photonics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $140K - $170K

Title:Manager of Budget & Financial Planning

Staff Group:Finance

* Location is open in the continental United States. You should have easy access to a major airport due to the travel requirements of this position.

Purpose

Under the direction of the VP for Finance & Investments (VPFI), the Manager of Budget and Financial Planning (MBFP) is responsible for development and stewardship of the Association’s operating and capital budgets and the system (currently Workday Adaptive) in which they are prepared, stored, and used for reporting. Their responsibilities include preparing detailed strategic financial analyses and scenario modeling, capital planning and expenditures analyses, managing stafffootprint, stewardship and reporting, and other research and analyses as needed.

Central functions include presentation development of the Association’s board approved multi-year operating and capital budgets, preparing budget forecasts, system administration and training, capital planning, analytics and scenario modeling, development of programmatic financial models, and making recommendations on effective resource allocations. These responsibilities require extensive and inclusive collaboration across all stakeholder groups and subject matter experts to develop the revenue and expense assumptions necessary for realistic and reliable financial models and projections.

This role will also support the financial planning needs of Programs & Ministries reporting to the VP and working in partnership with their direct reports. They would work closely with the VP and their team of direct reports to create departmental and programmatic budgets and their presentation, provide financial and budget leadership and guidance to the individuals across those groups involved, and strategic planning to ensure the financial impacts are captured.

Reports to the VP Finance & Investments with a dotted line to the VP for Programs & Ministries (70% VPFI, 30% VPPM)

Principal Responsibilities

Oversee the development of the association’s annual operating and capital budgets: (30%)

  • Design, develop, and coordinate the annual budget development process and calendar.
  • Enhance the association’s budget process by creating budget templates, planning guidelines, and other documents used by divisions and budget managers to submit budget information.
  • Consolidate budget requests and other budget information and prepare budget forecasts for presentation to the VPFI, shared governance groups, Board of Trustees meetings and others as needed, and have follow-up conversations and prepare additional research and analysis to ensure the accuracy and completeness of all budget information and reports.
  • Continually assess the budget process and effectiveness and efficiency of the college’s resource allocations to ensure effective linkage to strategic priorities.

2. Responsible for system management and strategic financial and budget analyses: (20%)

  • Advance and maintain the Workday Adaptive long-range modeling and budget development system and ensure the accuracy and completeness of all budget and financial models and forecasts. Ensure Level 1 support is internal. Manage the integration and the relationship with accounting’s Blackbaud’s FENXT system.
  • Development of programmatic, auxiliary and administrative financial models and reports; conduct ad hoc and routine financial analyses as needed on existing as well as potential new initiatives; and support and advise the Vice President of Finance & Investment (VPFI).

5. Manages key relationships with Vice Presidents and their leadership teams, AVPs/Directors, budget managers, and other staff across the virtual environment. Collaboration with stakeholders is paramount to the development of realistic, reliable financial models and budget forecasts in support of the association’s strategic decisions and excellence in fiscal stewardship. (15%)

6. Work with the VPPM and their direct reports to develop and maintain their budget framework, and provide leadership and guidance to the staff within Programs & Ministries that have financial responsibilities (30%)

7. Performs all other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the VPFI, VPs or President. This may include attendance and participation in required training for this role. (5%)

Qualifications

This position hasmidpoint of $74,00. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and geographical location, with offers potentially ranging from 10-15% higher or lower than the midpoint.Requirements include:

  • B.S. or B.A. degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field
  • Five years of demonstrated experience in system-wide budgeting, system optimization, business planning, financial analysis, and strategic planning.
  • Advanced level of technical expertise (e.g., Excel, Word, Workday Adaptive or other budget and long-range modeling practices, Google Suite, data warehouse tools, report writing tools) and experience managing and analyzing large data sets
  • Deep expertise and extensive experience with budget development and stewardship, and understanding of financial reporting principles used by not-for-profit organizations; extensive knowledge of the association industry, business models and market factors/trends preferred
  • Ability to interpret and communicate complex policies and procedures
  • Proven leadership and strong communication skills
  • Experience working in large, highly collaborative environments
  • Ability to work independently with high reliability, accuracy, and productivity
  • Ability to handle confidential information responsibly
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain harmonious working relationships and address complex administrative issues effectively
  • Proven track record in exercising discretion and independent judgment in decision-making processes
  • Experience managing multiple projects with critical deadlines.

How to Apply

People with disabilities, people of color, indigenous people, Hispanic/Latinx, and LGBTQ candidates are encouraged to apply. The UUA is committed to developing a diverse and talented staff team. If you are excited about thisrole, butare unsure whether you meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage you to inquire and/or apply. Please submit your resume and cover letter via our applicant portal (ADPWorkforceNow)on uua.org/jobs.If you have any questions, please reach out .

About the UUA

The Unitarian Universalist Association is a progressive religious denomination headquartered in Boston’s waterfront Fort Point Innovation District. Our faith community of more than 1,000 self-governing congregations brings to the world a vision of religious freedom, tolerance, and social justice. Our normal workweek is 35 hours, we pay 80% contribution towards health insurance premiums, 10% towards retirement (after one year), and have generous paid time-off policies. We are a great place to work, and we value diversity. The UUA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the full inclusion of all. As part of this commitment, the UUA will ensure that applicants and staff with disabilities areprovidedreasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed toparticipatein the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact theDepartmentof Human Resources . For more information on the UUA, visit us online at UUA.org and uuworld.org.

Support for the Mission and Values of the Association

The Unitarian Universalist Association is a progressive and historic religious denomination. All UUA staff members are expected to perform their job duties in accordance with the UUA’s values, principles, and mission. Unitarian Universalism puts love at the center of our commitments, which embrace the Shared Values of justice, equity, transformation, interdependence, pluralism and generosity. The following points drawn from these Shared Values are of particular importance for the UUA’s work environment and staff culture:

  • Pluralism and generosity: We affirm the need for a human-centered workplace that allows our diverse staff to flourish. We also understand that our wider culture and society oppresses and denies human dignity, and we seek to counter the effects of that oppression in our hiring and workplace culture so that each person feels whole and valued.
  • Justice and equity: We speak openly and publicly of our support for social and political issues, including LGBTQ equity, racial justice, climate justice, gender equity, and reproductive justice.
  • Interdependence and transformation: We recognize that the liberation of all people is interwoven, and we work to counter patriarchy, white supremacy, colonialism, homophobia, transphobia, environmental exploitation, and other interrelated systems of marginalization.

Must possess strong expertise in existing & emerging business marketing solutions, coupled with the ability to collaborate with our sales partners, post sales optimizers to identify opportunities, and effectively deliver solutions that maximize a client's ROI; are minimum expectations. raw.description:
Love Turning Leads Into Revenue? So Do We.

At NewLaw Business Model, we're helping estate planning lawyers build thriving businesses through education, coaching, technology and managed services.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Specialist who combines commercial thinking, technical expertise and a passion for improving conversion.

This isn't a traditional CRM administration or sales support role. You'll partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to uncover revenue opportunities, evaluate solutions and build the systems and processes that help us attract, engage and convert more prospective members.

The Opportunity

You'll play a critical role in improving how NewLaw attracts, engages and converts prospective members across our education, membership and B2B managed-services offerings.

As a key partner to Sales and Marketing, you'll bring an independent, data-driven perspective to revenue performance—identifying what's working, where we're losing opportunities and what we should do differently.

You'll evaluate conversion challenges, recommend commercial and operational improvements, design more effective lead journeys and independently build the technology and tools needed to bring those ideas to life. This includes everything from HubSpot architecture, lead scoring and automated follow-up to conversion experiments, sales enablement, reporting and AI-powered workflows.

You'll have meaningful autonomy to investigate revenue performance, evaluate alternative approaches, recommend solutions, make implementation decisions within your area of responsibility and lead cross-functional improvements.

You'll also help establish the operational standards and systems that support a more efficient, scalable revenue engine.

Your work will directly influence conversion rates, sales effectiveness, customer acquisition efficiency and revenue growth.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Drive Conversion & Revenue Growth

  • Analyze the revenue funnel to identify conversion barriers and opportunities.

  • Develop and recommend strategies to improve lead engagement, sales effectiveness and customer acquisition.

  • Design and implement conversion experiments, funnel improvements and performance optimization initiatives.

Build Smarter Revenue Systems

  • Own and optimize HubSpot CRM architecture, lead scoring, segmentation, routing, automation and reporting.

  • Independently evaluate systems requirements and implement workflows that improve revenue operations.

  • Improve integrations and data flows connecting Marketing, Sales and downstream business processes.

Enable Sales & Marketing

  • Develop tools, workflows and resources that improve sales productivity and conversion.

  • Create and optimize lead nurture sequences, sales communications, landing page messaging and conversion assets.

  • Identify and implement AI-enabled tools that improve lead intelligence, follow-up and team effectiveness.

Turn Data Into Better Decisions

  • Build reporting that provides visibility into acquisition, engagement, conversion and sales performance.

  • Evaluate performance trends and recommend practical commercial improvements.

  • Lead cross-functional revenue initiatives from discovery through implementation and measurable results.

What “Success” Looks Like

  • Optimize our lead funnel: Identify conversion leakage and improve how prospects move from initial interest to becoming members.

  • Strengthen sales enablement: Build better tools, messaging, automations, and resources that help Sales convert more effectively.

  • Improve lead nurture: Create smarter, more personalized journeys that re-engage prospects and accelerate conversion.

  • Explore AI-powered growth: Implement practical AI and automation solutions that improve revenue team productivity and performance.

  • Build better revenue intelligence: Connect Marketing, Sales, and customer data to identify new growth opportunities.

Who You Are

You're a commercially minded, technically capable operator who combines independent judgment, analytical thinking and hands-on execution.

You don't just identify problems—you investigate, evaluate alternatives, recommend improvements and build the solutions.

You Bring:

  • Experience in Revenue Operations, Growth Operations, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations.

  • Advanced hands-on HubSpot expertise, including CRM architecture, workflows, automation and reporting.

  • Strong understanding of revenue funnels, CRO, lead management and sales conversion.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify and implement measurable commercial improvements.

  • Experience developing sales enablement tools, automated workflows and conversion-focused communications.

  • Strong analytical, project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Even Better If You Have:

  • Experience with education, memberships, SaaS or B2B managed services.

  • Experience with webinar funnels, lifecycle marketing or high-volume lead generation.

  • Familiarity with APIs, Zapier, Make, AI-enabled workflows or connected revenue systems.

  • Experience with sales messaging, conversion testing or CRM integrations.

You'll Thrive Here If...

  • You're curious about why people buy, what drives conversion and how to improve results.

  • You're a self-starter who sees opportunities and takes initiative.

  • You think strategically but love getting hands-on with implementation.

  • You're equally energized by creative experimentation, technology and data.

  • You enjoy challenging assumptions and testing new approaches.

  • You collaborate confidently with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

  • You thrive in an evolving organization with room to innovate and make an impact.

Why NewLaw?

  • Real ownership: Identify revenue opportunities and independently drive meaningful improvements.

  • Commercial impact: See how your work influences conversion, sales effectiveness and growth.

  • Technical innovation: Build smarter HubSpot systems, automations and AI-enabled workflows.

  • Opportunity to build: Help shape a growing Revenue Operations function.

  • Mission-driven work: Help lawyers build better businesses and serve families more effectively.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt (W2)

  • Annual Base Wage: Pay Range: $85,000-$95,000/ annually

    • Starting base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including geographic location, applicable experience, relevant skills, market data, and internal equity.

    • Bonus Eligibility: This position is eligible for company-wide and individual performance-based discretionary bonuses.

This is a 100% remote position open to qualified candidates authorized to work and residing anywhere in the continental United States, with the exception of California. NewLaw Business Model is not currently hiring or registered to employ individuals in the State of California for this position.


Benefits

  • 100% Remote Work at a Profitable, Growing Company

  • Recession-Proof Industry, Product, and Audience

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • 401K Retirement Program w/Discretionary Company Match

  • Flexible Paid Time Off*

  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Leadership Development

  • Be Part of a Mission-Driven Company Transforming the Legal Industry

    *Flexible PTO allows team members to self-manage time off for vacation, personal needs, and cultural or religious holidays of choice, and includes applicable statutory paid sick leave in accordance with state and local laws.

Interested? Let's Talk.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to maintain a revenue system, but wants to make it perform better. If you're excited about identifying growth opportunities, building better conversion experiences, and making a measurable impact on revenue, we'd love to hear from you. At NLBM, you’ll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact, scale your career in leadership, and be part of a passionate, supportive team driving innovation and change.

This is a 100% remote position. Team members are expected to maintain a dedicated workspace with reliable high-speed internet and hardware capable of running modern SaaS and automation workflows (minimum 16GB RAM). NewLaw provides all required software licenses, security access, and a monthly home office/technology allowance to assist with remote workspace and internet expenses.

New Law Business Model (NLBM) respects your time and work. Any portfolio materials, technical breakdowns, or operational insights submitted during this application process are requested solely for the purpose of assessing your qualifications for this position. NLBM will not use, publish, or commercially exploit any material submitted during your application process without your express written consent. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that any skills assessments do not create an employment relationship or a contract for services.

NLBM provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state laws. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interviewing process, please contact us at .

New Law Business Model is an equal opportunity organization. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. All qualified practitioners are encouraged to apply.

Highlights

Drive revenue growth across NewLaw's education, membership and B2B services by optimizing how we attract, engage and convert prospects, identifying opportunities and improving performance.

raw.description:
Inside Sales & Social Media Lead Closer

Remote – U.S.-Based | Flexible Schedule | Evening Availability Required

Own The Leads. Build Relationships. Close Business.

Are you someone who enjoys connecting with people, responding to opportunities, and turning conversations into sales?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where responsiveness, organization, and follow-through make the difference between winning and losing a customer?

Are you self-motivated, competitive, and someone who takes pride in making things happen without needing someone looking over your shoulder?

If so, Mongo Attachments has an opportunity for you!

We're looking for a driven, sales focused Inside Sales & Social Media Lead Closer to take ownership of our incoming lead management process, engage with prospective customers, and help grow our online presence.

This isn't simply a customer service or social media position – it's an opportunity to directly impact company revenue by managing incoming opportunities, developing new business through social media, following up with customers, and closing sales.

We're looking for someone who understands that speed matters, relationships matter, and every lead represents a potential sale. The right person will take ownership of the process, stay engaged, and consistently look for ways to generate business and improve results.

Location:100% Remote (U.S.-Based)

Schedule:Flexible scheduling with a strong emphasis on evening availability to align with peak incoming lead volume.

Important:This position requires someone who is comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and being available during evenings when prospective customers are actively reaching out.

What You'll Do

You'll be responsible for managing incoming sales opportunities, generating new business, and maintaining customer relationships by:

  • Managing and responding to all incoming leads in a timely, professional, and organized manner.
  • Following a structured lead management process to ensure no opportunities fall through the cracks.
  • Responding quickly to incoming Facebook messages and converting customer inquiries into sales opportunities.
  • Managing and maintaining lead information, communication history, and follow-up activities within Salesforce CRM.
  • Taking ownership of leads from initial inquiry through follow-up and closing.
  • Actively monitoring industry-specific Facebook Groups to identify potential customers and new business opportunities.
  • Initiating professional outbound conversations and developing new sales opportunities through social media.
  • Following up with previous customers to check on their experience, gather feedback, and identify additional product needs.
  • Identifying opportunities to upsell customers on additional attachments, accessories, and related products.
  • Proactively requesting customer reviews on Google and Facebook to strengthen Mongo Attachments' online reputation.
  • Maintaining consistent communication with prospective and existing customers to provide an exceptional customer experience.
  • Developing and following standard operating procedures to improve lead response times, follow-up consistency, and conversion rates.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve the lead management process, customer experience, and overall sales performance.
  • Staying productive during slower lead periods by taking initiative on administrative projects, market research, process improvements, and other business development activities.

What Makes You Successful

You're someone who:

  • Understands that speed and responsiveness are critical to converting online leads into customers.
  • Enjoys communicating with people and building relationships through phone, email, and social media.
  • Is confident, professional, and persuasive when communicating with prospective customers.
  • Takes ownership of every lead and understands the importance of consistent follow-up.
  • Is organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and opportunities simultaneously.
  • Is comfortable using social media as a tool to generate business, not simply as a platform for browsing.
  • Understands the importance of customer service and creating a positive customer experience.
  • Takes initiative and looks for opportunities to generate additional business.
  • Is self-motivated and capable of working independently without constant supervision.
  • Can manage their time effectively and stay productive in a remote work environment.
  • Is comfortable working flexible hours, including evenings when lead activity is highest.
  • Is motivated by performance and wants their compensation to reflect the results they produce.
  • Understands that the goal isn't simply to respond to leads – it's to convert them into customers.

Preferred Experience

  • 1–3 years of experience in inside sales, lead management, digital sales, or social media community management.
  • Proven experience working with Salesforce CRM or a comparable CRM platform (required).
  • Experience managing incoming leads and maintaining consistent follow-up processes.
  • Familiarity with Facebook Business Suite, Facebook Messenger, and Facebook Groups.
  • Experience generating business through social media engagement and outbound messaging.
  • Experience with customer retention, upselling, and post-sale follow-up.
  • Familiarity with Google Business Profile and online review management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and manage a flexible remote schedule.
  • Experience in construction equipment, heavy equipment, compact equipment, excavators, attachments, forestry, land management, or related industries is a plus.

Why Mongo Attachments?

Mongo Attachments is a growing competitor in the mini excavator attachment and accessory market, specializing in niche products for Micro-Mini, Mini, and Midi excavators. We serve both direct-to-consumer and dealer markets, with a commitment to providing quality products, quick lead and delivery times, and customer service that stands above the competition.

Our team comes from hands-on backgrounds in construction, forestry, and land management. We understand our customers because we've lived the work ourselves. We don't just sell attachments – we believe in the industries we serve and the people who make them successful.

When you join Mongo Attachments, you'll enjoy:

  • A competitive annual base salary of $42,000.
  • Additional sales commissions based on closed business, with significant earning potential.
  • Monthly performance bonuses for generating verified customer reviews.
  • Target earning potential of $60,000+ annually, with high-performing individuals having the opportunity to earn $80,000+.
  • 100% remote work environment.
  • Flexible scheduling based on business needs and performance, with evening availability required.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with up to a 4% company match.
  • Paid vacation / PTO and holidays.
  • The opportunity to directly impact company revenue and customer relationships.
  • The opportunity to grow alongside an expanding company.

How You'll Be Rewarded

We believe people who produce results should be rewarded for them. That's why this position includes an incentive structure that rewards both closed sales and contributions to our online reputation.

Sales Commission:

  • 1–15 closed sales per month: $50 per sale.
  • 16–30 closed sales per month: $75 per sale, retroactive to the first sale.
  • 31+ closed sales per month: $100 per sale, retroactive to the first sale.

Customer Review Bonuses:

  • Earn $150 for securing at least five verified 5-star customer reviews within a calendar month.
  • Earn an additional $25 for each verified review beyond the initial five.

The more business you generate and the more value you create, the greater your earning potential.

This Role Is Ideal for Someone Who...

  • Enjoys sales and wants to be directly involved in generating revenue.
  • Understands the importance of responding quickly and following up consistently.
  • Likes connecting with customers and turning conversations into business.
  • Is comfortable using Facebook and other digital platforms to develop new sales opportunities.
  • Takes pride in being organized, dependable, and accountable.
  • Doesn't need to be micromanaged and knows how to manage their time.
  • Can stay motivated and productive while working remotely.
  • Is willing to work evenings when customers are most active.
  • Is motivated by performance and wants their compensation to reflect their results.
  • Wants to play an important role in the growth of a company rather than simply fill a position.

Ready to Turn Leads Into Sales?

This is not a micromanaged position. We believe in giving the right person the flexibility, tools, and resources to manage their responsibilities and make an impact.

However, flexibility comes with high expectations. We're looking for someone who is responsive, driven, organized, accountable, and committed to producing results.

We don't need someone who simply answers messages and checks boxes. We need someone who takes ownership of every opportunity, understands how to communicate with customers, and has the drive to turn incoming leads into closed business.

If you're a motivated sales professional who enjoys connecting with customers, developing opportunities, and closing deals, Mongo Attachments offers the opportunity to put those skills to work – and be rewarded for it.

Take ownership. Build relationships. Close business.

Apply today and grow with Mongo Attachments!
